jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking experienced **Senior Embedded Software Engineers** to develop real-time embedded control and application software for advanced rocket propulsion systems. This hands-on role supports the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, integration, and testing.

The ideal candidate has strong **C/C++ development experience**, a background in safety-critical or mission-critical systems, and experience working in hardware-integrated environments. This position offers the opportunity to support laboratory testing and live rocket engine hot-fire tests.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, implement, and test real-time embedded control and application software for propulsion systems.
* Support the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, design, coding, unit testing, integration, and verification.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for safety-critical and mission-critical software.
* Participate in software design reviews, customer reviews, and program milestone activities.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to support hardware/software integration and laboratory testing.
* Identify opportunities to improve software development processes, tools, metrics, and overall efficiency.
* Support propulsion system testing, including potential live hot-fire engine tests.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline with 6+ years of relevant experience; or a master's degree with 4+ years; or 10+ years of experience in lieu of a degree.
* **6+ years of embedded real-time software development experience.**
* **6+ years of C/C++ programming experience.**
* Experience developing safety-critical or human-rated software.
* Strong understanding of the full software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, integration, and testing.
* Experience producing detailed software documentation for mission-critical systems.
* Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.
* **Active Secret security clearance required at start.**
* **U.S. citizenship required; dual citizenship is not permitted.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS), including NI Linux, INTEGRITY, Red Hat Linux, or QNX.
* Knowledge of communication protocols such as MIL-STD-1553, TCP/IP, RS-422, and SPI.
* Experience with UML and modeling tools such as Enterprise Architect, Rhapsody, or Cameo.
* Hardware/software integration and embedded systems testing experience.
* Familiarity with laboratory equipment, including oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies.
* Experience with software development IDEs and lifecycle management tools.
* Understanding of CMMI Level 3 or higher software development processes.

**Additional Details**

* **Location:** Huntsville, AL
* **Travel:** Up to 10% to testing facilities in Alabama, Virginia, and California.

60.00 - 69.50 per hour (DOE)

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Job ID: 2618305

**Location:** Huntsville, AL, US

**Date Posted:** 2026-10-23

**Category:** Engineering and Sciences

**Subcategory:** Systems Engineer

**Schedule:** Full-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** Yes - 10% of the time

**Minimum Clearance Required:** Secret

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** None

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_ON\_SITE

**Description**

﻿SAIC is seeking a mid-level **Senior Systems Engineer** to support the **Common Translator (CT)**, an embedded software module that acts as a translator between existing aircraft software and a new Identification, Friend or Foe (IFF) transponder located in **Huntsville, AL**. In this role, you will lead and support systems engineering activities across the lifecycle of safety-critical avionics software developed under DO-178C (DAL C) objectives.

The ideal candidate will work closely with software and test engineers to translate operational and certification requirements into well-structured system and software requirements, architectures, interfaces, and verification strategies. This position is ideal for an engineer who thrives on rigorous requirements engineering, system architecture, and disciplined verification in a standards-driven aerospace environment.

**The Senior Systems Engineer will be responsible for but not limited to the following duties:**

* Elicit, analyze, and document system-level and software-level requirements for transponder-based capabilities.
* Ensure requirements are clear, consistent, testable, and traceable to customer needs, standards, and DO-178C DAL C objectives.
* Decompose and allocate system requirements to software components and interfaces, maintaining end-to-end traceability from high-level requirements through design and test.
* Manage requirements baselines and changes, performing impact analyses on architecture, design, integration, and verification activities.
* Maintain requirements traceability matrices and support audits and reviews focused on requirements completeness and consistency.
* Develop and refine system and software architectures for CT configurations, including data interfaces, and integration with avionics systems.
* Define and maintain interface control documents (ICDs) and data models for integration with aircraft flight management systems, and other avionics subsystems.
* Collaborate with software engineers to ensure the architecture and requirements support performance, safety, configurability, and maintainability goals.
* Data analysis and testing in customer and/or 3rd-party labs (to include some travel)
* Apply DO-178C and related aerospace standards and guidance to systems engineering and requirements activities.
* Support the development of plans, standards, and guidelines (e.g., requirements standards, architecture guidelines) for CT-based solutions.
* Contribute to compliance evidence by producing and reviewing systems engineering and requirements artifacts required for audits and certification reviews.
* Define and maintain verification and validation strategies, including mapping of system and software requirements to test plans and procedures.
* Develop and review test plans, procedures, and cases, ensuring they provide adequate coverage of requirements and key operational scenarios.
* Support integration and system test activities, including anomaly investigation, root cause analysis, and requirements-focused corrective actions.
* Work closely with test engineers to evaluate test results, confirm requirement satisfaction, and improve test effectiveness and traceability.
* Participate in agile ceremonies (backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, reviews, retrospectives) representing systems and requirements engineering concerns.
* Collaborate with software engineers, test engineers and customer stakeholders to refine features and ensure they meet operational needs and certification constraints.
* Lead or contribute to technical reviews (requirements reviews, architecture/design reviews, test readiness reviews) to ensure quality and compliance.
* Develop and maintain systems engineering documentation, including requirements specifications, architecture descriptions, ICDs, and verification reports.
* Ensure systems engineering and requirements artifacts are properly baselined, controlled, and integrated with configuration management tools and processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve requirements management, architecture practices, and verification workflows, and help implement process and tool enhancements.
* Support customer interactions and technical presentations, clearly communicating requirements rationale, system capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs.

**Qualifications**

**Required Education:**

* Bachelor's degree and five (5) years’ experience; additional four (4) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree.

**Required Clearance:**

* Must possess an active Secret security clearance with the ability to maintain; US Citizenship required.

**Required Skills:**

* Experience in requirements engineering: elicitation, analysis, decomposition, allocation, baselining, and traceability.
* Experience developing system and software architectures, defining interfaces, and working with multidisciplinary teams to realize designs.
* Experience collaborating closely with software engineering teams; ability to understand and discuss software design and implementation trade-offs in the context of requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to perform impact analyses and resolve complex integration and requirement issues.
* Proficiency with requirements management practices and tools (e.g., traceability matrices, baseline control, change management).
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing technical documentation and participating in formal reviews.

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Radiance Technologies, a rapidly growing employee-owned company, is seeking a seasoned Senior/Principal Software Engineer to lead the design, development, integration, and verification of software for advanced missile and guided-projectile systems. In this role, you will be the bridge between flight dynamics theory and real-time embedded execution, owning the software architecture for Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC), managing complex Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) simulation labs, and supporting end-to-end flight test campaigns.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. GNC & Embedded Software Development

* Design, implement, integrate, and verify mission-critical missile software, focusing heavily on GNC algorithms, autopilot loops, and flight control laws.
* Translate complex mathematical flight dynamics models into high-performance, deterministic, real-time code.
* Utilize Model-Based Design (MBD) frameworks (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink auto-coding) to transition control algorithms seamlessly into target hardware.

2. Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) & Simulation Management

* Architect, maintain, and expand HWIL test environments, integrating flight computers, inertial measurement units (IMUs), actuation systems, and sensor suites.
* Plan and execute rigorous HWIL test campaigns to validate software performance against simulated aerodynamic threats, target profiles, and environmental disturbances.
* Troubleshoot complex, multi-domain system failures spanning software logic, digital/analog signal interfaces, and physical hardware behavior.

3. Verification, Validation, & Accreditation (VV&A)

* Lead VV&A activities for simulation environments, software-only test beds, and HWIL facilities to ensure high fidelity and traceability to system requirements.
* Develop automated test scripts and regression suites to support continuous integration and rapid deployment of software updates.

4. Pre-Flight Support & Mission Planning

* Collaborate with systems engineering and flight test teams to execute pre-flight activities, including missile flyout predictions, trajectory simulations, and safety analysis.
* Define and optimize Restricted Operating Zones (ROZ), range safety limits, and mission scripts for live-fire or captive-carry tests.

5. Field Deployment & Discrepancy Resolution

* Apply deep flight-dynamics and systems-level knowledge to root-cause analysis, anomaly investigation, and discrepancy resolution during test execution.
* Deploy to remote test ranges, proving grounds, or integration facilities as required to support pre-test checkouts, launch operations, and post-flight data reduction.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Stack**

* Experience: 10+ years of professional software engineering experience specifically within aerospace, defense, or missile systems.
* Education: B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Core Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in C and C++ for real-time embedded environments; familiarity with Python or MATLAB for scripting and analysis.
* Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS): Experience developing safety-critical software on RTOS platforms (e.g., VxWorks, Linux with PREEMPT\_RT).
* Domain Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of flight dynamics, 6-DOF (Degrees of Freedom) simulation, aerodynamics, and control theory.
* HWIL & Lab Equipment: Proven background managing HWIL labs using real-time simulation hardware (e.g., dSPACE, National Instruments PXI/CompactRIO, Speedgoat) and communication protocols (MIL-STD-1553, Ethernet/UDP, ARINC 429, RS-422).
* Clearance: Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience with safety-critical software development standards (e.g., DO-178C or equivalent military standards).
* Familiarity with Agile development workflows, configuration management tools (Git, SVN), and requirements traceability tools (DOORS, Jira).
* Hands-on experience with sensor simulation or seeker-in-the-loop (SIL) testing.

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Radiance Technologies, a rapidly growing employee-owned company, is seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** to play a key role in the design, development, integration, and qualification of missile electronics, power architectures, and electrical interconnect systems. In this position, you will be responsible for the hands-on engineering of onboard avionics, power distribution, sensor/seeker interfaces, Control Actuation System (CAS) drive electronics, flight telemetry systems, and inertial sensor integration.

You will own hardware across the full lifecycle—from concept design and schematic capture through circuit simulation, physical PCB layout, prototype bringing-up, environmental testing, and flight test support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Electrical Hardware & Avionics Design**

* Design, analyze, and test high-reliability, ruggedized printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs) for onboard flight processing, signal conditioning, power conversion, and motor control.
* Develop power supply electronics and power conditioning circuits tailored for high-strain missile environments (utilizing thermal batteries, linear/switching regulators, and protection networks).
* Design motor drive electronics and high-current power stages for electromechanical actuators (CAS) and thrust vector control (TVC) systems.

**2. Subsystem Integration & Interconnects**

* Integrate Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) sensors (Inertial Measurement Units, GPS, altimeters) and seeker payloads with flight computer interfaces.
* Design MIL-spec cable harnesses and interconnect systems engineered to withstand extreme acceleration, vibration, shock, and thermal loads.
* Develop and maintain Electrical Interface Control Documents (ICDs), schematic diagrams, and system wiring topologies.

**3. Signal Integrity, EMI/EMC, & Qualification**

* Implement Electromagnetic Interference (EMI), Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC), and shielding techniques per military standards.
* Perform circuit simulations, signal integrity (SI) analysis, and thermal-electrical derating evaluations for critical avionics components.
* Support and execute environmental qualification testing of electronic assemblies under thermal vacuum (TVAC), vibration, pyroshock, and thermal shock conditions.

**4. Lab Testing, HWIL, & Field Support**

* Design and build Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE), test fixtures, and breakout boxes for laboratory integration and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) testing.
* Perform detailed troubleshooting, failure analysis, and root-cause investigations on hardware anomalies during bench testing, HWIL runs, or field operations.
* Support remote test range campaigns for pre-flight checkouts and post-flight telemetry/data analysis.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Stack**

* **Education:** B.S. in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering with 5+ years of experience, or M.S. with 3+ years of experience in aerospace, defense, or high-reliability electronics design.

**IMU & Inertial Sensor Experience:**

* Direct hands-on experience integrating tactical or strategic-grade IMUs (RLG, FOG, or high-performance MEMS IMUs such as Honeywell, Northrop Grumman, or Analog Devices units).
* In-depth understanding of IMU electrical interfaces, clocking/synchronization protocols, dynamic range constraints, and noise-sensitivity characteristics.

* **Circuit Design & Tools:**
  + Proven track record in schematic capture and PCB layout using industry-standard EDA tools (**Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro, or Mentor Graphics/Siemens EDA**).
  + Hands-on experience with mixed-signal, analog, high-speed digital, and power conversion (DC-DC) design.
* **Bus Protocols & Interfaces:**
  + Experience implementing standard defense and industrial communication buses (**MIL-STD-1553, ARINC 429, Ethernet/UDP, CAN bus, RS-422/485, SPI, I2C**).
* **Military Standards & Test:**
  + Working knowledge of key military standards (**MIL-STD-461** for EMI/EMC, **MIL-STD-810** for environmental testing, and **MIL-STD-704** for aircraft/missile power).
* **Security Clearance:** Must hold an **active US DoD Secret security clearance** with eligibility for Top Secret / SCI.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience designing drive electronics for brushless DC (BLDC) motors or actuators.
* Background in ordnance safety design or electronic fuzing (ESAD/ESAF) circuits per **MIL-STD-1901A**.
* Familiarity with RF interfaces, antennas, or telemetry transmitters.
* Basic FPGA development (VHDL/Verilog) or micro-controller firmware integration experience.

Radiance Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer**  
  
Join Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions practice as a Microsoft Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant). You will help clients design, deploy, and support scalable Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365 F&O) and Power Platform environments that advance finance and supply chain transformation. You will collaborate with client business and technology leaders to establish secure application lifecycle management, DevOps, integration, and operational practices across complex engagements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.  
  
Work you'll do  
  
As a Microsoft D365/Power Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant) on the Emerging ERP Solutions team, you will be responsible for:  
  
Design and govern environment topology, routing, capacity, deployment standards, Data Loss Prevention policies, and managed-environment settings across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Dataverse, model-driven apps, and Power Automate; lead transitions from Lifecycle Services (LCS) to Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) deployment models.  
  
Architect and maintain Git-based application lifecycle management (ALM) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Power Platform Build Tools, solution packaging, automated solution checker gates, release controls, and rollback procedures.  
  
Lead client workshops, architecture reviews, and stakeholder discussions; document environment and architecture decisions in decision logs and runbooks; present trade-offs involving cost, governance, and delivery speed.  
  
Manage Azure integration services, including Service Bus, API Management (APIM), Storage Accounts, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and Application Insights; monitor batch jobs, workflows, integrations, and application performance; investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.  
  
Manage technical delivery across concurrent client engagements, mentor team members, maintain reusable assets, and evaluate governance implications of emerging Power Platform capabilities, including Code Apps, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and Copilot Studio agents.  
  
Participate in on-call and after-hours support as required.  
  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  
  
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  
  
Effective written and verbal communication skills  
  
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  
  
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  
  
Ability to lead projects or workstreams  
  
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  
  
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  
  
Ability to meet deadlines  
  
Ability to provide clear guidance to others  
  
Qualifications Required:  
  
6+ years of experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) or Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management (F&SCM), and Power Platform.  
  
Experience using Azure DevOps or GitHub-based continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for Dataverse solutions and Git workflows, including branching, pull requests, and conflict resolution.  
  
Experience using Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC), environment groups, managed environments, and Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS)-to-PPAC deployment transitions.  
  
Experience designing Dataverse solution architecture, including managed and unmanaged solution layering and use of the Power Platform Center of Excellence Starter Kit or Application Lifecycle Management Accelerator.  
  
Experience using Azure Portal and at least two of the following Azure services: API Management, Service Bus, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Key Vault, or Azure Functions.  
  
Experience leading client workshops, architecture reviews, or steering committee presentations.  
  
Experience managing technical delivery across two or more concurrent client engagements.  
  
You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.  
  
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.  
  
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.  
  
Preferred:  
  
Microsoft certifications: PL-600 (Solution Architect), MB-700 (F&SCM Solution Architect), MB-800, or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer).  
  
AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-204 (Azure Developer) certification.  
  
Experience with Dataverse Git integration and Power Platform Build Tools.  
  
Experience with Copilot Studio agent governance and AI Builder.  
  
Experience with dual-write or integration architectures connecting Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management or Customer Engagement to external systems through Service Bus or API Management.  
  
Experience creating environment and ALM decision records, operational support documentation, or runbooks.  
  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. Description:

TriVector Services, Inc. provides quality aerospace engineering solutions to complex problems through a renowned team of engineering professionals. We are a Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned, SBA-certified Small Business headquartered in Huntsville, Alabama. Our experienced team is dedicated to building lasting partnerships based on professional integrity and sound engineering principles. TriVector's **Experience** and exceptional **Performance** adds measurable **Value** to every project. TriVector Services, Inc., is seeking qualified candidates to fill our **Electrical Engineering Technician IV** position.

The Electrical Engineering Technician level IV (Service Contract Act (SCA) Occupation Code 30080) support NASA - Marshall Space Flight Center must be able to provide semi-professional technical support for engineers working in such areas as research, design, development, testing, or manufacturing process improvement. Work pertains to electrical, electronic, or mechanical components or equipment. These technicians are required to have some practical knowledge of science or engineering. Some positions may require a practical knowledge of mathematics or computer science. Included are workers who prepare design drawings and assist with the design, evaluation, and/or modification of machinery and equipment.

* Assist with configuration control activities, including hardware identification, documentation updates, and verification of installed configurations.
* Support anomaly resolution and failure investigations through inspection, troubleshooting, testing, data collection, and corrective action implementation.
* Obtain and maintain all certifications required to support assigned duties, including operation of material handling equipment, personnel lifts, and other specialized equipment as required by the scope of work.
* Perform assignments that are not completely standardized or prescribed.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* U.S. Citizenship is required.
* Must have at least 5 years of relevant experience.
* Requires ability to obtain and maintain NASA Public Trust background screening requirements.
* Practical knowledge of science or engineering is required.
* Practical knowledge of mathematics is required.
* Must have at least a high school diploma or GED.
* Must be able to work from written and verbal instructions.
* Must adhere to MSFC and OSHA safety requirements, including use of appropriate PPE when necessary and follow written technical procedures.
* Must be dependable and willing to work hours outside the normal schedule.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and workmanship.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer -Top SECRET - ONSITE
jobs.description:
Visual Soft, Inc is seeking qualified candidates (US Citizens with active **TOP SECRET** clearance - a requirement on its Project with a Major Prime) for the following position for a federal agency.

**Job Title**: Senior Systems Engineer  
**Location**: Huntsville, AL  
**Salary**: based on experience on other qualifications. OR 1099 is also available only for individuals NOT C2C scenario, check will be issued in legal name
  
**Clearance**: **TOP SECRET is** a must and job is fully ONSITE  
**Education:** Bachelor's degree with 8+ years of experience  
**Job description:**  
We are seeking an experienced **Senior Systems Engineer** with following job responsibilities **:**

* Supervise, coordinate and/or perform additions and changes to network hardware and operating systems, and attached devices, including investigation, analysis, recommendation, configuration, installation, and testing of new network hardware and software.
* Provide direct support in the day-to-day operations on network hardware and operating systems including the evaluation of system utilization, monitoring response time and primary support for detection and correction of operational problems.
* Troubleshoot at the physical level of the network, working with network measurement hardware and software, as well as physical checking and testing of hardware devices at the logical level working with communication protocols.
* Participate in planning design, technical review and implementation for new network infrastructure hardware and network operating systems for voice and data communication networks.
* Perform systems management and integration functions. Exhibiting proficiency with virtualization technologies and network administration.
* Maintain network infrastructure standards including network communication protocols such as TCP/IP. Provide technical consultation, training and support to IT staff as designated by the government.
* Diagnose and resolve complex communication problems.
* Perform systems management and integration functions.
* Responsible for design, deployment, evaluating, testing, certification, patching, addressing interoperability issues, not only of the base storage & backup system, but for all features, components, and application dependencies.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

#### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Space Ground Systems Engineering team solves the mathematical, physical, and algorithmic problems at the core of next-generation missile defense and fire control systems. We tackle dynamic battle-management challenges: fusing real-time sensor streams into track data, optimizing weapon-target assignment under uncertainty, and feeding high-confidence fire-control schedules back to the warfighter.

#### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Systems Engineer - Machine Learning to join our rapidly growing team in Huntsville, AL or Colorado Springs, CO. In this role, you will be responsible for bridging systems engineering, applied physics, and mathematical and machine learning to solve complex missile defense problems. You will design track-fusion pipelines, build threat-assignment algorithms, and conduct deep sensitivity analyses across complex architectures. This will require proficiency in applied math, physics, and algorithm development using Python or C++, alongside an understanding of sensor data and battle management workflows. If you are someone who moves quickly, loves diving deep into the math behind the system, and can operate autonomously to deliver verified, defensible technical solutions, then this role is for you.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Machine Learning:** Research, develop, and deploy complex machine learning models such as generative ai, reinforcement learning, deep neural networks, physics based neural models.
* **Algorithm Design and Development:** Formulate and solve complex physics problems using mathematical techniques.
  + Ex: Object detection, tracking, and discrimination. Weapon-Target Assignment (WTA), sensor allocation, and fire control scheduling.
* **Sensor Fusion & Tracking:** Work on the components of system architecture that ingest raw/processed sensor data, execute track fusion, and perform threat classification.
* **Parametric & Sensitivity Analysis:** Design, conduct, and defend rigorous trade studies, sensitivity analyses, and parametric evaluations to determine system boundaries and validate performance.
* **Prototyping & Modeling:** Rapidly translate mathematical equations into clean, functional code (Python / C++) to run non-customer-facing modeling, simulation, and algorithm verification.
* **Mission Systems Architecture:** Bridge the gap between low-level physics/threat intelligence inputs and high-level mission outputs.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
* **Experience:** 5+ years of relevant engineering experience
* Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
* **Core Foundation:** Strong mastery of **applied mathematics, physics, and programming**.
* **Algorithmic Programming:** Proficiency in **Python** and/or **C++, Pytorch (or TensorFlow), Coding GPU's,** multi-agent reinforcement learning, mathematical modeling, experience implementing foundation models, and algorithm development (you don't need to be an enterprise software engineer, but you must be able to write robust code to solve math problems).
  + Windows, Linux, MATLAB,
* **Domain Knowledge:** Exposure to missile defense concepts, radar/sensor processing, flight dynamics, TOM, threat intelligence, discrimination algorithms, sensor tracking algorithms, kill assessment, integrated algorithms into operational systems, or fire control systems (GMD, NGI, SM3, Aegis, IBCS, C2BMC, SBI)
  + Military or defense operations experience is a strong plus.
* **Security Clearance:** **Active U.S. Secret clearance required**

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Top Secret / SCI eligible preferred.

jobs.description:
**Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer**  
  
Join Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions practice as a Microsoft Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant). You will help clients design, deploy, and support scalable Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365 F&O) and Power Platform environments that advance finance and supply chain transformation. You will collaborate with client business and technology leaders to establish secure application lifecycle management, DevOps, integration, and operational practices across complex engagements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.  
  
Work you'll do  
  
As a Microsoft D365/Power Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant) on the Emerging ERP Solutions team, you will be responsible for:  
  
Design and govern environment topology, routing, capacity, deployment standards, Data Loss Prevention policies, and managed-environment settings across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Dataverse, model-driven apps, and Power Automate; lead transitions from Lifecycle Services (LCS) to Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) deployment models.  
  
Architect and maintain Git-based application lifecycle management (ALM) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Power Platform Build Tools, solution packaging, automated solution checker gates, release controls, and rollback procedures.  
  
Lead client workshops, architecture reviews, and stakeholder discussions; document environment and architecture decisions in decision logs and runbooks; present trade-offs involving cost, governance, and delivery speed.  
  
Manage Azure integration services, including Service Bus, API Management (APIM), Storage Accounts, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and Application Insights; monitor batch jobs, workflows, integrations, and application performance; investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.  
  
Manage technical delivery across concurrent client engagements, mentor team members, maintain reusable assets, and evaluate governance implications of emerging Power Platform capabilities, including Code Apps, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and Copilot Studio agents.  
  
Participate in on-call and after-hours support as required.  
  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  
  
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  
  
Effective written and verbal communication skills  
  
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  
  
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  
  
Ability to lead projects or workstreams  
  
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  
  
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  
  
Ability to meet deadlines  
  
Ability to provide clear guidance to others  
  
Qualifications Required:  
  
6+ years of experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) or Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management (F&SCM), and Power Platform.  
  
Experience using Azure DevOps or GitHub-based continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for Dataverse solutions and Git workflows, including branching, pull requests, and conflict resolution.  
  
Experience using Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC), environment groups, managed environments, and Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS)-to-PPAC deployment transitions.  
  
Experience designing Dataverse solution architecture, including managed and unmanaged solution layering and use of the Power Platform Center of Excellence Starter Kit or Application Lifecycle Management Accelerator.  
  
Experience using Azure Portal and at least two of the following Azure services: API Management, Service Bus, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Key Vault, or Azure Functions.  
  
Experience leading client workshops, architecture reviews, or steering committee presentations.  
  
Experience managing technical delivery across two or more concurrent client engagements.  
  
You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.  
  
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.  
  
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.  
  
Preferred:  
  
Microsoft certifications: PL-600 (Solution Architect), MB-700 (F&SCM Solution Architect), MB-800, or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer).  
  
AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-204 (Azure Developer) certification.  
  
Experience with Dataverse Git integration and Power Platform Build Tools.  
  
Experience with Copilot Studio agent governance and AI Builder.  
  
Experience with dual-write or integration architectures connecting Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management or Customer Engagement to external systems through Service Bus or API Management.  
  
Experience creating environment and ALM decision records, operational support documentation, or runbooks.  
  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. jobs.title: Equipment Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Crafco has an opening for an Equipment Electrical Engineer at our equipment plant in Chandler, AZ.**

Under the direction of the Equipment Engineering Manager, the Equipment Electrical Engineer is responsible for all equipment related electrical and software development, research, design, testing, application and improvement. The position will use 2D and 3D CAD Modeling software to develop electrical designs and drawings/schematics for wiring harnesses, control systems, electric drive components, electrical connectors and related systems using verbal instructions, customer specifications, sales staff and other Engineering data. The position will also use programming software for the improvement and development of PLC's and user interface design that integrate with and control the equipment's functions.

**This position offers a competitive salary rate with an excellent benefits package including: Profit Sharing, Matching 401(k), Health, Life, Disability, Dental, Vision, Holiday, Personal & Sick pay, Maternity/Paternity leave and more!**

**Specific Duties include:**

* Make various drawings using Solid Edge 3D and AutoCAD 2D software following standard manufacturing and engineering procedures.
* Design new products as assigned by the Equipment Engineering Manager.
* Design, test and implement new and/or improved wiring harnesses for machinery.
* Design, program, integrate and test PLC and/or HMI control systems to control the equipment's functions.
* Integration, development and programming of robotic systems.
* Follow the product life cycle from research and design to prototyping and testing to implementation in production, and to the final state of performance in the field.
* Provide technical support and troubleshooting to customers and internal personnel.
* Specify correct materials within the scope of standard stocking inventory.
* Update existing drawings as necessary due to changes in design or manufacturing requests.
* Complete Engineering Change Notice and circulate documentation as needed.
* Complete all phases of drawings and schematics from small detailed parts to large assemblies.
* Reduce costs and waste on existing and new designs.
* Work on Operator Manuals, both new and existing or other literature as needed by the Equipment Engineering Manager.
* Develop and maintain part numbers with all necessary information in order to purchase, make and use the parts.
* Enter and update Bills of Material and Manufacturing Routes in SAP manufacturing software.
* Provide monthly project update reports.
* Develop and present quarterly project presentations.
* Maintain a neat, clean, organized and safe work space.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and training.
* Perform other miscellaneous duties as required by the Equipment Engineering Manager.
* Limited travel to customer location to provide assistance.
* Be able to travel internationally as may be required.

**Qualifications:**

* Possess an Electrical Engineering Degree or equivalent from a minimum of 2 years in college or trade school, but 4 years is preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in electrical design and application within the industries of industrial machinery, construction equipment, automotive or aerospace.
* Must have knowledge of wire harness and connection design as well as implementation experience.
* Must have experience with Human Machine Interface/Programmable Logic Controls and related software programming. It is desirable to have knowledge on IEC61131 standards, Sequential Function Chart (SFC), Structured Text (ST) and Ladder (LDR) languages.
* Experience with ERP or MRP software, (preferably SAP) is preferred.
* Must be proficient with typical office computer operations and programs including Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel.
* Must be proficient with 3D CAD software. Solid Edge is preferred, but Solidworks or the equivalent is acceptable.
* Must be a self-starter and have good time management skills.
* Must have strong communication and people skills.
* Must have ability to prioritize and multitask effectively, and work responsibly with or without direct supervision, with exceptional attention to detail and quality.
* Ability to comply with all company policies and procedures.
* Must be able to lift 50 lbs.

**About Crafco, Inc.**

Crafco, Inc. has delivered confidence through innovation, quality, and value to our customers since 1976. Crafco is the world's leading manufacturer in quantity and diversity of packaged pavement preservation products and equipment. As a subsidiary of Ergon, Inc., our core values consist of Empowered Service, Selfless Leadership, Purposeful Growth, and Respectful Relationships, which provide an excellent work environment for future growth. We have a great culture of people working together. If you are looking for a great career with a job you enjoy, check us out.

Learn more about Crafco and Ergon:

http://crafco.com

https://ergon.com/sustainability

Contact us to see if you can be a part of our TEAM.

jobs.title: Sr. Principal Electrical Engineer 4 – Automated Test Equipment (ATE)
jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be availableCLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: NoCLEARANCE TYPE: SecretTRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Sr. Principal Electrical Engineer 4 – Automated Test Equipment (ATE)

Northrop Grumman Space Systems is currently seeking an experienced Principal Electrical Engineer to join our electrical ground support equipment group in our Chandler, AZ facility. The Automated Test Equipment (ATE) team supports our programs with the design, test, and sustainment of all ATE and test support equipment hardware used in the integration and launch of our vehicles. Our EGSE team members work in a diverse set of roles across the lifecycle of a program.

Job Duties: Based on specific objectives, work with a system electrical engineering team to perform analysis, design, and test of complex “system level” designs with a focus on the electrical ground support equipment and test support equipment for the launch vehicle.

Job responsibilities:

  

* Broad understanding and application of company electrical engineering technical standards.
* Broad technical expertise and working knowledge of other related disciplines.
* Prepares and presents electrical engineering materials for Requirements and Design Reviews.
* With minimal guidance, studies basic design concepts and criteria for more complex problems.
* Applies electrical engineering principles to adapt or improve upon heritage features from previous successful designs of a similar nature.
* Actively and effectively participates and contributes in a positive manner while supporting team decisions and goals.
* Makes an extra effort to provide quality internal and external customer service.
* Constantly seeks new sources of information and provides information necessary to meet customer needs.
* Disciplined with escalation when required.
* Derives requirements through multiple sources of documentation and design meetings.
* Evaluate, with supervision, uncertainty and risks associated with requirements and designs.
* Patriciate in trade studies for both internal projects and procured equipment.
* Act with safety as your number one priority through every aspect of the role.
* Provides formal peer review of simple engineering designs or analyses for less experienced engineers.
* Completing day-to-day activities with no oversight of senior engineers.

Desired Experience:

  

* Design, test, and/or integration and deployment of electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) or test support equipment (TSE).
* Design, test, programming, and/or integration and deployment of automated test equipment (ATE).
* Testing of avionics, electronic components, or electrical systems using purpose designed test equipment.
* Burndown of nonconformances and/or root cause failure analysis of electronic systems.
* Release of engineering documentation including technical drawings, specifications, and test procedures.
* Leading teams or personnel in the execution of test procedures.
* Leading teams or personnel in the design of electronic equipment.
* Management or tracking of projects through a product life cycle.
* Support of manufacturing engineering during the production of test equipment products.
* Experience with telemetry systems including decoms and chapter 10 recorders.
* Development or support of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) or other integrations labs.
* Problem solving not only for technical issues, but also for schedule, cost, resource and other project challenges.
* Mentoring and cross-training team members across a diverse set of technologies and equipment architectures used to meet customer requirements.
* Knowledgeable with the use of basic test equipment such as power supplies, oscilloscopes, DMMs, and electronic loads.
* Broad or high-level circuit design and analysis.

Also seeking experience in any of the following:

  

* LabVIEW/TestStand programming and NI hardware and software products.
* Contributions to process improvement initiatives.
* CompTIA Security+ or similar certifications.
* Usage and troubleshooting of networks, Windows systems, and RHEL or other Linux distributions.
* Experience with classified test systems or systems subject to cyber security policies.

Basic Qualifications for Sr. Principal Electrical Engineer - 4

  

* Requires 8 years with a Bachelor’s in Engineering or 5 years with a Master’s in Engineering.
* Ability to obtain U.S. Government Secret Clearance at time of application.
* U.S. Citizenship is required
* Proficient knowledge of electrical engineering principles.
* Design, Test, or Integration experience with EGSE or similar equipment.
* Experience with processes applicable to operating EGSE in secure environments.

**Day Shift**

**Pay Rate: $42/hr - $45/hr (based on experience)**

**Electrical Engineer I**

As an Electrical Engineer I within the Propulsion Control Systems team, you will contribute to the design, integration, and production support of electronic control systems used in gas turbine engines, auxiliary power units (APUs), and cabin pressure control systems. Working alongside experienced engineers across multiple disciplines, you will support products throughout their lifecycle while developing the technical expertise needed to build a successful career in aerospace engineering.

In this role, you will support the development and sustainment of highly engineered aerospace products, with a focus on electronic control units (ECUs) and related control system technologies. You will collaborate with design, manufacturing, supplier, and certification teams to resolve technical issues, implement design improvements, and ensure products continue to meet performance, quality, and regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Production & Factory Support**

* Support production and manufacturing teams by investigating and resolving engineering issues.
* Develop and release Engineering Change Notices (ECNs).
* Perform technical evaluations and substantiation of design changes.
* Collaborate with engineering team members to prioritize support activities.
* Partner with cross-functional engineering teams.

**Design & Systems Integration**

* Support approved source list and build-to-print drawings.
* Reconcile component-level requirements with system and customer requirements.
* Support integration into larger aerospace systems.
* Assist with drawing revisions, design updates, and obsolescence management.

**Supplier & Project Coordination**

jobs.title: Sr Embedded Engineer, Vehicle Diagnostics and Monitoring
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match.  
  
Our AV Labs Hardware team is building the next-generation E/E architecture for our L4 data-collection vehicle fleet. A fleet only collects useful data when its compute, MCU and sensors work reliably in the car, and when a fault can be found and fixed without a technician on site. You will build the diagnostics, monitoring and dashboards that make fleet health visible, from MCU and SoC firmware to fleet dashboards, and you will bring our hardware to life in vehicles and support the path to production-line testing.  
  
**What the Candidate Will Do**  

* **Diagnostics and fault management:** Design and implement fault detection, event and DTC handling, UDS and DoIP services, and watchdog supervision across the MCU and the Linux compute platform.
* **Monitoring framework:** Design and own the vehicle health monitoring pipeline: collect metrics, logs and fault events from the MCU (CAN, serial or UDP) and the Linux SoC, and send them to a central time-series and log store using standard tooling (for example Prometheus exporters or OpenTelemetry collectors).
* **Deep system observability:** Use eBPF and kernel tracing to observe Linux SoC behavior with low overhead: scheduling, network, driver and camera pipeline latency, and frame or packet drops.
* **Dashboards and alerting:** Build dashboards (for example in Grafana) for fleet, vehicle and board health: temperatures, voltages, power state, bus load, time sync offset, camera link status and update status. Define alert rules and thresholds, and route alerts to on-call.
* **Vehicle bring-up and integration:** Commission the compute, MCU and sensor stack in vehicles (CAN-FD, Ethernet, power sequencing, GNSS, IMU, cameras) and validate gPTP and PPS timing.
* **Field triage and test automation:** Use monitoring data to reproduce and root-cause vehicle issues with the reliability and software teams, and turn each one into an automated regression test and, where useful, a new dashboard panel or alert.
* **Safety and security of diagnostics:** Contribute to safety analysis (FMEA, FMEDA) and implement safety mechanisms. Protect diagnostic access with authenticated sessions and security access.
* **Production line support:** Define the diagnostic interfaces and readouts (unit identity, firmware versions, pass or fail data) that end-of-line test stations use, with the manufacturing test team.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* **Embedded experience:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, with 7+ years developing embedded software in C/C++ on an RTOS, embedded Linux or bare metal.
* **Automotive diagnostics:** Hands-on experience with UDS (ISO 14229), DTC handling and ISO-TP over CAN; DoIP (ISO 13400) is a plus.
* **Vehicle networks and integration:** Strong experience with CAN/CAN-FD and Automotive Ethernet, tools such as Vector CANoe or similar, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, and integrating compute platforms and sensors in vehicles.
* **Linux observability:** Hands-on experience debugging system-level issues on embedded Linux with eBPF-based tools and profilers (for example bpftrace, bcc or perf).
* **Monitoring and visualization:** Experience building monitoring for devices or fleets (for example with Prometheus and Grafana): instrumentation or exporters, dashboards and alert rules, in Python, Go or C/C++.
* **Production lifecycle:** Experience taking embedded systems from prototype and third-party integration to production, ideally in autonomous vehicle, robotics or mission-critical automotive domains.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* **Observability stack:** Experience with log and time-series stacks (for example Loki, ELK, OpenTelemetry, InfluxDB), eBPF-based observability tools, and fleet-scale telemetry pipelines (retention, cardinality, cost).
* **Security:** Hardware security module (HSM) and secure boot experience, plus secure diagnostics (UDS security access, authenticated sessions, key management).
* **AUTOSAR diagnostics:** Configuring Dcm, Dem, FiM, WdgM and E2E modules in an AUTOSAR Classic stack.
* **Functional safety:** ISO 26262 (ASIL B through D), ASPICE and MISRA C/C++.
* **Production and service tooling:** End-of-line test, factory programming or remote service diagnostics tooling.
* **Linux and AV compute:** Linux kernel, device tree and Yocto board support, and experience with platforms such as NVIDIA DRIVE or Jetson.

  
For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $180,000 per year - USD $200,000 per year.  
  
You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

jobs.title: Firmware Release & Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We've got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform's impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that's alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We're rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

### **About the Role**

As a Firmware Release & Test Automation Engineer, you will own the final mile between embedded code development and physical deployment across our global fleet of connected devices. In this hybrid role, you sit at the intersection of build infrastructure, automated validation, and release governance. You won't just run test suites or push buttons on a deployment train—you will architect the continuous integration pipelines, design Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) automation fixtures, define gatekeeping qualification criteria, and orchestrate safe, staged over-the-air (OTA) updates.

You will work closely with firmware engineers, hardware validation teams, and cloud backend developers to ensure that every build that lands on a customer's wall, ceiling, or door controller is stable, secure, and reliable.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to be onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Own the Release Lifecycle:** Define, maintain, and optimize the end-to-end release pipeline for embedded Linux and RTOS builds across our devices.
* **Build Automated Validation Systems:** Design, build, and scale automated Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) test harnesses to catch regressions before firmware ever reaches external hardware.
* **Set Quality & Gatekeeping Standards:** Establish clear go/no-go qualification gates, track test flakiness, and lead triage for release-blocking bugs alongside core firmware developers.
* **Orchestrate Safe Deployments:** Drive staged fleet rollouts, canary deployments, and automated telemetry monitoring to catch field anomalies early and execute fast rollbacks when needed.
* **Drive Developer Productivity:** Build tools and CI/CD automation that speed up firmware compile, packaging, and local test cycles.
* **Self-motivated problem solver:** At Verkada, you will tackle large, complex edge-case bugs spanning silicon, firmware, networking, and cloud services with no clear answers.
* **Teach and learn:** You will take technical ownership of major validation systems while collaborating with and mentoring peers across software, firmware, and hardware engineering.

### **What You Bring**

* BS or graduate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 3+ years of experience in software/firmware build infrastructure, embedded test automation, or release engineering.
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and Bash for automation, scripting, and test framework development.
* Working knowledge of C/C++ in embedded Linux or RTOS environments.
* Hands-on experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, TeamCity) for embedded systems.
* Experience with automated test execution on physical hardware targets (HIL testbeds, serial/UART logging, JTAG/SWD, network power switches).
* Understanding of modern version control workflows (Git branching models, tagging, release trains) and build systems (Yocto/BitBake, CMake, Make, Bazel).
* Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week at our San Mateo HQ.
* Must be willing to travel at least one week a year to our engineering office in Krakow, Poland.

### **Nice to Have**

* Working knowledge of Go.
* Experience with secure boot workflows, cryptographic firmware signing, and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation.
* Familiarity with over-the-air (OTA) update frameworks and dual-partition (A/B) fallback mechanisms.
* Experience monitoring fleet health telemetry (DataDog, Grafana, Prometheus, or ELK).
* Knowledge of standard embedded communication interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Ethernet) and Wi-Fi/cellular networking.

### **US Employee Benefits**

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

* Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
* Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage

* Expanded mental health support

* Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.

With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an **Electrical Engineer** to join our satellite development team. In this role, you will design, develop, and integrate electrical systems that power and control spacecraft propulsion systems, working closely with engineers from other subsystems to integrate your designs from concept through flight.

This is a hands-on, collaborative role where you’ll lead electrical hardware design, lab testing, and debugging across low-to-high voltage subsystems. This includes embedded microcontroller hardware, power tree design, precision sensor acquisition, valve drivers, and dedicated DC/DC converters. You will work alongside firmware and power electronics engineers and collaborate closely with propulsion and avionics teams to ensure hardware reliability in harsh space environments.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Hardware Design:** Design and develop electrical subsystems for propulsion electronics, including embedded microcontroller hardware, sensor interfaces, valve drivers, and power conversion.
* **PCB Development:** Lead schematic capture and multi-layer PCB layout design from breadboard prototypes to flight hardware.
* **Power & Driver Stages:** Design, tune, and validate DC/DC converters and driver stages for inductive and resistive loads.
* **Analog Acquisition:** Implement precision analog front-ends for critical telemetry, including current sensing (high-side/low-side), pressure transducers, and temperature monitoring.
* **Firmware Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with embedded firmware engineers to define hardware/firmware interfaces, peripheral pin mappings, register maps, and communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, RS-422).
* **Reviews & Quality:** Conduct hardware design and layout reviews. Support component sourcing while ensuring compliance with standards and derating guidelines.
* **Testing & Automation:** Develop and execute electrical test plans from breadboard to flight hardware, writing Python scripts for test automation and data logging.
* **Lab Debugging:** Troubleshoot and debug electrical systems in a lab environment using test equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, electronic dynamic loads, power meters).
* **Documentation:** Develop electrical interface documentation (ICDs) and test procedures for spacecraft subsystems.
* **Integration Support:** Support assembly, integration, and test (AIT) activities, including environmental testing (e.g., TVAC, vibration, EMI/EMC).

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 2+ years taking mixed-signal designs from schematics to manufacturing and lab bring-up.
* **EDA & Modeling:** Familiarity with electrical design and simulation tools (e.g., Altium, KiCad, SPICE).
* **Core Technical:** Fundamental understanding of mixed-signal electronics, power tree design, power conversion, signal integrity, and hardware reliability in harsh space environments.
* **Embedded HW:** Hands-on experience designing embedded microcontroller hardware and peripheral interfaces (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, RS-422).
* **Power Electronics:** Experience designing driver circuits for inductive loads (valves, valve drivers, solenoids) and closed-loop DC/DC converters. High-voltage power electronics experience is a plus.
* **Analog Design:** Strong background in precision sensor acquisition and analog signal conditioning (op-amps, filtering, ADC/DAC interfacing).
* **Lab Validation:** Hands-on experience with electrical testing, debugging (oscilloscopes, dynamic loads, power meters), and Python test scripting.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to satellite systems, avionics, or electrical power systems.
* Experience with space environmental testing (e.g., TVAC, vibration, EMI/EMC per MIL-STD-461) and component derating standards (e.g., NASA EEE-INST-002).
* Experience developing hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulators
* Familiarity with reading embedded C/C++ to collaborate seamlessly with firmware engineers during low-level driver bring-up and boundary-scan debugging.

**For U.S. Roles:** To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

**For U.K. Roles:** To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

**For Canada Roles:** Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Compensation Range: $140K - $185K

jobs.title: Battery and Power Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At SiFly, we're building a new category of aircraft: vertical-takeoff, long-endurance drones that deliver helicopter-level performance at drone economics. After thousands of flight tests and years of engineering, our NDAA-compliant platform flies more than 2 hours in hover or 3 hours in forward flight on a single charge — matching the capability of traditional helicopters at a fraction of their cost and operational burden. We merge aerial robotics, perception, and onboard intelligence to cut complexity and minimize human intervention, and our unique approach to communications and networking unlocks remote operations from day one. It's an ambitious mission, and we're a small team that moves fast.  
  
**The role**  
  
A lead engineer for battery packs and high current distribution in our products. This can include cell selection, architecture, thermal and electrical design, BMS tuning and characterization on the bench. You’ll also play a role in cell and pack vendor relationships, our manufacturing partners, and the safety testing and certification.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* Drive pack architecture and future cell evalutions
* Understand and evolve our pack designs including structure, materials, thermal paths, tolerance analysis — and characterize them on the bench.
* Drive BMS hardware architecture, and specify the BMS firmware requirements: what it must do, and how it must fail.
* Own charge control: charger architecture, charge-rate strategy, and the throughput consequences of both.
* Drive battery safety — the analysis, the test campaigns, and the documentation — including UN 38.3 and IEC 62133.
* Lead hardware analysis in support of safety: worst-case circuit analysis, DFMEA, derating, thermal assessment, protection coordination.
* Support Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain through NPI and production ramp.

**What we're looking for**

* Electrical engineering depth with real high-voltage or high-energy battery system experience.
* You've taken a lithium-ion pack from cell selection through to a shipping product.
* BMS electronics experience. Ability to specify architecture options and firmware behavior. History of working with cell monitoring, balancing, protection circuits, isolation measurement.
* Hands-on bench capability: you can instrument a pack, run the thermal characterization, and interpret the data.
* Battery safety test experience
* You anticipate failure systematically — DFMEA, worst-case circuit analysis, derating and stress analysis, thermal margin.
* First-principles thinking and a drive to understand the “why” behind traditional approaches to propulsion, power systems, and even radio technologies.
* This is a hands-on job at a company that is still small. You'll be at the bench, in the shop, on the flight line, and sometimes at a customer site working out why a deployed system is misbehaving — alongside new product development, not instead of it.
* You use AI as a real tool, not a talking point. We want to hear one specific example of something you did with AI that surprised you — a workflow you rebuilt, a problem you came at sideways, an analysis that wouldn't have been worth doing by hand. We care less about which tools you use than about what you've changed about how you work. We're enthusiastic about the leverage and unforgiving about errors.

**Nice to have**

* Both aerospace and automotive high-voltage battery context.
* Charging infrastructure design, and mechanical pack design alongside the electrical side.

**Details**

* Onsite in Santa Clara, CA.
* Compensation range $120-165K

jobs.title: Systems Engineer, Thermal and Airflow
jobs.description:
Mill is a waste prevention technology company reimagining what it means to eliminate waste, starting with food. We build smart systems and infrastructure for homes, businesses, and municipalities that transform food scraps from landfill-bound waste into valuable resources, including chicken feed. Tens of thousands of Mill's residential food recyclers are already helping households divert millions of pounds of food scraps every year, paving the way for our upcoming launch of Mill Commercial—the industry's first end-to-end solution for managing, understanding, and preventing food waste in commercial environments (e.g. grocery, restaurants, food services). At Mill, we are passionate about building easy-to-use, beautifully designed technologies that keep food in the food system and out of landfills.

**About this Role**

As a Systems Engineer at Mill, you will help characterize, understand, and improve the performance of our next-generation commercial food recycler. This is a hands-on individual contributor role on a small team. You'll work closely with our test engineers to turn experimental data into clear conclusions, review and draft changes to the Engineering Requirements Document (ERD), and take ownership of specific subsystems from characterization through design improvement. You'll collaborate daily with Mechanical, Electrical, Algorithms, and Product. If you enjoy digging into thermal and airflow data and turning it into better hardware, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Partner with the test engineering team to plan experiments and analyze the resulting data on system parameters such as temperatures, airflow, humidity, and heat transfer. Derive conclusions, quantify tradeoffs, and recommend next steps to improve drying performance, energy efficiency, and throughput.
* Own targeted subsystems (e.g. airflow path, condenser, heater, or drying chamber) end to end: define requirements, characterize performance, identify failure modes, and drive design improvements.
* Review proposed changes to the ERD and draft requirement updates based on test results, field data, and cross-functional input, so that requirements stay current and visible to stakeholders.
* Work with the algorithms and firmware teams to provide the data and system understanding needed to refine control schemes for energy use, drying time, and reliable operation.
* Support mechanical engineers in evaluating and iterating on custom hardware such as mixing paddles, air deflectors, and cutting/shredding components, grounded in test data.
* Help define component requirements (fans, blowers, heaters, sensors, flow meters) and support part selection and evaluation.
* Build reusable analysis tools and clear reports (plots, summaries, test writeups) that make results legible across the team.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of hands-on engineering experience with a thermal, airflow/fluids, or mechanical systems focus. Experience with thermal testing and airflow characterization is strongly preferred; a mechanical design background with strong test and analysis skills is also a great fit.
* Comfortable analyzing time-series test data and communicating findings clearly. Python is preferred, but other tools (R, MATLAB, spreadsheets, AI-assisted analysis) are acceptable.
* Experience writing or reviewing engineering requirements, test plans, or similar technical documentation.
* Familiarity with electromechanical components such as fans, blowers, heaters, valves, and sensors.
* BS in Mechanical, Thermal, Process, Chemical, or a related engineering field.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to present results to engineers across disciplines.
* Able to work independently on an owned area while collaborating closely with a small, fast-moving team.

**Nice to have**

* + Prior experience taking a product or process from prototype toward production.
  + Exposure to CFD or thermal simulation results and how to validate them against test data.
  + Startup or small-team experience with fast paced environments

*The estimated base salary range for this position is $1165 to $195, which does not include the value of benefits or a potential equity grant. A wide range of factors are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets, market conditions, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and business and organizational needs.*

We’re searching for a **Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure** to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes.

* Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation.
