jobs.title: Controls Engineer - Energy Solutions
jobs.description:
**Career Area:**

Engineering

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**About IDES:**

Caterpillar’s Integrated Drivetrain Energy Solutions (IDES) Division will focus on delivering advanced electrified power train, zero-emissions products/technologies, and the solutions and services associated with these technologies. Focus areas include batteries, fuel cells, motors, inverters, micro grid controllers, charging, energy storage systems, lifecycle solutions/services and integration of components for ePowertrain solutions across industries.

  

We are looking for top talent to build and scale the next generation of technologies, products and services to help our customers build a better—more sustainable—world. We need self-motivated, intelligent and team-oriented individuals to make our plans a reality. Individuals with high emotional intelligence, humility and openness to discovery will thrive in the teams we are building.

  

**Job Summary**

Join Caterpillar as a Controls Engineer supporting energy solutions products in Mossville, Illinois. In this role, you will develop, integrate, and validate control strategies for products such as charging solutions, battery energy storage systems, and site energy management controllers. You will apply MATLAB, Simulink, embedded C, and Python to solve technical problems, evaluate system performance, and help move controls technologies from concept toward product readiness. Depending on project priorities, your work may include controls development, system integration, performance analysis, test automation, or validation support. You will collaborate within an agile product group and learn from experienced engineers across controls, software, electrical systems, validation, and energy solutions. This is an opportunity for a flexible, curious engineer to contribute to innovative technologies that improve performance, reliability, and integration of tomorrow’s power and energy products.

**What You Will Do**

* Develop, integrate and validate control algorithms for charging products, battery energy storage systems, and site energy management controllers.
* Translate product and system requirements into control strategies, functional specifications, models, and testable engineering deliverables.
* Create, simulate, analyze, and implement control models using MATLAB, Simulink, embedded C, and Python, including automation and engineering data analysis.
* Plan and execute controls verification and validation at the model, software, controller, subsystem, and integrated-system levels.
* Analyze test results, troubleshoot unexpected system behavior, identify root causes, and recommend practical corrective actions.
* Support integration of controllers with batteries, power electronics, chargers, generators, inverters, sensors, communications networks, and other energy systems.
* Collaborate across controls, embedded software, electrical, systems, product, and validation teams while documenting technical decisions, test results, and conclusions.

**What You Will Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
* **Analytical Thinking:** Working knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
* **Effective Communications:** Working knowledge and understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
* **Managing Multiple Priorities:** Working knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.
* **Technical Excellence:** Working knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.

**What Will Set You Apart**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, with coursework or experience in controls, power electronics, embedded systems, energy systems, or dynamic-system modeling.
* Experience developing or validating control software for battery energy storage, charging, microgrid, site energy management, hybrid power, generator, inverters, DC-DC conversion or other technologies.
* Hands-on experience with MATLAB/Simulink, model-based controls development, embedded C, and/or Python.
* Familiarity with controls verification and validation methods such as MIL, SIL, PIL, or HIL, along with data analysis and root-cause troubleshooting.

Accountability spans the full development cycle from concept to production implementation onto BMS controller. The position will collaborate with a global teams to solve technical problems and deliver on project goals, continually learn to stay abreast of innovative technology, and mentor team members. All World is your one-stop shop solutions provider for aftermarket machine tool spare parts, services, repairs, and custom-engineered applications. jobs.title: Advisor, Automation Engineering
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
We are seeking an Indianapolis-based senior automation engineer to join the Automation Engineering team within Lilly's RNA Therapeutics group.
  
  
In this role, the successful candidate will do the core technical work of building, deploying, and supporting laboratory automation that advances pipeline-facing science, with a particular focus on in vitro pharmacology and chemistry workflows. Equally important is the partnership side of the role: working closely with scientific users to understand their needs, supporting the systems they depend on, and enabling teams to get the most out of automation. This is a builder's role for someone who wants to be close to the bench and the instruments, and who takes satisfaction in seeing their systems genuinely adopted.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a skilled automation engineer who independently identifies the key technical problems in a workflow and develops practical solutions to solve them. They take pride in delivering systems that are intuitive and dependable for users with varying levels of automation experience, so that automation measurably improves the efficiency of their work. They bring sound engineering judgment, a methodical approach to qualification and reproducibility, a teamwork-minded approach to user support, and an interest in how emerging tools, including LLM-based coding assistants, can speed up method development and deployment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Build, program, deploy, and maintain laboratory automation systems supporting in vitro pharmacology, chemistry, and related pipeline workflows
* Develop and validate automated methods, translating scientific protocols into robust, reproducible automated processes
* Partner directly with scientific users to gather requirements, understand their workflows, weigh practical tradeoffs, and deliver automation solutions that meet their needs
* Deploy and support automation systems tailored to specific pipeline processes and throughput needs
* Provide ongoing support for deployed systems, responding to user needs and keeping automation running reliably day to day
* Develop clear documentation, quick-reference guides, and ongoing support resources that help teams operate automated workflows independently
* Plan and deliver hands-on training to local end users on new instrumentation, automated methods, and protocols, tailoring instruction to varying levels of automation experience and ensuring users can operate systems confidently and independently
* Resolve hardware, software, and integration issues to keep systems running reliably
* Strengthen data reproducibility across automated processes through sound standards, controls, and qualification practices
* Integrate automation with scheduling and lab orchestration software and with ELN/LIMS platforms such as Benchling
* Apply LLM-based coding tools and agentic assistants to accelerate method development, scripting, and systems integration
* Contribute to the generation of large-scale, structured datasets suitable for AI/ML applications
* Build effective working relationships across scientific and engineering teams to ensure automation solutions fit real-world use

**Basic Qualifications:**  
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, biological sciences, or related field with 5+ years of hands-on laboratory automation experience.
  
  
**Additional Skills/Preferences:**  

* Hands-on expertise with the Hamilton automation ecosystem and a track record of building and deploying integrated automation across other platforms (e.g. acoustic dispensers (e.g., Echo), oligonucleotide synthesizers, robotic arms, Tecan instruments)
* Experience automating in vitro pharmacology and chemistry workflows.
* Strong method development and qualification skills, with a focus on reproducibility.
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with scientific users to gather requirements and support adoption.
* Experience with schedulers and end-to-end lab orchestration.
* Experience integrating automation with ELN/LIMS, such as Benchling.
* Experience with automated sample management systems.
* Proficiency in scripting or programming for automation.
* Experience using LLM-based coding tools or agentic assistants to accelerate method development, scripting, or systems integration.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to build durable working relationships with scientific users.

Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

jobs.description:

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, we know time is the most critical facet in the laboratory today: time to get life-saving therapies to patients faster; reclaiming time by automating tedious manual workflows; and saving time spent addressing erroneous or complex results.

We are partners in time and accelerate answers to critical questions through the power of automation. We develop innovations for scientists by scientists, with many of our 3,300+ global colleagues coming from the laboratory.

It’s all part of our time-tested approach to bringing meaningful innovations at the speed of life since 1935. And we’re just beginning. Working together, let’s put our time and talents together to advance human health for tomorrow.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The **Software Engineer II** is responsible for defining, implementing, and maintaining custom software products for medium and high throughput automated research systems. Together we'll be giving scientists around the world the tools to craft the next generation of medical treatments, improvements in agricultural crops, and other life science innovations. Work is performed in a team environment consisting of various engineering disciplines, project managers, and technicians.

This position reports to the Senior Manager, ASG Innovation and is part of the Access Solutions Group located in Indianapolis and will be an on-site role. The ASG delivers over 400 custom projects per year in a fast-paced, collaborative setting.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

  

* Develop and maintain device integrations for custom liquid handling robotic systems across multiple communication protocols (REST, gRPC, Serial, Web Sockets, SiLA)
* Work cross functionally with hardware, systems and application scientists to develop new product offerings
* Partner with scientists and lab automation engineers to diagnose and resolve integration issues across APIs, services, and third-party devices.
* Debug system behavior across hardware/software boundaries, including timing, communication, and scheduling interactions.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or related field
* 2+years of professional software development experience (0+ with a master’s degree)
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills
* Some experience in C#/.NET (Java experience also considered)

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

  

* WPF or desktop application development
* Containerization and Orchestration technology (e.g. Docker, Podman, Kubernetes)
* Troubleshooting network-related issues (latency, connectivity, DNS resolution)
* Hardware integrations or lab automation systems

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

  

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

**Job Title: Specialist, Systems Engineering**

**Job Code: 46185**  
**Job Location: Fort Wayne, IN**

**Job Schedule: 9/80**

**Job Description:**

L3Harris is seeking a system engineer to support development of a space-based Electro-Optical/Infrared (EO/IR) mission payload sensor system. This role will perform broad systems engineering functions in support of payload design, development, integration, verification, and test. Multiple positions are available, and candidates may bring different technical focus areas depending on program needs and individual experience. The selected candidates will join a multidisciplinary engineering team supporting a sophisticated EO/IR payload and will contribute to a range of systems engineering activities including data management, data analysis, algorithm development, requirements management and verification, model-based systems engineering (MBSE), and payload test support.

**Essential Functions:**

* Support systems engineering activities for a space-based EO/IR mission payload system across development, integration, verification, and test phases.
* Contribute to development, decomposition, allocation, and maintenance of system and subsystem requirements.
* Support requirements traceability, verification planning, and verification closure activities.
* Assist with development and maintenance of systems engineering artifacts such as specifications, interface documentation, verification matrices, technical plans, and trade study documentation.
* Perform technical analyses to support system design, performance evaluation, and mission compliance assessments.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including optics, focal plane, electronics, software, mechanical, thermal, integration and test, and mission operations engineering.
* Support technical issue resolution, risk identification, discrepancy tracking, and change impact assessments.
* Participate in system integration, test planning, test execution support, and post-test data review.
* Support program technical reviews and engineering lifecycle activities including SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and related working groups.
* Contribute to maintenance of the technical baseline through disciplined documentation and configuration management practices.
* Eligibility to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret security clearance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree with a minimum of 4 years prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree with a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years prior related experience.
* Experience in one or more systems engineering-related areas such as requirements, verification, analysis, integration and test, technical documentation, or model-based engineering.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

* Experience with space-based EO/IR systems, remote sensing payloads, electro-optical systems, or related aerospace hardware.
* Experience with requirements management tools such as DOORS, DOORS Next, Jama, or similar.
* Experience with MBSE tools such as Cameo, MagicDraw, Capella, or similar.
* Experience with engineering or test data analysis, including use of scripting or analytical tools.
* Experience supporting algorithm development, modeling, simulation, or sensor data processing.
* Experience with payload integration and test or system verification activities.
* Experience working with interface documentation, verification matrices, or technical baselines.
* Active security clearance.

**Electrical Engineer**

Whitestown, IN | 1st Shift | Full-Time

*Salary Range: $80,000-$110,000+(for the right candidate)*

**NOTICE:** This position is subject to U.S. Government security clearance. Due to federal government contracts and national security regulations, **candidates must be U.S. citizens** to be eligible for security clearance.

**About the Role**
------------------

Aerodyn Engineering is looking for an Electrical Engineer to own the electrical programming and controls for our turbo test cells. You'll program Siemens PLCs, design and troubleshoot PC-based data acquisition systems, and select the sensors and controls that let us deliver accurate, successful test results to aerospace and industrial customers.

For more information on Aerodyn Engineering, please visit www.aerodyn-global.com

**What We Offer**

* Quarterly Bonus Incentives
* Weekly Paychecks
* Industry-Competitive Wages
* Paid Time Off
* Designated Sick/Med Time Off
* 9 Paid Holidays
* Active Insurance Benefits Within Your First Month
* Wide Range of Medical Plans, including 100% employer-paid options
* 100% Employer-Paid Short-term Disability, Life, and AD&D Insurances
* Dental/Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Match
* Skill Development & Advancement Opportunities

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Program Siemens PLCs for fluid flow testing.
* Design, modify, and troubleshoot PC-based data acquisition systems.
* Select sensors and controls to meet each customer's test requirements.
* Test and calibrate test equipment during customer testing.
* Analyze test data and prepare test result documentation and reports.
* Maintain equipment records and perform required maintenance.
* Estimate costs for equipment repairs and improvements.

**What Makes You a Fit**
------------------------

* Electrical engineering degree or equivalent skill set.
* Hands-on PLC programming experience (Siemens is a plus).
* Experience with data acquisition, sensors, and instrumentation.
* Strong troubleshooter who enjoys solving problems at the test cell.
* Self-directed and comfortable working independently and as part of a team.

**What You'll Have**
--------------------

* Ownership of the controls and data systems behind our turbo test cells.
* Varied, technically challenging customer test programs.
* A hands-on test team of engineers and technicians to build with.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent skill set from an accredited program.
* Knowledge of PLC programming and applicable codes related to electrical/electronic engineering.
* Knowledge of design and calculation software.
* Must be self-directed and able to deliver under pressure, meeting customer and management deadlines.
* Must be a highly motivated self-starter comfortable operating independently and with a team.
* Must demonstrate ability to act professionally.
* Minimum travel required.

jobs.title: Lead Systems Engineer

Eaton’s IS AER MSD division is currently seeking a Lead Systems Engineer. This position will support research and new product development.

The Lead Systems Engineer is responsible for requirements management, system architecture development, and supporting system integration and test. The candidate will provide technical oversight and guidance to other SE engineers based in US and in Global Teams as well as serve as an individual contributor. The product and systems are thermal fluid and dynamic mechanical systems that support aerospace applications. These aerospace applications are diverse and include space life support and propulsion, aircraft oxygen and refueling, and weapons storage and release systems. The Lead Systems Engineer should be self-motivated to proactively learn about the technical domain of the given system and identify how and where the systems engineering discipline can create the highest value. Similarly, the candidate should have experience tailoring systems engineering practices to program scope and need. Finally, the candidate should work as a member and partner of the product team generating SE work products and providing technical guidance to incorporate systems engineering methodologies. Other critical skills include technical leadership, project execution, and team collaboration. This is a remote position, with a hybrid requirement for candidates located within 50 miles of Davenport, IA.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $97000 - $143000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Overview:**

The Software Engineer owns the development and implementation of assigned features and components within our enterprise eCommerce platform, delivering scalable, high-quality solutions that support a seamless and engaging user experience. This role collaborates closely with UX design, solutions architect, senior engineers and stakeholders to execute against established architectural standards, best practices, and delivery commitments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Full-Stack Engineering & Website Development**

* Design, develop, and modify company websites by owning assigned features and ensuring they meet functionality, performance, and quality expectations.
* Maintain and enhance website architecture by implementing solutions aligned with established architectural patterns.
* Develop server-side logic, manage database integrations, and ensure high performance and responsiveness to requests from the front end.
* Implement responsive design principles to ensure the website functions seamlessly across various devices and browsers.
* Integrate and manage content using content management systems (CMS), Digital Asset Management (DAM), Product Information Management (PIM), etc.
* Implement security measures to protect user data and prevent breaches, following established practices in alignment with security and compliance standards.
* Participate in peer code reviews to validate code changes for quality, maintainability, and adherence to best practices.

**Maintenance & Support**

* Regularly update and maintain the website to ensure it remains current, stable, and functional.
* Troubleshoot and resolve website issues while identifying root causes and preventing recurrence.
* Actively participate in change management practices in alignment with company policies.
* Provide technical support and knowledge sharing to internal stakeholders to support effective adoption of platform capabilities.

**SEO & Analytics**

* In cooperation with the analytics team, optimize the website for search engines (SEO) to improve visibility and traffic.
* In cooperation with the analytics team, implement and manage web analytics tools (e.g., Google Tag Manager) to support monitoring and analysis of website performance.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with IT, marketing, product, and other departments to translate business requirements into well-defined technical solutions.
* Collaborate with designers to develop and integrate visually appealing and intuitive interfaces that enhance user satisfaction and engagement.
* Collaborate with product owners, product managers, and content creators to ensure the website is updated with fresh, relevant content by providing reliable and intuitive tools that support efficient content updates.

**Team Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing**

* Collaborate effectively with other team members, providing peer mentorship and technical feedback.
* Foster continuous learning by contributing to coding standards and documenting new features, fixes, and technical discoveries.

**Agile Delivery**

* Participate in agile practices and ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Take ownership of sprint commitments and contribute to continuous improvement of team delivery practices.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure continuous delivery and integration.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 2+ years of experience delivering production-grade software in a team-based environment.
* Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including frameworks like React and Next.js, and libraries such as jQuery and TypeScript.
* Experience with PHP and Node.js.
* Experience with content management systems (CMS) like WordPress, Drupal, or Joomla.
* Experience with eCommerce platforms (such as Shopify or WooCommerce).
* Familiarity with SEO best practices and web analytics tools.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Certified Web Developer) are a plus.
* Experience with Agile or SAFe Agile methodologies.

At Holley, we’re more than a performance parts company—we’re a community of enthusiasts, innovators, and problem-solvers. We offer a competitive benefits package and a culture that values both performance and people.

Benefits:

* Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage starting day one.
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off and 9 paid holidays
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Company-paid life and short-term disability insurance
* Employee discounts on Holley Performance Brands products, events, and partnerships
* Education Assistance program

jobs.title: Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer**  
  
Join Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions practice as a Microsoft Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant). You will help clients design, deploy, and support scalable Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365 F&O) and Power Platform environments that advance finance and supply chain transformation. You will collaborate with client business and technology leaders to establish secure application lifecycle management, DevOps, integration, and operational practices across complex engagements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.  
  
Work you'll do  
  
As a Microsoft D365/Power Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant) on the Emerging ERP Solutions team, you will be responsible for:  
  
Design and govern environment topology, routing, capacity, deployment standards, Data Loss Prevention policies, and managed-environment settings across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Dataverse, model-driven apps, and Power Automate; lead transitions from Lifecycle Services (LCS) to Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) deployment models.  
  
Architect and maintain Git-based application lifecycle management (ALM) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Power Platform Build Tools, solution packaging, automated solution checker gates, release controls, and rollback procedures.  
  
Lead client workshops, architecture reviews, and stakeholder discussions; document environment and architecture decisions in decision logs and runbooks; present trade-offs involving cost, governance, and delivery speed.  
  
Manage Azure integration services, including Service Bus, API Management (APIM), Storage Accounts, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and Application Insights; monitor batch jobs, workflows, integrations, and application performance; investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.  
  
Manage technical delivery across concurrent client engagements, mentor team members, maintain reusable assets, and evaluate governance implications of emerging Power Platform capabilities, including Code Apps, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and Copilot Studio agents.  
  
Participate in on-call and after-hours support as required.  
  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  
  
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  
  
Effective written and verbal communication skills  
  
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  
  
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  
  
Ability to lead projects or workstreams  
  
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  
  
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  
  
Ability to meet deadlines  
  
Ability to provide clear guidance to others  
  
Qualifications Required:  
  
6+ years of experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) or Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management (F&SCM), and Power Platform.  
  
Experience using Azure DevOps or GitHub-based continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for Dataverse solutions and Git workflows, including branching, pull requests, and conflict resolution.  
  
Experience using Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC), environment groups, managed environments, and Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS)-to-PPAC deployment transitions.  
  
Experience designing Dataverse solution architecture, including managed and unmanaged solution layering and use of the Power Platform Center of Excellence Starter Kit or Application Lifecycle Management Accelerator.  
  
Experience using Azure Portal and at least two of the following Azure services: API Management, Service Bus, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Key Vault, or Azure Functions.  
  
Experience leading client workshops, architecture reviews, or steering committee presentations.  
  
Experience managing technical delivery across two or more concurrent client engagements.  
  
You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.  
  
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.  
  
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.  
  
Preferred:  
  
Microsoft certifications: PL-600 (Solution Architect), MB-700 (F&SCM Solution Architect), MB-800, or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer).  
  
AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-204 (Azure Developer) certification.  
  
Experience with Dataverse Git integration and Power Platform Build Tools.  
  
Experience with Copilot Studio agent governance and AI Builder.  
  
Experience with dual-write or integration architectures connecting Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management or Customer Engagement to external systems through Service Bus or API Management.  
  
Experience creating environment and ALM decision records, operational support documentation, or runbooks.

jobs.description:

10-30-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

**Job Summary**

The Electrical Engineer will support gas, coal, renewable, and new-generation self-build projects by defining electrical design-basis requirements and supporting the technical specification, engineering, procurement, integration, and commissioning of power generation electrical systems. A required focus of this role is advanced knowledge of utility-scale power plant electrical systems and equipment, including generators, generator step-up transformers (GSUs), medium- and low-voltage distribution systems, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), protective relaying, grounding systems, black-start systems, auxiliary power systems, and grid interconnection requirements.  
This role collaborates with Architect & Engineering (A/E) and Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) firms and coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure electrical designs meet performance, reliability, maintainability, constructability, safety, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements. The engineer will participate in RFx/OEM engagements, support self-build proposals, and provide construction, commissioning, startup, and lifecycle support across the generation portfolio.

**Job Description**

**What you’ll do:**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support development of electrical design-basis and equipment requirements (generators, transformers, switchgear, station service, UPS/DC, cabling).
* Assist with power system studies and data preparation (load flow, short‑circuit, protection coordination, arc‑flash, harmonics) under senior review.
* Review vendor drawings, technical bids, and RFx deliverables and prepare comments for senior engineers.
* Help prepare technical and procurement specifications and scope documents for proposals.
* Support OEM interfacing during procurement: submittal review, factory/field testing coordination, and lead‑time tracking.
* Provide construction and commissioning support: site inspections, cable/power testing, relay settings assistance, witness testing, and punch‑list follow‑up.
* Assist with protection relay settings, grounding design, cable routing, and MV/HV equipment testing.
* Ensure designs comply with relevant codes and standards (IEEE, NEC/NFPA70, ANSI, IEC) and assist with reliability/obsolescence tasks.
* Coordinate with mechanical, I&C, civil, and operations teams to resolve integration and SCADA/DCS interface items.
* Contribute to O&M documentation, spares lists, and lifecycle cost input.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Understanding of protection relays, CT/VT selection, relay coordination fundamentals.
* Basic skills in grounding, cable sizing, testing, and MV/HV equipment installation practices.
* Ability to interpret single‑line diagrams, schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical reports.
* Familiarity with power electronics for renewables and storage is a plus.
* Proficiency in MS Office; familiarity with scripting or databases is beneficial.
* Effective written and verbal communication for cross‑functional coordination.

**Working Conditions**

* Approximately 25% travel, including day trips and overnight stays (up to a week or more).
* Work in both indoor and outdoor environments with exposure to heat, cold, noise, dust, fumes, and operating machinery.
* Mandatory safety gear required at generating stations: hard hat, eye/hearing protection, steel-toed shoes with heels and non-slip soles.
* Adherence to site-specific safety requirements is mandatory.

**What we’re looking for:**

**Engineer Principal SG9**

*Education/Experience:*

* Has typically acquired 8 or more years of related engineering experience along with a Bachelor's degree in engineering in a program accredited by ABET\*;
* Or 6 years of related engineering experience along with a Master's or PhD in engineering from a program accredited by ABET\*.
* Registration as a Professional Engineer (PE) in any U.S. state or Puerto Rico\*\* is preferred for this position unless approval to waive this requirement is given by the organization's EVP.

* ABET - Engineering Accreditation Commission of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology.
* Individuals with a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering Technology can satisfy this degree requirement, if they obtain a certified Professional Engineering (PE) license.

*Acceptable alternative:*

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (non-ABET) plus a Master's degree or PhD in engineering from a university with an ABET accredited Bachelor's program.
* \*\* Confirmation is preferred to ensure the PE obtained in Puerto Rico aligns with NCEES standards.

\*\*\*VP or above may waive the requirement for a degree from a university with an Non ABET accredited program

*In addition:*

* Experience across gas, coal, and renewable projects; commissioning experience on simple/combined‑cycle plants.
* Experience with battery storage, inverters, or utility interconnection practices.
* Working knowledge of simple‑ and combined‑cycle plant electrical systems, generator synchronization, and MV/HV equipment.
* Familiarity with power system study tools and analysis methods.
* Experience reviewing vendor drawings and RFx responses.
* Proficiency with electrical design/analysis tools (ETAP, SKM/PowerTools, CYME, MATLAB, AutoCAD/MicroStation, or equivalent).

**Sr. Power Systems Engineer, P.E. - Baton Rouge, LA & Houston, TX**

10-15 Years Experience

NorthStar Energy Services is seeking an experienced **Senior Power Systems Engineer, P.E.** to join our Professional Engineering Consulting team. This role supports the design and execution of electrical systems for energy, petrochemical, industrial and data center industries. The Senior Power Systems Engineer will be responsible for developing electrical design concepts, performing advanced engineering analyses, and ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and client requirements across the full project lifecycle.

This position works closely with multidisciplinary engineering and design teams and plays a key role in delivering safe, reliable, and constructible power electrical designs for complex energy facilities.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

  

Xometry is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Core Platform team. This role is a strategic technical leadership position focused on the architectural evolution of our flagship enterprise partnership.

While our current plug-ins function as external add-ons, you will be responsible for re-architecting Xometry's core application services to live natively within our partner's digital ecosystem. You will shape the technical direction of multiple products, establishing the engineering patterns that allow Xometry's AI—trained on millions of parts—to operate directly on our partner's native 3D geometry. Your goal is to move the architectural framework toward a "target state" where users experience zero-latency DFM feedback and one-click procurement without ever leaving their primary enterprise design environment.

This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our North Bethesda, MD or Waltham, MA office location.

**How You'll Contribute**
-------------------------

* **Software Development and Technical Craft:** You will design high-performance solutions that extend beyond a single org, establishing the organizational standards for how Xometry-AI is embedded into external PLM environments. You will advance our architectural framework to ensure it is extensible, scalable, and adheres to strict enterprise SLIs/SLOs.
* **AI Fluency:** You will lead the effort to integrate production ML pipelines into the application layer, ensuring the "science fiction speed" promised in our vision is realized through optimized model serving and real-time geometry analysis. In addition, you'll champion AI-assisted development practices across the team, actively mentoring engineers on effective use of AI tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and reduce toil.
* **Problem Solving and Decision Making:** You will solve significant and unique challenges regarding data gravity and security. You'll create formal networks between our partner's and Xometry's engineering groups to develop new ways of conducting operations—specifically regarding "ring-fenced" data governance where part files remain securely within the partner's network infrastructure.
* **Scope and Impact:** You are responsible for establishing the strategic direction and leading the execution of this core integration. You will be a technical and business role model, ensuring that the integration of DFM (Manufacturability) and IQE (Pricing) AI engines creates a distinct, defensible edge for the partnership.
* **Collaboration and Communication:** You will facilitate technical discourse across the entire Xometry organization, leading to durable, well-documented decisions. As a primary point of contact for senior leadership, you will guide risk/reward conversations and champion cross-functional development across our marketplace and data science teams.
* **Operational Excellence:** You will define the reliability and security standards for our enterprise-grade deployments, whether partner-hosted or Xometry-hosted, ensuring seamless multi-tenant management.

**What You'll Bring to Xometry**
--------------------------------

* **Experience:** 12+ years of professional software development experience, with a history of scaling complex platforms.
* **Deep Technical Expertise:** Expert-level mastery of Python, AWS infrastructure, and modern frontend frameworks (React/NextJS) used for complex enterprise applications.
* **Systems Architect:** Proven experience shaping the technical direction of multiple teams and establishing engineering patterns as organizational standards.
* **Strategic Roadmap Execution:** A track record of securing endorsement for 6-12 month initiatives and driving them to successful production deployment.
* **Communication Excellence:** The ability to influence senior leadership and external partners on technical strategy and long-term technology investments.
* **Education:** Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

**You Would Be A Great Fit With**
---------------------------------

* **Platform Experience:** Background in building "Software as a Service" (SaaS) platforms or complex B2B integration hubs.
* **Industrial Tech Background:** Experience with manufacturing, logistics, or CAD/PLM software ecosystems.
* **Security & Governance:** Deep understanding of enterprise data controls, dedicated tenants, and SOC2/ISO compliance within a cloud environment.
* **Distributed Systems:** Experience architecting large-scale ML platforms or high-frequency marketplace engines.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $170,000 – $195,000annually + annual bonus, depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. The total compensation package includes base, bonus, and equity.

We also offer a competitive benefits package, including:

* 401(k) match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life and disability insurance
* Generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays
* Maternity and bonding leave
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and other wellbeing resources
* A stipend for catered lunch on Tuesdays and Thursdays

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer and participates in E-Verify.

#LI-Hybrid

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

jobs.title: Embedded Sustainment Firmware engineer
jobs.description:
**About Forterra**  
  
At Forterra, we are unleashing autonomy at scale to transform the battlefield. Our mission is to build the foundational platforms that enable an intelligent ecosystem to coordinate, adapt, and execute with speed and precision even in the uncertainty and disruption of modern conflict. In an era marked by rapid technological change and evolving threats, we design for flexibility, survivability, and operational dominance.

Forterra delivers weapons, sensors, and battlefield effects through integrated autonomous networks reaching operational areas faster, safer, and without placing human lives at risk. Our systems operate with distributed control, dynamic routing, and real-time responsiveness, enabling sustained advantage across complex mission environments.

**About the role**

We are looking for a product focused Embedded Software/Firmware Engineer to help sustain and develop next generation, cutting edge, safe, and scalable autonomous vehicle hardware. You will work at the intersection of embedded systems and autonomous technology, supporting existing projects, bringing up new hardware platforms, writing firmware for microcontrollers and microprocessors, and ensuring system functionality and safety through rigorous testing. You will closely collaborate with deployed product teams, hardware, systems, and other FW engineers to support and develop new cutting edge platforms for Forterra.

**What you'll do**

Work with new hardware:

* Assist in developing hardware/FW through the full product lifecycle from ideation through manufacturing and support.
* Aid in establishing production line tooling, as well as diagnostics capabilities for existing systems.
* Help evaluate new pre-release hardware and tooling for use on next generation systems.
* Review schematics and provide guidance and feedback on signal assignment and wiring.
* Quickly establish a working knowledge of new complete systems, microcontrollers, microprocessors, sensors, and tooling with a view toward product development.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers to understand system architecture, participate in design reviews, and debug issues.
* Perform and support new board testing and characterization with low-level firmware.
* Create proof-of-concept setups testing isolated functions of new hardware.
* Work with hardware engineers to provide FW functionality for production line testing.
* Provide guidance to other teams adopting the new hardware and tooling platform.

Develop FW and SW:

* Develop FW for different stages of the product lifecycle; prototype through production.
* Develop board bring-up FW to test signals, busses, and processors to prove wiring.
* Develop tools in Windows or Linux to show signal states, test boards, and support characterization.
* Develop FW and SW to allow boards to operate as designed in a pre-production environment.
* Implement drivers, bootloaders, and system-level software for initial board functionality.
* Assist to get production level FW loaded, working, and tested on new boards.
* Provide test FW to support product manufacturing and automated infant mortality reporting.
* Develop and deploy test FW and SW revisions to aid in diagnostics of embedded Linux systems.

Testing & Validation:

* Develop test plans to validate processor, memory, and communication interfaces (Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, UART, etc.) to support all phases of product development.
* Perform bring-up and debugging of embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debugging tools.
* Set up and execute final acceptance testing for hardware validation before deployment.
* Assist in developing manufacturing and production tests.
* Assist in debugging fielded issues and providing product improvements.

Collaboration & Documentation:

* Work closely with hardware, software, and systems engineers to ensure seamless integration.
* Document software architecture, test plans, and debugging procedures.
* Provide technical support for hardware and firmware during development and production.
* Implement best practices on documenting SW designs and committing code for other teams to use.
* Provide product documentation required to reach safety requirements, product manuals, test procedures, etc.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in embedded software development (Linux) and product development experience.
* 3+ years working with hardware test tools like Oscilloscopes, analyzers, and meters.
* Experience with ARM Cortex-M/R/A processors or similar embedded platforms.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems.
* Experience with bare metal programming and RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr).
* Some experience with Linux as a desktop or embedded in a device.
* Hands-on experience with board bring-up and low-level debugging.
* Knowledge of hardware communication protocols (Ethernet, CAN, I2C, SPI, UART).
* Familiarity with embedded development tools (JTAG debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers).
* Experience with TCP both on embedded platforms and larger systems.
* Experience reading schematics and integrated circuit data sheets.
* Time management and organizational skills.
* Troubleshooting and triage experience, ability to organize complex debugging scenarios.

* Experience in regulated environments.

jobs.description:
(ID: 2026-3890)

**Axle** is a bioscience and information technology company that offers advancements in translational research, biomedical informatics, and data science applications to research centers and healthcare organizations nationally and abroad. With experts in biomedical science, software engineering, and program management, we focus on developing and applying research tools and techniques to empower decision-making and accelerate research discoveries. We work with some of the top research organizations and facilities in the country including multiple institutes at the National Institutes of Health (NIH).

  

**Benefits We Offer:**

* 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage for Employees
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* 401K match up to 5%
* Educational Benefits for Career Growth
* Employee Referral Bonus
* Flexible Spending Accounts:
  + Healthcare (FSA)
  + Parking Reimbursement Account (PRK)
  + Dependent Care Assistant Program (DCAP)
  + Transportation Reimbursement Account (TRN)

**Position Overview**

  

The Laboratory Automation Engineer will program, integrate, and keep running the robots of the autonomous laboratory in Bethesda, starting with the BAB400, so that biological experiments run reliably without a person at the bench. The role builds the software layer that turns robot hardware into orchestrated, repeatable workflows, using the MADSci framework from Argonne National Laboratory. It also builds digital twins of the robots and workcells, used to plan, test, and validate protocols before they run on real hardware. The position combines hands-on robotics work in a biological lab with production-quality software development, and it works closely with IDSS data engineers, bioinformaticians, and the biologists who define the protocols.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Robot programming and control.** Program, calibrate, and maintain the BAB400 and other laboratory robots, including arms, liquid handlers, plate movers, and incubator and imaging interfaces.
* **MADSci integration.** Deploy MADSci modules, nodes, and workcell definitions so each robot and instrument can be commanded, monitored, and scheduled through a common interface. Contribute fixes and new modules back to the framework where appropriate.
* **Workflow development and scheduling.** Translate biological protocols (cell culture, iPSC maintenance, passaging, media exchange, imaging, sampling) into automated workflows with sequencing, timing, resource tracking, and recovery from failures.
* **Instrument and data integration.** Connect robot and instrument outputs to the data pipelines, LIMS, and metadata systems maintained by IDSS, so every run is logged, traceable, and reusable.
* **Validation and reliability.** Develop acceptance tests, error handling, logging, and monitoring. Troubleshoot hardware and software faults, and document root causes and fixes.
* **Safety and compliance.** Implement interlocks and safe-state behavior, and follow laboratory, biosafety, and NIH/HHS security requirements.
* **Tool evaluation.** Evaluate robots, drivers, simulators, and frameworks, and prepare short technical assessments for IDSS leadership.
* **Training and documentation.** Train laboratory staff to operate and recover the system, and write standard operating procedures and technical documentation.

  

**Required Qualifications**

The selection standard is demonstrated ability to get automated systems working. A degree in engineering, computer science, robotics, or a related science is common, but equivalent practical experience is fully acceptable.

* **Automation experience.** Several years of hands-on experience with laboratory robotics or comparable automation, such as robotic arms, liquid handlers, plate handlers, or workcells, including installing, programming, calibrating, and troubleshooting them.
* **Robot software.** Experience with the software that drives laboratory robots: vendor APIs and SDKs, device drivers, and orchestration or scheduling software.
* **Laboratory context.** Some experience with robotics in a biological laboratory (cell culture, molecular biology, or assay automation), and comfort working around biological materials under biosafety practices.
* **Programming.** Strong Python, including asynchronous or service-style code, REST APIs, and working with hardware or network protocols (serial, TCP/IP, OPC UA, or similar).
* **Software engineering practices.** Experience with Git, testing, and code review, and with Docker for deploying software next to hardware.
* **Protocol translation.** Ability to read a protocol, understand what the biology requires, and turn it into a reliable automated workflow.
* **Communication.** Strong communication skills and the ability to train laboratory staff.
* **Clearance.** Ability to obtain and maintain NIH/HHS security clearance and meet federal contractor suitability requirements.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience with MADSci, or with similar laboratory orchestration frameworks (for example PyLabRobot, Opentrons tooling, or ROS-based systems).
* Experience with simulation platforms such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MoveIt, or similar robot simulators.
* Experience with stem cell, iPSC, organoid, or tissue engineering laboratories.
* Experience with self-driving or autonomous laboratories, including closed-loop experiments driven by ML or optimization.
* Familiarity with ROS 2, robot kinematics, and computer vision for labware or sample detection.
* Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and message-based architectures (MQTT, Redis, or similar).
* Familiarity with LIMS, ELN, and metadata standards, and with FAIR data principles.
* Experience with imaging instruments and plate-based assays.
* Experience building or using simulation or digital-twin models of robotic systems, or a clear record of learning a new simulator quickly.

Job Description
  
  
The System Engineer 1 will analyze user's requirements, concept of operations documents, and high level system architectures to develop system requirements specificiations. Analyzes system requiremend leads design and development activities. Guides users in formulating requirements, advises alternative approaches, and conducts feasibility studies. Provides technical leadership for the integration of requirements, design, and technology. Incorporates new plans, designs and systems into ongoing operations. Develop technical documentation. Guides system development and implementation planning through assessment or preparation of system engineering management plans and system integration and test plans. Interacts with the Government regarding Systems Engineering technical considerations and for associated problems, issues or conflicts. Ultimate responsibility for the technical integrity of work performed and deliverables associated with the Systems Engineering area of responsibility. Communicates with other program personnel, government overseers, and senior executives.
  
,
  
Required Skills
  
  
The Level 1 System Engineer (SE) shall possess the following capabilities:
  
Manage system requirements and derived requirements to ensure the delivery of production systems that are compatible with the defined system architecture(s) – Department of Defense Architecture Framework (DoDAF), Service-oriented Architecture (SOA), etc
  
Contribute to the development of sections of systems engineering documentation such as System Engineering Plans, Initial Capabilities Documents, Requirements specifications, and Interface Control Documents
  
Assist with the development of system requirements, functional requirements, and allocation of the same to individual hardware, software, facility, and personnel components
  
Coordinate the resolution of action items from Configuration Control Board (CCB) meetings, design reviews, program reviews, and test reviews that require cross-discipline coordination
  
Participate in an Integrated Product Team to design new capabilities based upon evaluation of all necessary development and operational considerations
  
Allocate real-time process budgets and error budgets to systems and subsystem components
  
Generate alternative system concepts, physical architectures, and design solutions
  
Define the methods, processes, and evaluation criteria by which the systems, subsystems and work products are verified against their requirements in a written plan
  
Develop system design solution that satisfies the system requirements and fulfills the functional analysis
  
Review and provide input to program and contract work breakdown structure (WBS), work packages and the integrated master plan (IMP)
  
Participate in the development of system engineering documentation, such as System Engineering Plans, Initial Capabilities Documents, Requirements Specifications, and Interface Control Documents
  
Participate in interface definition, design, and changes to the configuration between affected groups and individuals throughout the life cycle
  
Derive from the system requirements an understanding of stakeholder needs, functions that may be logically inferred and implied as essential to system effectiveness
  
Derive lower-level requirements from higher-level allocated requirements that describe in detail the functions that a system component must fulfill, and ensure these requirements are complete, correct, unique, unambiguous, realizable, and verifiable
  
Participate in establishing and gaining approval of the definition of a system or component under development (requirements, designs, interfaces, test procedures, etc.) that provides a common reference point for hardware and software developers
  
Develop derived requirements for Information Assurance Services (Confidentiality, Integrity, Non repudiation, and Availability); Basic Information Assurance Mechanisms (e.g., Identification, Authentication, Access Control, Accountability); and Security Mechanism Technology (Passwords, cryptography, discretionary access control, mandatory access control, hashing, key management, etc.)

Baltimore, MD, US

Req ID: 42180

Date: Oct 23, 2026

The ASR Group® family of companies make up the world’s largest refiner and marketer of cane sugar. The companies produce a full line of grocery, industrial, foodservice and specialty sweetener products. Across North America, ASR Group® companies operate five sugar refineries, located in California, Maryland, Louisiana, Canada and Mexico. In Europe, ASR Group® companies operate sugar refineries in the United Kingdom, Portugal, and, with a joint venture partner, Italy. The companies also farm sugarcane and own sugar mills in Mexico and Belize. The ASR Group® portfolio includes the leading brands Domino®, C&H®, Florida Crystals®, Redpath®, Tate & Lyle®, Lyle's®, Sidul® and Whitworths®. ASR Group® companies also produce and market Tellus®, a single-use, compostable tableware and foodservice product made from plant fibers, including sugarcane.

  

**OVERVIEW**

The **Senior Electrical Engineer** serves as the site technical authority for electrical infrastructure and power distribution systems, including substations, transformers, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), motors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), generators, and associated electrical assets.

This position is responsible for developing and maintaining a multi-year electrical infrastructure roadmap, including asset lifecycle planning, equipment modernization, critical spare parts strategy, and identification of future capital needs. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer-Atlas
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

As seen at CES 2026, Atlas is the robot transforming the role of humanoid robots in our world. This is your chance to come and work on the cutting edge of robotics, and make a direct impact on how people will interact with humanoids now and in the future.

  

The Atlas Applications team is seeking a versatile full stack engineer to build and integrate the systems that make Atlas capable of complex tasks in dynamic environments.

  

In this role, you will work across every layer of our agentic autonomy stack – from third-party integrations and context engineering to observability frameworks and user interfaces.

  

You will partner closely with ML experts, behavior engineers, and product teams to develop Atlas' planning and reasoning system, and to integrate this system with the right tools, data, and prompts.

  

Candidates who thrive working across system boundaries and who are excited to advance the state of the art in robotics are encouraged to apply.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Work directly on Atlas' agentic capabilities, utilizing VLMs, tool calls, context engineering, and memory to build a flexible and performant task execution system.
* Develop, design, and establish conventions for the operator dashboards, task configuration UIs, and diagnostic interfaces to help users build and deploy Atlas applications.
* Leverage observability frameworks, structured logging, and tracing infrastructure to provide visibility into system behavior and performance.
* Develop and utilize evaluation and benchmarks to measure reasoning quality, safety, reliability, and generalization across tasks and environments.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with agentic systems, behavior, controls, perception, and product experts to ship end-to-end capabilities.
* Engage with customers and internal stakeholders to understand real-world use cases and ensure solutions are practical, reliable, and impactful.
Contribute to a strong engineering culture through code reviews, testing, documentation, and thoughtful system design.  

  

**Requirements**
----------------

* 2+ years of professional software engineering experience or masters degree in related field.
* Demonstrated ability to design and integrate APIs and third-party services in complex, multi-system environments.
* Knowledge of modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React), backend technologies (e.g., Python, TypeScript) and databases (e.g. Postgres, Redis).
* Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software architecture.
Comfort working in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you're expected to own problems end to end.  

  

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience building LLM products and/or agentic systems, including chat UIs, prompt engineering, context window management, or tool-use orchestration (e.g. coding agents, assistants).
* Experience working with robotics systems, vision models, or real-time data pipelines.
* Proficiency in TypeScript and/or Python with comfort operating across large codebases.
Familiarity with observability platforms (e.g. OpenTelemetry) and evaluation frameworks for AI systems.  

  

*We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.*

  

The base pay range for this position is between $120,000 to $145,000 annually. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors including, but not limited to internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience. This range represents a good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Boston Dynamics offers a generous Benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401(k), paid time off and an annual bonus structure. Additional details regarding these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer for employment.

**Hardware Engineer - Test System Development**
===============================================

Yazaki is a global leader in the research, development, and delivery of vehicle power and data solutions.

Today, we're looking for energetic people with the potential to perform and the ability to strengthen - and thrive in - the positive work environment we pride ourselves on.

***What we are looking for:***

This position is responsible for supporting the design, development, integration, and validation of automotive electronic hardware and automated test systems. The Hardware Engineer / Test System Development Engineer will apply knowledge of PCB design, automotive electronics, embedded systems, and software development using C/C++ and Python to develop and support test solutions for automotive products.

  

The role involves developing integrated hardware and software solutions to validate automotive products, including instrument clusters, body control modules, driver information displays, and intelligent power modules. The engineer will collaborate with product design, validation, and program management teams to develop test systems, automate testing, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure test solutions meet applicable customer and industry requirements. ***What you will bring to the table:***

jobs.title: Staff Vehicle Controls Engineer, Steering
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo's fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Hardware Engineering is an innovative and collaborative group of electrical, mechanical, reliability, software and vehicle engineers. We design, build, and perfect the products which are the eyes and ears of Waymo's autonomous driving technology, and integrate those products into vehicle platforms. We're seeking curious and talented teammates to keep us moving in the right direction.

This role follows a hybrid work schedule and you will report to a Vehicle Systems Architecture Lead.

**You will:**

* Own steering system requirements (EPS and steer-by-wire) for the Waymo Driver through their full lifecycle, covering steering tracking performance, redundancy and safe behavior under faults
* Drive steering architecture and fault-tolerance trade studies, such as dual-wound motors, dual ECUs and leader/follower arbitration, redundant sensing, power and communication, degraded-assist levels and thermal derating, to deliver fail-operational steering
* Define and review steering fault monitors and the self-driving system's response to each fault (detection thresholds, debounce, latching and minimal-risk maneuvers), partnering with Functional Safety on ISO 26262 (ASIL D) safety concepts
* Serve as the technical lead with steering suppliers and vehicle OEM partners: review specifications, firmware release content and CAN/CAN-FD interface definitions, and drive supplier defects to closure across sample phases
* Lead root-cause investigations of steering issues found in HIL, on the test track and in the fleet, analyzing vehicle logs and CAN traces and building Python tools that automate analysis of fleet data
* Define verification strategy and sign off steering for driverless operation, covering steering performance (latency, bandwidth, rack speed, tracking error, tire-limit behavior), thermal and endurance cases, and evidence from HIL, track and fleet testing

**You have:**

* 7+ years of experience developing and integrating safety-critical systems in the automotive, autonomous vehicle, aerospace, robotics, or related industries, with at least part of that time focused on steering systems
* Demonstrated ownership of system-level requirements, architecture or control strategy for an automotive steering system (EPS, steer-by-wire or rear-wheel steering) at an OEM, Tier 1 supplier or AV company
* Working knowledge of steering hardware and physics: rack, column and pinion EPS layouts, BLDC/PMSM motors and inverters, torque and angle sensing, rack force, and tire and vehicle dynamics basics
* Strong foundation in systems engineering principles such as requirements definition and traceability, verification and validation, and HIL or vehicle-level testing
* Proficiency in Python or MATLAB for data and log analysis, and the ability to read C/C++
* Bachelor's Degree in a relevant Engineering or a related field (including ME, EE, CS, Robotics, Controls, Aerospace, etc.) or equivalent practical experience

**We prefer:**

* Experience with redundant or fail-operational steering (dual-channel EPS or steer-by-wire), especially on L4 self-driving platforms
* Experience applying ISO 26262 to steering: ASIL D safety concepts, FMEA/FTA, and how a supplier implements microcontroller safety mechanisms (e.g., lockstep cores, built-in self-tests and runtime reset limits)
* Proven experience in technical supplier management, including authoring Statements of Work (SOW) or Requirement Specifications, leading technical design reviews, and managing firmware releases for safety-critical ECUs
* Hands-on experience with Vector CANoe/CANalyzer, dSPACE, and vehicle-dynamics tools such as CarSim or IPG CarMaker
* Experience working within standard automotive development and production release processes for ECUs and firmware, such as APQP, phase gates and A/B/C/D samples
* Proficiency in Korean or Japanese, to support technical reviews with partners

**Travel requirements:**

* Up to 8 weeks of travel; (domestic and international) to support requirement implementation with partners or verification at test sites

jobs.description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits.

**It's Time to Join Stryker!**
------------------------------

**Why Join Stryker?**
---------------------

Join Stryker's Mako Robotics team and help shape the future of robotic-assisted surgery!

As an Electrical Engineer, you will take ownership of electrical designs supporting Mako's robotic end effectors, contributing to the development, integration, testing, and improvement of sophisticated medical technology.

  

This is a hands-on opportunity to work across the electrical engineering lifecycle, from circuit design and hardware development to troubleshooting and system integration.

Working alongside a talented multidisciplinary engineering team, you will help develop reliable, innovative solutions that support surgical precision and improve patient outcomes.

If you enjoy building things, solving challenging technical problems, and seeing your designs come to life in real-world applications, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Design, develop, and support electrical components and subsystems for Mako robotic end effectors, taking ownership of assigned electrical designs throughout the development lifecycle.
* Translate product requirements into electrical engineering specifications, circuit designs, and technical solutions.
* Perform schematic design, PCB development, component selection, and electrical hardware integration activities.
* Build and evaluate prototypes, conduct bench testing, and validate electrical functionality and performance.
* Troubleshoot electrical hardware and system-level issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective solutions.
* Integrate electrical hardware with mechanical, software, and other system components to support reliable robotic system performance.
* Evaluate existing designs, identify opportunities for improvement, and support ongoing product development and engineering changes.
* Conduct electrical testing, verification activities, and technical investigations to ensure designs meet performance, safety, and quality requirements.
* Develop and maintain engineering documentation, including schematics, design specifications, test procedures, technical reports, and design history records.
* Collaborate with Systems, Mechanical, Software, Manufacturing, Quality, and other cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges and support successful product development.
* Apply engineering best practices, design controls, and risk management principles in accordance with applicable medical device regulations and quality system requirements.

**What You Need**
-----------------

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline is required.
* 2 or more years of professional engineering experience is required.

### **Preferred Qualifications (You do not need to have all of these)**

  

* Experience designing, developing, building, testing, and troubleshooting electrical hardware or subsystems.
* Experience with electrical schematic design, PCB development, and component selection.
* Proficiency with electrical design tools, with experience using Altium Designer preferred.
* Hands-on experience with electrical prototyping, bench testing, and laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies.
* Experience troubleshooting electrical circuits and resolving hardware integration or system-level issues.
* Understanding of electrical system integration and interactions between hardware, software, and mechanical components.
* Experience translating engineering requirements into electrical designs, test plans, and verification activities.
* Familiarity with electrical manufacturing processes, design for manufacturability, and hardware reliability considerations.
* Experience supporting electromechanical systems, robotics, or other complex integrated products.
* Experience working in a regulated industry, particularly medical devices, including familiarity with design controls, risk management, and technical documentation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on, collaborative approach to engineering challenges.
* Ability to independently manage technical assignments, communicate findings, and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

  

* $89,300 - $148,800 USD Annual

Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD&D insurance, and short-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.
