Gradian is an engineering-led, full-line thermal solutions partner serving data center and other mission-critical, commercial, and industrial markets. Headquartered in Maple Grove, MN, with additional facilities across North America, we design and manufacture liquid cooling systems, air handling equipment, heat rejection units, and modular, factory-assembled thermal management solutions.

Gradian was founded through the unification of four complementary, established brands: MAS HVAC, Daedex, DeepCoolAI, and EcoChillers. Together, we act as a single-source provider, deploying cooling technologies as scalable systems optimized for efficiency, spatial constraints, and overall performance. With a vertically integrated engineering and manufacturing model, we pair rapid design turnaround with precision fabrication, so customers can move faster on complex projects where reliability, timeline, and quality all matter.

**Why work here**

At Gradian, you'll work alongside others who get genuinely fired up by complex problems, see your work go from first sketch to job site in weeks, not years, and know that while we're developing the technologies critical for AI infrastructure to scale, our culture remains people-first by design.

It is core to our identity that we operate as one team — driving to win together, energizing others, and building lasting relationships that make the work fun and rewarding.

**Position Summary:**

The Senior Controls Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for designing, integrating, and programming advanced control systems for chillers, heat rejection equipment, and related products. This role requires deep expertise in control system architecture, hardware selection, and software programming, along with experience leading cross-functional teams. The Senior Controls Engineer will drive technical strategy, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and business functions to ensure successful execution of complex projects. The position bridges high-level strategy and hands-on implementation, ensuring innovative, reliable, and efficient control solutions for mission-critical environments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and integrate control systems for chillers and heat rejection equipment, including dry coolers, adiabatic coolers, cooling towers, and condensers.
* Develop control system architectures for new machines, including hardware selection (HMIs, sensors, VFDs, actuators, etc.) and software programming logic.
* Program control logic and sequences of operation (e.g., compressor staging, fan and pump speed control, free-cooling changeover, adiabatic/spray control, and lead-lag staging) to meet customer requirements, specifications, and standards.
* Conduct thorough testing of control systems on test benches, prototype chillers, or heat rejection units to identify and resolve issues including troubleshooting and debugging.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including R&D, product development, sales, and customer support, to deliver effective control solutions.
* Develop and maintain detailed engineering documentation, including control system drawings, wiring diagrams, and system specifications.
* Ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and in accordance with customer specifications.
* Maintain and improve internal processes to enhance product quality and efficiency.
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies, incorporating them into product designs.

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

Required:

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in control systems engineering, preferably with OEM products.
* Demonstrated expertise in designing and developing detailed electrical schematics using industry-standard software such as AutoCAD and Visio.
* Proven ability to develop and implement control algorithms for PC, PLC, and HMI platforms using vendor-specific software and in compliance with industry standards.
* Experience with control communication protocols, including Modbus TCP/RTU, BACnet, and Ethernet/IP.
* Demonstrated capability to perform three phase power and arc flash calculations, determining SCCR and componentry for 480VAC enclosures, power transformers, panelboards and switchgear.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to resolve complex system issues.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams and customers.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and prioritize tasks effectively.

Preferred:

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Familiarity with chiller and heat rejection controls, data center applications, electrical codes, and safety standards.
* Background knowledge with Distech control systems.

**Key Competencies:**

* Strong analytical and technical skills.
* Ability to manage complex projects and meet deadlines.
* Collaborative mindset with cross-functional teams.
* Innovative approach to solving chiller and heat rejection challenges.
* Strategic leadership and mentorship abilities.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**NEUTRON**

Neutron is a medium lift launch vehicle capable of delivering the mega constellations of tomorrow, high assurance payloads, and human spaceflight. As a highly reusable launch platform, Neutron will deliver a highly cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab's proven execution history with the Electron program.

**GROUND SYSTEMS ENGINEER II**

Based out of Rocket Lab's Test Facility at Stennis Space Center in Mississippi, the Ground Systems Engineer II is responsible for Design, Build, and Maintenance of critical test facilities to support the Archimedes rocket engine and the Neutron launch vehicles. You'll collaborate closely with Engine Propulsion and Test Operations teams to develop requirements for test stand design.

Your work will require technical discipline and expertise in mechanical design and build but will also require a strong understanding of instrumentation and test site operations. You will be responsible for maintaining and upgrading critical test facilities to meet the needs of the Archimedes engine test program. You may be asked to directly support Engine hardware and Engine test operations. You will become skilled in Ground Systems engineering and be expected to work independently in support of the overall test facility design, build, activation, and engine test efforts.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO**

* Design, build, and integrate critical test systems to support all test objectives and requirements
* Work with a team of technicians and engineers to perform troubleshooting to resolve facility and test operations issues
* Develop maintenance protocols for new and existing facility infrastructure
* Collaborate with Archimedes engine and Neutron vehicle design teams to prepare and perform tests on key engine and stage hardware
* Work hand in hand with the test operators to complete design, build, installation and checkout of facility systems
* This includes helping maintain cleanliness and integrity of systems, ensure component level verifications are performed, and ensuring internal standards are met

jobs.description:
**Senior Electrical Engineer | Kansas City, MO**

*100% Employee-Owned · Big-firm resources, local-team relationships, ONE IMEG culture*

  

IMEG is hiring a Senior Electrical Engineer in Kansas City, MO. This role leads electrical design efforts and project delivery for moderate to complex building projects, with opportunities to contribute through either a Technical Path or a Project Management Path.

  

You will work with engineers, consultants, clients, and cross-functional teams to support project goals, budgets, mentoring, and client expectations. The work supports healthcare and MEP markets, including complex, technology-rich healthcare and institutional environments, while advancing high-performance, energy-efficient design aligned with MEP2050 and AIA2030.

  

**At a Glance**

**Location:** Kansas City, MO
  
**Discipline:** Electrical
  
**Markets:** Healthcare; MEP
  
**Ownership:** 100% employee-owned (ESOP)
  
**Travel:** Up to 20%
  
**Work Schedule:** Full-time hybrid
  
**Sponsorship:** Not available

  

**What You'll Do**

  

**Technical Path**

* Lead electrical-system analysis and design efforts, using engineering software and tools to develop designs, specifications, and calculations that meet code requirements and IMEG standards.

* Perform site assessments and prepare detailed analysis and technical reports.

* Work with clients to understand needs, gather project requirements, communicate technical information, and build client relationships.

* Conduct in-process reviews of electrical system designs, calculations, specifications, and project correspondence.

* Implement IMEG quality control processes to meet IMEG, industry, and client requirements.

* Train, mentor, and motivate staff.

* Provide technical assistance to resolve field issues with limited support from senior staff.

* Stay current on electrical-engineering trends, emerging technologies, and best practices, and contribute to research, development, and innovation efforts.

* Prioritize safety and identify and mitigate potential safety risks associated with electrical systems.

* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver integrated solutions and participate in project interviews and presentations.

**OR**

**Project Management Path**

* Coordinate, oversee, and manage projects of varying size and complexity.

* Assist Project Executives and Client Executives with design scopes of work, fee calculations for proposals, and contract reviews.

* Create project schedules with milestone and deadline targets.

* Serve as the point of contact for teams and clients.

* Create monthly billings, submit financial information to Accounting, and update billing projections and estimated completion percentages monthly.

* Ensure designs meet owner, IMEG, and code requirements, milestone deliverables are achieved, quality-control processes are completed, and construction technical support occurs in a timely manner.

* Coordinate design staff and project scheduling through all design and construction phases, and schedule and lead progress meetings with documentation.

* Conduct construction site visits and provide documentation as needed or requested.

* Respond to and resolve client / construction concerns, and manage change orders and obtain appropriate approvals.

* Train, mentor, and motivate staff.

* Build, maintain, and develop client relationships.

  

**What You'll Bring**

Candidates may qualify through either the Technical Path or Project Management Path below.

  

**Technical Path**

**Required Skills and Abilities**

* Adept in the technical aspects of one’s discipline; advanced proficiency in technical and analytical skills including proficiency of principles of circuit theory, electromagnetism, power systems, and electronics as they relate to electrical systems

**Project Management Path**

**Required Skills and Abilities**

* Demonstrated leadership traits in the Project Management career path

  

**Required for Both Paths**

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor of Science (BS) Degree in Electrical Engineering, or equivalent, required

* Professional Engineer (PE) License required

* 7 years of experience minimum required, 8 preferred, in the building design consulting industry

**Skills and Abilities**

* Knowledge of Illumination Engineering Society (IES) Standards and reference material resources such as NFPA Link, TechStreet, MadCAD, and Facility Guideline Institution (FGI)

* Advanced proficiency of Master Specification editing and software such as eSPECS; Proficient with Adobe or Bluebeam Revu

* Ability to mentor, train, motivate, and lead others

* Ability to perform final quality control check in their area of expertise

* Ability to sell work and develop client relationships

* Strong training and mentoring skills

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; Ability to clearly communicate in both oral and written communication to individuals or groups

* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

* Attention to detail and problem-solving skills

* Proficient with MS Office Suite including but not limited to Word, Excel, and Outlook

* Ability to travel up to 20% with occasional overnight stays

  

**About the Team**

* Service mix is strongly healthcare-oriented, with meaningful education, civic, and cultural work. The team repeatedly appears on full-scope MEP projects with fire protection, telecom, security, and AV elements, supporting complex, technology-rich healthcare and institutional environments.

* Recent work includes SRHC MRI Addition, Healthcare; Saint Luke's South 3rd Floor Patient Rooms, Healthcare; and Med Plaza 1 /Kansas City / Electrical Upgrades, Healthcare.

We put people at the center of who we are, creating positive outcomes for people, communities, and our planet.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer / Electrical Designer
jobs.description:
Are you ready to get hands-on and help shape the future of building systems? Solutions AEC is a Design/Build-focused Engineering, Commissioning, and Consulting firm seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer who is passionate about advancing the built environment. We’re looking for someone who is eager to learn, solve real-world challenges, and grow alongside an experienced team.

At Solutions AEC, we combine strong engineering fundamentals with innovative thinking, emerging technology, and a commitment to continuous improvement. We’re embracing AI and emerging digital tools to help our teams work smarter, improve processes, solve problems, and deliver greater value to our clients, while keeping sound engineering judgment at the center of our work.

**What You'll Do:**

*Technical Leadership & Project Delivery*

* Lead the planning, design, coordination, and production of complete electrical construction documents for a variety of project types.
* Design and develop power distribution, lighting, and electrical systems that support safe, efficient, and innovative facilities.
* Prepare engineering calculations, one-line diagrams, equipment schedules, specifications, and technical documentation.
* Ensure construction documents meet applicable codes, standards, and client requirements.
* Conduct field investigations, site surveys, and existing condition assessments to support renovation and retrofit projects.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop practical and cost-effective design solutions.

*Mentorship & Team Development*

* Provide technical guidance and support to engineers and designers across the department.
* Review design documents and provide constructive feedback to improve technical quality and consistency.
* Delegate work appropriately while fostering growth and development within project teams.
* Serve as a mentor who promotes continuous learning, accountability, and professional excellence.

*Innovation & Continuous Improvement*

* Utilize Revit and other engineering technologies to create efficient and accurate design solutions.

* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, design standards, and project delivery processes.
* Contribute to the enhancement of company tools, templates, and best practices.

*Construction & Client Support*

* Support projects through bidding and construction phases, including contractor coordination, submittal reviews, and field observations.
* Assist project teams with cost considerations, equipment procurement support, and design-build coordination.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, contractors, and project stakeholders.

**What You Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering with 8+ years of experience in building systems design **-or-** 12+ years of electrical design experience within the built environment
* Experience designing electrical power distribution systems
* Experience with creating one-line diagrams and distribution equipment layouts
* Power device layout and coordination, including receptacles, disconnect switches, junction boxes, and related equipment
* Lighting design, control systems, fixture schedules, and energy code compliance
* Electrical calculations, including:

* Load calculations
* Voltage drop analysis
* Fault current calculations
* Arc-flash studies

* Professional Engineer (PE) license or RCDD certification is highly valued
* Working knowledge of:

* NEC
* IBC
* NFPA standards
* IES recommended practices
* Other applicable building and energy codes

* Experience with low-voltage systems including telecommunications, fire alarm, security, and access control systems
* Proficiency with Revit, AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, and related engineering software
* Curiosity about AI, automation, and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and thoughtfully apply new tools to engineering workflows.
* Design-build project experience is a plus
* Strong leadership, mentoring, and delegation abilities
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong organizational and time-management capabilities
* Proven problem-solving and critical-thinking skills
* Ability to thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented environment
* Authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship for at least three years

**Why Solutions AEC?**

At Solutions AEC, we’re not just designing projects. We’re building relationships and delivering excellence. Our core values, **Do What It Takes, Get Better Every Day, Have Fun, Serve One Another, and Thoughtful Stewards** guide everything we do.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary and standout benefits package.

* 100% company-paid health insurance premiums for employees.
* 401(k) with company contributions.
* Generous vacation and PTO, plus a four-week paid sabbatical every five years.
* Flexible work schedule to support work-life balance.

jobs.title: Sr. Automation/Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
It's exciting to work for a company that makes the world measurably better.

We're committed to bringing safety, quality, and customer focus to the business of advanced ceramics manufacturing.

**Job Title**

Sr. Automation/Controls EngineerAs the Sr Automation/Controls Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical expert in industrial automation and controls and executes against the function’s manufacturing and engineering strategy. You will be responsible for understanding, defining, implementing, and supporting automation and controls systems across manufacturing operations. Responsibilities include identifying process and equipment improvements, performing technical and cost-benefit analyses, developing equipment and controls specifications, evaluating equipment suppliers and system integrators, supporting project proposals, and leading equipment installation, programming, integration, commissioning, and technology transfer activities.  
  
You will also be accountable for improving manufacturing capability, yield, productivity, reliability, safety, and equipment effectiveness through development and application of automation technologies. You will support development and standardization of automation architectures, controls practices, and manufacturing data connectivity that can be effectively maintained and deployed across multiple manufacturing sites.

**Role & Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a senior engineering subject matter expert in industrial automation, controls, and related manufacturing technologies.
* Provide hands-on engineering support for the design, programming, integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of automated manufacturing equipment.
* Lead complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis involving PLCs, HMIs, electrical controls, instrumentation, motion systems, networks, sensors, and associated manufacturing equipment.
* Develop and maintain PLC and HMI programming standards, controls specifications, electrical/control system documentation, program backups, version control practices, and other automation standards to improve equipment maintainability and consistency.
* Design, program, commission, and troubleshoot Rockwell Automation control systems, including ControlLogix/CompactLogix and FactoryTalk platforms. Support legacy PLC platforms where required.
* Apply industrial networking and communication technologies such as EtherNet/IP and other applicable industrial communication protocols to connect machines, controls, and manufacturing systems.
* Support machine data collection and integration between automation systems and higher-level manufacturing, historian, database, or MES systems where applicable.
* Apply appropriate OT cybersecurity principles when designing, modifying, connecting, and remotely supporting industrial control systems.
* Specify, integrate, and troubleshoot automation technologies such as VFDs, servo/motion control, sensors, instrumentation, machine vision, robotics, and automated material handling where applicable.
* Apply machine safety principles, including safety circuits, interlocks, guarding interfaces, safety PLCs, and risk-reduction requirements in equipment design and modification.
* Review and develop electrical schematics, control panel designs, I/O requirements, P&IDs, and equipment interface requirements.
* Serve as a key technical interface with machine manufacturers, automation suppliers, system integrators, and other external engineering resources.
* Develop equipment and automation specifications and participate in supplier selection, design reviews, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), installation, startup, and commissioning.
* Execute capital equipment projects and technology transfers to meet manufacturing requirements, including training and technical support for plant engineering, maintenance, and manufacturing personnel.
* Collaborate with manufacturing, maintenance, engineering, quality, EHS, IT/OT, and business leadership to improve equipment performance, reliability, process capability, and productivity.
* Develop technical and business justification for automation and process improvement projects, including cost-benefit and risk analysis.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and replicate successful automation technologies and equipment solutions across manufacturing operations.
* Maintain awareness of developments in industrial automation, controls, robotics, machine vision, manufacturing data systems, and related technologies and help evaluate their application within the company.
* Prepare technical analyses, project updates, recommendations, and presentations for engineering, plant, and executive leadership.

**Job Requirements**

**Required Education & Experience:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum of 5 years of controls, automation, or manufacturing engineering experience, with significant hands-on responsibility for industrial automation systems.

**Required Experience and Skills:**

  

* Demonstrated experience designing, programming, commissioning, troubleshooting, and improving PLC/HMI-based manufacturing equipment.
* Strong experience with Rockwell Automation platforms, including Studio 5000/ControlLogix and FactoryTalk, or equivalent industrial control platforms.
* Experience commissioning automated equipment for small and large capital projects.
* Strong understanding of industrial electrical controls, electrical schematics, instrumentation, sensors, motors, VFDs, and related automation hardware.
* Experience with industrial communication networks and protocols used to connect PLCs, HMIs, drives, instrumentation, and manufacturing systems.
* Working knowledge of machine safety principles and applicable electrical/control standards, including relevant NEC, NFPA, NEMA, ISA, IEC, and IEEE requirements.

jobs.title: Mid Software Engineer - Survivable Airborne Operations
jobs.description:
Join a team building secure, automated recovery capabilities that will enable future mission-critical systems to recover quickly and operate with confidence when it matters most. We are looking for motivated engineers, hands-on problem solvers, and proactive go-getters who take ownership and enjoy moving complex solutions from concept through integration and demonstration.

Put your software engineering skills to work on a mission that matters. DS2 is seeking a driven Software Engineer to help build secure, automated recovery capabilities that protect mission-critical systems and enable rapid restoration when our nation's operators need them most. You will develop containerized applications and APIs, deploy solutions with Kubernetes, and integrate software with COTS/GOTS technologies, storage systems, infrastructure, and physical devices. This is an opportunity to take ideas from prototype to working capability while collaborating with engineers, mission partners, and customers. The position offers a hybrid mix of virtual and in-person work, with preference for candidates who can travel to the Boston, Massachusetts area for lab integration, hardware testing, and demonstrations.

**Who is DS2?**

DS2 provides full life-cycle software engineering services to DoW, federal, and commercial clients. We are committed to teamwork, a clear focus on the customer, and a belief that hiring talented individuals is essential to achieving our vision of being "Engineered to Exceed Expectations".

Every day, DS2 engineers meet our client's needs through problem-solving, teamwork, and technology-driven solutions. You can expect to work with a team of committed engineers that lives our core values in an environment where working hard is important and playing hard is just as important.

**Please Note:** You must be a U.S. Citizen and able to complete a U.S. government background investigation.

**Responsibilities — What you'll do:**

  

* Develop secure software and automation that enable rapid restoration and trusted full-system reconstitution
* Develop infrastructure as code, policy as code, and recovery playbooks that make recovery operations repeatable and reliable
* Design APIs and automated workflows that support integration with mission platforms, and lab environments
* Containerize, deploy, and demonstrate capabilities on representative hardware and integrated test environments
* Evaluate emerging technologies and rapidly prototype solutions that improve mission resilience and recovery outcomes
* Turn concepts into working prototypes through research, experimentation, and iterative development

  

**Required Qualifications — We need someone who:**

  

* Has a bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar technical field and 10+ years of experience
* Has a U.S. Citizenship (required for federal contract work and eligibility for security vetting)
* Has hands-on software development experience using Python, Go, C#, Java, or a comparable language
* Has proven experience with one or more of the following: API development, containerized applications, infrastructure as code, policy as code, or automation frameworks
* Uses strong organizational skills and personal initiative to prioritize work against project milestones
* Effectively collaborates and communicates with distributed teams and can present technical solutions to customers and stakeholders

  

**Preferred Qualifications — Bonus points if you:**

  

* Have specific experience developing maintainable backend services
* Have implemented containers, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, or policy-controlled automation
* Have developed backup, restoration, system deployment, configuration, or operational playbooks
* Demonstrate an understanding of authentication, RBAC, secure API design, and software supply-chain practices
* Have experience supporting defense, federal, mission-critical, or regulated systems
* Hold relevant cloud, DevOps, Agile, cybersecurity, or software-development certifications
* Have experience integrating COTS/GOTS Hardware/Software solutions for DoW efforts

**Benefits — What we do for you:**

  

* Flexible work hours and hybrid work options
* Health, dental, and vision insurance, including paid STD, LTD, and AD&D
* Start with 15 paid time off (PTO) days and 11 holidays
* 401K savings plan with company-matching
* Educational and growth opportunities
  + Tuition reimbursement
  + Student loan repayment
  + Certification reimbursement + bonuses and Learning Platform Subscriptions
  + Catered tech talk lunches on topics picked by you and your teammates
* Sponsored community and volunteer events, giving back to our community
* Monthly office social events; game night, cook outs and office parties

  

**Standard HR Disclaimer:**

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status or any other status protected by federal, state or local laws. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

jobs.description:
We're ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. **Job Title: Lead Electrical Hardware Engineer (LMES)**

**Job Code: 46521**

**Job Location:** **Camden, NJ (on-site)**

**Schedule: 9/80 Regular (every other Friday off)**

**Job Description:**

This role requires a deep understanding of advanced digital design principles, signal integrity, and high-speed data transmission. As a Lead Electrical Engineer (EE), you will be a crucial member of our engineering team, responsible for the end-to-end design and development of high-speed digital electronic modules and circuit boards. Your responsibilities will include reviewing and deriving hardware requirements, developing design concepts that meet these requirements, and performing detailed electrical design of circuitry. This may encompass microprocessors, program and data memories, FPGAs, voltage regulators, power reset sequencers, analog circuitry, and interface transceiver circuits.

You will capture designs as schematic diagrams using our CAD tools, participate in design reviews, and collaborate with our ECAD department for layout and routing on printed wiring boards (PWBs). Once the PWB is fabricated and populated with components by our on-campus assembly facility, you will test and verify the electronics assembly, and support firmware and software integration. Our rigorous design review and documentation process includes the creation of requirements specifications, design documents, and comprehensive test plans and procedures.

**Essential Functions:**

  

* Lead the design and development of high-speed digital Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs) from concept through production.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware, software, and systems engineering to ensure cohesive product development.
* Perform signal integrity analysis and simulations to optimize high-speed data paths.
* Develop and review detailed schematics, layout designs, and documentation.
* Conduct design reviews and provide technical guidance to junior engineers.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex design issues.
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in high-speed digital design technologies.
* Minimal travel required.

**Qualifications:**

  

* BSEE with minimum of 10 years of professional experience specializing in high-speed digital CCA board design.
* Proven track record of successful high-speed digital design projects.
* Proficient in debugging and testing high-speed digital circuits using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other test equipment.
* Extensive experience with schematic capture and (Printed Circuit Board) PCB layout for high-speed digital circuits.
* Experience with standard CAD tools, Mentor Graphics Xpedition preferred.
* Basic programming skills in languages such as Python, C, or MATLAB for test automation and data analysis a plus
* Understanding of standard electronic interfaces, such as 2C, USB, RS-232, Ethernet, SATA, PCIe.
* U.S. Citizenship required.
* Must have a U.S. Government Secret security clearance.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

  

* MSEE preferred
* Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills with the ability to quickly isolate and resolve issues.
* Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, to collaborate with cross-functional teams and provide status updates.
* Ability to work well in a team environment and contribute to collaborative projects.
* Strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy and quality in design and testing.
* Ability to manage time effectively and prioritize tasks to meet project deadlines.

In compliance with pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $93,341 - $190,188. This is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as final offer amount may vary based on factors including but not limited to experience and geographic location. L3Harris also offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, EAP, education assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays. **Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer**  
  
Join Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions practice as a Microsoft Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant). You will help clients design, deploy, and support scalable Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365 F&O) and Power Platform environments that advance finance and supply chain transformation. You will collaborate with client business and technology leaders to establish secure application lifecycle management, DevOps, integration, and operational practices across complex engagements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.  
  
Work you'll do  
  
As a Microsoft D365/Power Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant) on the Emerging ERP Solutions team, you will be responsible for:  
  
Design and govern environment topology, routing, capacity, deployment standards, Data Loss Prevention policies, and managed-environment settings across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Dataverse, model-driven apps, and Power Automate; lead transitions from Lifecycle Services (LCS) to Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) deployment models.  
  
Architect and maintain Git-based application lifecycle management (ALM) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Power Platform Build Tools, solution packaging, automated solution checker gates, release controls, and rollback procedures.  
  
Lead client workshops, architecture reviews, and stakeholder discussions; document environment and architecture decisions in decision logs and runbooks; present trade-offs involving cost, governance, and delivery speed.  
  
Manage Azure integration services, including Service Bus, API Management (APIM), Storage Accounts, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and Application Insights; monitor batch jobs, workflows, integrations, and application performance; investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.  
  
Manage technical delivery across concurrent client engagements, mentor team members, maintain reusable assets, and evaluate governance implications of emerging Power Platform capabilities, including Code Apps, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and Copilot Studio agents.  
  
Participate in on-call and after-hours support as required.  
  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  
  
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  
  
Effective written and verbal communication skills  
  
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  
  
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  
  
Ability to lead projects or workstreams  
  
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  
  
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  
  
Ability to meet deadlines

6+ years of experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) or Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management (F&SCM), and Power Platform.  
  
Experience using Azure DevOps or GitHub-based continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for Dataverse solutions and Git workflows, including branching, pull requests, and conflict resolution.  
  
Experience using Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC), environment groups, managed environments, and Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS)-to-PPAC deployment transitions.  
  
Experience designing Dataverse solution architecture, including managed and unmanaged solution layering and use of the Power Platform Center of Excellence Starter Kit or Application Lifecycle Management Accelerator.  
  
Experience using Azure Portal and at least two of the following Azure services: API Management, Service Bus, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Key Vault, or Azure Functions.  
  
Experience leading client workshops, architecture reviews, or steering committee presentations.  
  
Experience managing technical delivery across two or more concurrent client engagements.  
  
You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.  
  
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.  
  
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.  
  
Preferred:  
  
Microsoft certifications: PL-600 (Solution Architect), MB-700 (F&SCM Solution Architect), MB-800, or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer).  
  
AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-204 (Azure Developer) certification.  
  
Experience with Dataverse Git integration and Power Platform Build Tools.  
  
Experience with Copilot Studio agent governance and AI Builder.  
  
Experience with dual-write or integration architectures connecting Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management or Customer Engagement to external systems through Service Bus or API Management.  
  
Experience creating environment and ALM decision records, operational support documentation, or runbooks.

Our teams design and deliver advanced mission systems, avionics, and secure technologies that provide unmatched performance and resilience for the U.S. Navy and allied forces. By integrating cutting-edge capabilities, we ensure our naval aviation platforms remain reliable, effective, and ready.

In this senior technical role, you will define the architectural vision, establish engineering best practices across multiple programs, guide cross-functional technical teams, and directly influence future product roadmaps and customer technology strategies. You will act as the primary technical interface between software engineering, program leadership, chief engineers, and defense stakeholders.

This role is onsite in Owego, NY.

Our work spans mission systems, avionics, integration, and program execution giving you the opportunity to contribute to technology that matters.

An architectural and techincal authority that:

Has served as the designated software technical authority across major programs, establishing architectural frameworks, interface standards, and open architecture strategies (e.g., SOSA, FACE, OMS) that scale across product lines. Has supported design and code review, as appropriate.

Has provided strategic technical direction to lead engineers and multi-disciplinary software teams across the entire lifecycle -from concept formulation through deployment and sustainment. Has led software teams to ensure consistency and maximize commonality of software across programs.

jobs.title: Actuator Systems Engineer, Fauna
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Every motion our robots make starts with an actuator, and we’re looking for an Actuator Systems Engineer to help us build better ones. This role is for someone who enjoys the full loop: building a model of how a motor or transmission should behave, rigorously testing this around other industry standards, and then iterating on the hardware or firmware until the desired specification is met.
  
  
You’ll work across electrical, mechanical, and firmware design, and you’ll own actuator performance from the bench all the way to robots running in people’s homes. The things you learn and build will directly shape how safe, reliable, efficient, quiet, and strong our robots are.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Plan and run characterization testing on our actuators, covering things like torque constant, friction, efficiency, thermal behavior, and wear over time, and turn those results into models and specs the rest of the team can rely on

  

* Build and maintain electromechanical and thermal models of our actuators that help us predict robot performance, set safe operating limits, and support the controls and simulation teams

  

* Contribute to the electrical design of the actuator, including motor selection, motor drivers, sensing, and protection, working closely with our EE team and suppliers

  

* Contribute to the mechanical design of the actuator, including transmissions, bearings, housings, and thermal paths, with an eye toward torque density, efficiency, and manufacturability

  

* Write and tune motor control firmware, including current and position control, current and thermal limiting, calibration, and fault detection

  
About the team  
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
  
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
  
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
  
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
  
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
* PhD in EE, ME, Robotics, Physics, or a related field, or a Master’s degree in one of these fields and 4+ years of industry experience developing actuators, motors, or other electromechanical systems
* Experience building models of electromechanical or thermal systems and validating them against test data

We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

### **Available Locations | Austin, TX | New York, NY | San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA**

### **About the Role**

The Cloudflare Hyperdrive team builds the technology that makes regional databases feel like they are global. Hyperdrive is a core piece of the Cloudflare Developer Platform that accelerates database queries from Cloudflare Workers by pooling connections and caching data at the edge. By eliminating the massive latency overhead of TCP, TLS, and database-specific handshakes, Hyperdrive allows developers to use the databases they already know and love—like PostgreSQL and MySQL—without the "cold start" performance penalties typically associated with serverless environments.

### **Responsibilities**

Hyperdrive is integrated directly into the Cloudflare global network and features:

* Global Connection Pooling: Maintains "warm" connections to origin databases across the globe, reducing connection times by up to 90%.
* Intelligent Query Caching: Automatically caches frequently run read queries as close to the user as possible.
* Protocol-Aware Proxying: Features custom-built implementations of database wire protocols (PostgreSQL and MySQL) to parse and optimize traffic in real-time.
* Seamless Integration: Works with existing ORMs and drivers, providing a simple connection string that "just works" for developers.
* The team is geographically distributed across North America.
* You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. * You enjoy the challenge of debugging complex, distributed systems and building for "five nines" reliability.

**About Groq**

Inference is the engine that powers AI, and Groq was built from the silicon up to deliver the world's fastest inference at scale. We pioneered the LPU—the first processor designed specifically for AI inference—and are transforming that innovation into a global cloud platform powering production AI workloads.

  

With the capital, infrastructure, and team to execute, we're uniquely positioned to define the next era of AI infrastructure. The opportunity is massive, and it's still wide open. Now let's go build it!

**Mission**

We’re looking for a network engineer with deep data center and Kubernetes networking experience to own networking across GroqMetal’s management plane and tenant clusters.

  

You will own network architecture, configuration, security, and production operations—from host and cluster networking through data center fabrics to edge peering and interconnects. You’ll manage changes through fabric managers, automation, and GitOps, backed by a detailed understanding of the protocols, packet paths, and failure behavior underneath them.

  

You’ll turn customer connectivity, isolation, and performance requirements into managed platform capabilities. Success means customers can provision and use networking reliably, tenant boundaries are demonstrably enforced, and network changes and failures can be diagnosed and resolved without reconstructing the system by hand.

  

**Location:** This role will be based in one of our three hiring hubs: the **Dallas, San Francisco, or New York City area**. The person hired for this role must be based in one of these three areas. You’ll have the flexibility to work remotely while we establish our local Groq office, with the expectation that this role will transition to onsite once the office opens.

  

**Responsibilities & opportunities in this role**

* **Networking product capabilities:** Translate customer connectivity, isolation, access, and performance requirements into supported platform features. Define how those features are requested, provisioned, changed, observed, and removed throughout their lifecycle.
* **Tenant and node network lifecycle:** Build Kubernetes-native automation to create, modify, and remove tenant networks and manage node membership through provisioning, scaling, repair, replacement, and reassignment. Verify isolation and connectivity at each transition, recover safely from partial failures, and remove stale configuration before resources are reassigned.
* **Data center routing and connectivity:** Own dynamic configuration of tenant networks, BGP, routing policy, VLANs, and overlays across management, tenant, and external networks. Build Kubernetes-native automation to provision and manage these capabilities through fabric-manager APIs, including customer service exposure, ingress/egress, VIPs, load balancers, and public IPs. Validate convergence, failover, reachability, and isolation.
* **Kubernetes networking:** Own networking for the Groq management plane and tenant clusters, including Cilium, network policy, service routing, ingress, egress, and integration with bare-metal networks.
* **GPU networking:** Automate tenant configuration and lifecycle operations for GPU networking, including NVL72 systems, InfiniBand, RoCE, and GPUDirect, through supported platform and fabric-management interfaces. Validate connectivity, isolation, and performance as tenant allocations and node membership change.
* **Addressing and fabric integration:** Own dynamic address allocation, network inventory integration, and tenant network configuration through IPAM, NetBox, and fabric-manager APIs such as Netris and UFM. Keep intended configuration, applied state, and inventory consistent throughout the tenant and node lifecycle.
* **Tenant isolation and network security:** Own segmentation and traffic policy across the Groq management plane, tenant clusters, and physical fabrics. Define permitted communication between environments and verify isolation through provisioning, scaling, maintenance, and hardware reassignment. Work with security engineering on network access controls and hardening requirements.
* **Network standards and configuration lifecycle:** Establish addressing, routing, and configuration standards for GroqMetal’s management plane and tenant networks. Implement declarative configuration and continuous reconciliation through Kubernetes-native controllers, fabric-manager APIs, and GitOps, with code review, automated testing and validation, staged rollout, and recovery procedures. Detect and reconcile configuration drift, and maintain tenant isolation as nodes enter, leave, or return to tenant networks during provisioning, repair, and reassignment.
* **Production network reliability:** Own network telemetry, troubleshooting, and incident remediation. Diagnose packet loss, routing failures, congestion, and unexpected traffic across hosts, clusters, fabrics, and the edge. Turn recurring incidents and performance findings into prioritized improvements to the managed service.
  

  

**Ideal candidates have/are**

* **Deep networking knowledge and production ownership:** You have designed and operated networking services on data center infrastructure through deployment, expansion, maintenance, and incidents. You understand TCP/IP, BGP, routing policy, peering, ECMP, segmentation, and interconnects well enough to explain packet paths, diagnose failures, and evaluate the consequences of a configuration change.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, 3D Rendering
jobs.description:
Mirage is an AI video company focused on making creation dramatically easier. Our team tackles some of the hardest creative and technical challenges in generative media.  
  
We get to rethink how people collaborate with AI that can actually *do* creative work with them—defining entirely new interaction paradigms for AI-native video tools. We make that possible by building multimodal agents that turn creative direction into edits, rendering engines that composite multiple layers of video and graphics, and generative video models trained from the ground up that create new media when needed.  
  
All of this comes together in Captions, our creative workspace for generating, editing, and designing video. The technology behind Captions is now available more broadly: Tesseract gives any AI agent native video-editing capabilities, while developers can integrate our models into their own products through APIs.  
  
**Explore our work**  
Captions — Our flagship creative workspace
  
Tesseract — Our professional video engine for AI agents
  
Research — The foundation models we build in-house
  
Updates — The latest from Mirage
  
TechCrunch, Forbes, Fast Company — Press  
  
**Our Investors**

We’re very fortunate to have some the best investors and entrepreneurs backing us, including **Index Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz,** **General Catalyst**, Uncommon Projects, Kevin Systrom, Mike Krieger, Lenny Rachitsky, Antoine Martin, Julie Zhuo, Ben Rubin, Jaren Glover, SVAngel, 20VC, Ludlow Ventures, Chapter One, and more.

*Please note that most of our roles will require you to be in-person at our NYC HQ (located in Union Square)*

**About the role**

We want Tesseract to render 3D that is indistinguishable from footage. You'll be the founding engineer for photoreal 3D in Tesseract, our Rust-based, cross-platform graphics and media rendering engine.

Tesseract already renders video, motion graphics, effects and compositing in a color- managed pipeline. You'll build 3D to the same standard: a fast interactive preview for editing, and a physically based final render, path-traced or hybrid ray-traced, that produces film-quality frames for export. Both run from one scene, material and lighting model, so what people see while they edit is what they export.

Scenes are authored by people and by AI agents, so render cost, failure modes and APIs matter as much as image quality. This is a foundational role: you'll make the core architectural decisions and help build the team around them.

**What you'll do**

* Define the architecture for photoreal 3D: how ray tracing, rasterization and denoising divide the work, and how that maps onto Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D and WebGPU.
* Build light transport: global illumination, reflections and refraction, soft shadows from area lights, and volumetrics such as haze, fog and light shafts.
* Build a physically based model for materials, lights and cameras: energy-conserving materials (metal, glass, clearcoat, sheen, translucency), lights in real-world units, and a camera with exposure, depth of field and motion blur.
* Own image quality: sampling, antialiasing, accumulation, denoising and firefly suppression, with frames that stay stable and deterministic across a video export.
* Scale scenes to production complexity with acceleration structures, instancing, culling and memory management, for millions of triangles and tens of thousands of objects.
* Integrate 3D into Tesseract's video, motion graphics and compositing pipeline, including ACES color management and render passes such as depth, normals, motion vectors and light groups.
* Make render cost predictable and rendering robust: performance budgets, profiling, and headless batch rendering on local and cloud GPUs.
* Design 3D APIs that work for people and AI agents alike: a clear scene representation, actionable validation errors, fast previews and render cost known before the render.
* Work with engine, product and AI teams, and help hire and grow the 3D rendering team.

**What makes you a great fit**

* Deep experience building physically based renderers in production: film or offline renderers, path tracers, or game engines with ray-traced or hybrid lighting.
* Strong command of light transport: the rendering equation, Monte Carlo integration, importance sampling, material models and denoising.
* Hands-on GPU ray tracing: building and traversing acceleration structures (BVHs), hardware ray-tracing APIs such as Metal ray tracing, Vulkan ray tracing or DXR, and compute-based fallbacks.
* A solid understanding of modern rasterization pipelines, and of how hybrid renderers combine rasterization with ray tracing.
* Hands-on experience with Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D or WebGPU, including compute shaders, GPU profiling and GPU debugging.
* Proficiency in Rust or C++, with strong reasoning about memory, concurrency and performance.
* Strong foundations in the mathematics of graphics: linear algebra, geometry, probability and sampling.
* An eye for realism: you can look at a frame, say why it doesn't read as real, and fix the cause.
* Experience owning complex technical projects and making architectural decisions in ambiguous problem spaces.

**Even better if…**

* You've worked on the internals of a production renderer or engine such as Cycles, Arnold, RenderMan, V-Ray, Karma, Unreal Engine (Lumen or its path tracer) or Unity HDRP.
* You've built or integrated ML denoisers, or worked on neural rendering.
* You've worked with color management (ACES, OpenColorIO), HDR output or film-look pipelines.
* You've built on cross-platform graphics abstractions such as wgpu, including extending them where they lack features such as ray tracing.
* You've optimized rendering for Apple silicon or mobile GPUs.
* You have experience with Rust, video compositing, or integrating 2D and 3D rendering in creative tools.

### **Benefits:**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans
* 401K with employer match

**About Groq**

Inference is the engine that powers AI, and Groq was built from the silicon up to deliver the world's fastest inference at scale. We pioneered the LPU—the first processor designed specifically for AI inference—and are transforming that innovation into a global cloud platform powering production AI workloads.

  

With the capital, infrastructure, and team to execute, we're uniquely positioned to define the next era of AI infrastructure. The opportunity is massive, and it's still wide open. Now let's go build it!

**Mission:**

GroqMetal is building the infrastructure platform that turns large-scale physical compute into a reliable, isolated, customer-consumable AI infrastructure. This is a hands-on Senior Staff role: you will write production software as part of a software engineering team. You will lead the design of a Kubernetes-based software platform focused on large-scale AI training and inference workloads. You will be a key technical leader in building the systems that turn cutting-edge physical infrastructure into a stable product.

  

**Location:** This role will be based in one of our three hiring hubs: the **Dallas, San Francisco, or New York City** area. The person hired for this role must be based in one of these three areas. You’ll have the flexibility to work remotely while we establish our local Groq office, with the expectation that this role will transition to onsite once the office opens.

  

**Responsibilities & opportunities in this role:**

* **Design and build core Groq platform systems:** APIs, controllers, operators, reconciliation loops, and infrastructure abstractions.
* **Remain deeply hands-on:** Write, review, test, debug, and operate substantial production code while providing Senior Staff technical leadership.
* **Embrace the market:** Leverage Kubernetes to build a commercial product for AI infrastructure, delivering production-grade Kubernetes services for dedicated customers running large-scale AI training and inference workloads.
* **Build a system, not just deploy technology:** Apply distributed-systems principles to partial failure, retries, concurrency, consistency, idempotency, availability, and recovery.
* **Design for stability and robustness:** Design stable platform APIs and contracts that decouple the customer experience from changes in backend infrastructure.
* **Collaborate with a team of experts:** Work across infrastructure, inference, networking, infosec, and other teams to turn ambiguous platform needs into production systems.
  

  

**Ideal candidates have/are:**

* **Experienced software engineers first:** Strong experience designing, implementing, testing, shipping, and maintaining production software.
* **Deep Kubernetes platform engineering experience:** Experience with operators/controllers, CRDs, admission control, node lifecycle, cluster services, and production-grade platform design.
* **Strong distributed-systems expertise:** Practical experience reasoning about CAP, consensus, leader election, eventual consistency, state reconciliation, fault domains, and recovery.
* **Experience developing infrastructure software:** Experience working through a robust SDLC, including design review, automated testing, CI/CD, staged rollout, rollback, observability, and incident learning.
* **Experience delivering Kubernetes as a Service:** Practical knowledge and experience gained from delivering Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, or infrastructure control planes as a commercially critical or externally consumed product is highly valued, but not required.
* **Hands-on experience using coding agents:** Experience using tools such as Codex, Claude Code, or similar systems/harnesses in substantive engineering work is highly valued; real-world practice matters more than commercial deployment.
* **Steeped in the domain:** Experience at a hyperscaler or neocloud supporting AI workloads or commercializing GPU clusters, with a strong understanding of the operational and product challenges of large-scale accelerator infrastructure.
* **Comfort with ambiguity:** Experience with inference platforms, accelerator/GPU infrastructure, device plugins, cloud infrastructure, or customer-facing platform products.
  

  

**Why Join Us:**

* **Purposeful Hiring**: You’re not here by accident, and neither is anyone else. Every teammate is handpicked with intention because who we build with matters.
* **Builders Wanted**: You’re not just riding the rocket ship, you’re building it. Your work directly shapes the trajectory of our company.
* **Mission-Driven Work**: We’re here to make a real impact. Our mission fuels everything we do.
* **Tackling Hard Problems**: If easy isn’t your thing, you’re in the right place. We solve some of the most complex and exciting challenges in our space.
* **Excellence Is The Standard**: High performance isn’t just encouraged, it’s the baseline. And it’s contagious.
  

  

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Compensation:**

Groq is committed to providing competitive compensation through our Total Cash philosophy, which incorporates potential bonus value directly into base pay. The total cash salary ranges for this position, which is inclusive of the potential bonus value, is dependent by level:

- Staff: $270,400 - $365,000

- Sr. Staff: $341,400 - $401,600

Individual placement within these ranges is determined by your geographic location, experience, skills, and alignment with internal compensation standards. These ranges are specific to candidates located in the United States. Compensation for international candidates will vary based on local market dynamics. Beyond cash compensation, Groq also offers a Long-Term Incentive (LTI) Program and a robust suite of employee benefits.

jobs.title: Facility Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**What Timken makes possible begins with you.**  
Those who came before us helped land a man on the moon, create the world's infrastructure, and introduce renewable energy alternatives. Now you can join the Timken team to write your own unique story and help drive what's next.

  

A career at Timken means you can have an immediate impact doing Work That Matters to the world— improving the efficiency of today's industrial equipment and preparing for the future of motion on our planet and beyond. New employees can start contributing right away, and there are many opportunities to advance your career at your own pace. Join our global team of 19,000 people in 45 countries, and start helping our customers push the limits of what's possible in their world of motion.

  

**PURPOSE**:  
  
This position exists to design, develop, construct, and maintain electrical control systems related to the function of the facility. This position will help maintain and troubleshoot the electrical systems pertaining to the building automation system, lighting system, and HVAC/chiller/boiler/cooling tower equipment and drives. This position will be responsible for integration basic level systems into the building automation system.  
This position will also design, develop, construct, and maintain electrical control systems for the implementation of new concepts on Research projects/testing systems.

  

**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES**:

  

* Design and construct electrical control circuitry and programming logic for integration of lower level facility systems into the building automation system. Projects will be handled start to finish (design/build/install/startup). Position will work with outside controls contractor on the implementation of larger systems in order to meet project timelines.
* Function as facility lead on computerized lighting/shade control system.
* Assist facilities Principal Electrical Analyst on regular facility maintenance issues related to motor control centers, substation breakers, well water system, fire alarm control system, compressed air system, iron filtration system etc.
* Design and construct electrical control circuitry for prototype and test machinery based on the needs of the customers. Design and program PLC logic for such machines as well as data acquisition schemes.
* Prepare budgets and designs for projects less than $100,000/ 12 week project time frame.
* Communicate closely with pipe fitters, machinists, sheet metal workers, machine operators, engineers, design technicians, safety inspectors, and others, so that machinery may be constructed as efficiently as possible using the proper tools and procedures as outlined in various safety and electrical codes.
* Analyze prototype and test machinery using electrical and electronic test equipment , schematics, logic and wiring diagrams, flow charts, cycle graphs, and other technical data in order to determine what improvements or changes might be needed to obtain more precise and efficient machine operation. Uses the data to design and implement the solution.
* Provide possible solutions for problems which have occurred during design, instruction, or run-off of test machinery. Implement these changes with success without first consulting the Engineering Department.
* Keep informed about new types of electrical, electronic, and microprocessor controls by studying technical manuals, video tapes, attending factory schools and seminars, and working with field service engineers so that these controls may be integrated into futuristic machine controls with the least amount of difficulty, confusion, and expense possible.

  

**TECHNICAL FUNCTION SKILLS**:

  

* Proficient in CAD
* Ability to design and develop PLC ladder logic
* Ability to design and develop HMI programming
* Proficient in basic and advanced electrical tools (multimeters, o-scopes, data acquisition systems)
* Basic computer knowledge (Microsoft office)
* Understanding of NEC code and the ability to make decisions based upon it.
* Function knowledge of facility systems such as boilers, chillers, HVAC, variable speed fans, etc.
* Ability to program building automation system
* Building Operators Certificate Level 1

  

**EDUCATION:**

  

* Minimum: HS Diploma with 8+ years of relevant experience is required (i.e. test lab, facility maintenance etc.). Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Technology is preferred.

  

All qualified applicants shall be treated equally according to their individual qualifications, abilities, experiences and other employment standards. There will be no discrimination due to gender or gender identity, race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran/military status or any other basis protected by applicable law.

The Electrical Engineer will support gas, coal, renewable, and new-generation self-build projects by defining electrical design-basis requirements and supporting the technical specification, engineering, procurement, integration, and commissioning of power generation electrical systems. A required focus of this role is advanced knowledge of utility-scale power plant electrical systems and equipment, including generators, generator step-up transformers (GSUs), medium- and low-voltage distribution systems, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), protective relaying, grounding systems, black-start systems, auxiliary power systems, and grid interconnection requirements.

jobs.description:
**About Johnson Controls**

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

**What you will do**

Johnson Controls is seeking a Variable Speed Drive (VSD) Subject Matter Expert to serve as a senior technical authority for the variable-speed-drive technologies applied to our YORK water-cooled chiller portfolio.

In this highly influential role, you will provide advanced technical leadership across the complete product lifecycle, supporting Field Sales, Service, Product Technical Support, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Product Management.

The role requires not only the ability to solve difficult electrical and system-level technical problems, but also the ability to translate that knowledge into service procedures, diagnostic guidance, technical literature, training, design improvements, and long-term product reliability.

You will also be deeply involved in new product development and product enhancement, representing serviceability, reliability, field, and customer needs throughout the engineering process. You will collaborate with engineering teams to evaluate drive architectures, review designs and supplier solutions, establish validation plans, assess test results, identify technical risks, and help ensure new products enter the market ready to perform reliably throughout their lifecycle.

* Provide advanced day-to-day technical support to global Field Sales, Service, and Product Technical Support organizations through site visits, remote troubleshooting, technical reviews, and escalation support.
* Lead the diagnosis and resolution of complex issues involving VSD power electronics, rectifier and inverter sections, DC-link systems, IGBT or other switching devices, gate-drive circuits, harmonic filters, cooling systems, motors, controls, communications, protection, customer power interfaces, and chiller system integration.
* Act as a senior escalation resource for challenging field issues, using operating data, fault histories, waveforms, electrical measurements, service history, test results, and engineering analysis to establish root cause and corrective actions.
* Provide technical leadership for low- and medium-voltage drive applications, including system architecture, incoming power requirements, breaker and contactor interfaces, grounding, power quality, harmonic performance, motor compatibility, protection coordination, and safe commissioning practices.
* Partner with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Product Management, Sourcing, suppliers, and Service teams to drive product reliability, standardization, and continuous improvement.
* Participate in new product development, supplier technical reviews, design reviews, DFMEA and risk assessments, validation planning, prototype testing, product launch readiness, and post-launch support.
* Evaluate drive performance across expected operating conditions, including voltage variation, load transients, starting and stopping sequences, cooling conditions, communication loss, protective trips, fault recovery, and interaction with the compressor motor and chiller control system.
* Bring the voice of the field and service organization into product development, ensuring serviceability, diagnostics, maintainability, safe work practices, replacement strategy, spare-parts support, reliability, and lifecycle considerations are addressed early in the design process.
* Create and maintain technical service literature, including service bulletins, service letters, troubleshooting procedures, fault trees, diagnostic guidance, commissioning instructions, parameter-management guidance, training materials, and updates to internal technical knowledge systems.
* Develop and deliver technical training and knowledge transfer to Product Technical Support, Field Service, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and other internal organizations.
* Mentor engineers and technical support personnel, helping build organizational expertise in VSD technology, electrical troubleshooting, and chiller-drive integration.
* Support structured root-cause investigations and corrective-action activities for significant product quality, supplier quality, safety, and reliability issues.
* Analyze quantitative and qualitative field information to identify recurring issues, emerging reliability risks, supplier concerns, and opportunities for product or diagnostic improvement.
* Represent the organization professionally during critical customer and field situations where deep technical expertise, safe decision-making, and sound engineering judgment are required.

**What we look for**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Power Electronics, Controls Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant technical experience.
* 7+ years of experience with variable-sp

jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly.

The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone.

At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn.

**What we are looking for**

We’re searching for a **Senior Software Engineer, ML Evaluation & Introspection Infrastructure** to join our Behavior Analysis team, reporting to the team’s engineering manager. Aurora’s trucks already haul freight on Texas highways with no one on board, and every new version of the learned model that drives them has to prove, on real driving data, that it is better and safer than the one before. Behavior Analysis builds the systems that make that call: the evals that compare model versions, the embedding search that makes every driving scenario findable, and the introspection tools that show why a model did what it did. Engineers build more than 100 training and eval datasets a week through our tools. We’re a small team, so each engineer owns whole systems, and we work agent-first: our tools are built for AI agents to drive as easily as engineers do. You’ll own core pieces of that loop and help lead what comes next: putting LLMs, VLMs and agents to work on analysis, so questions that take days to answer today take minutes.

**In this role you will**

* Build and scale evaluation pipelines that compare model versions on large driving datasets: offline evals, slice-based metrics, regression detection, and model-vs-model reports.
* Own embedding and vector-search pipelines over driving data, versioned per model, so engineers can search, cluster and compare how any model represents the world. This is where you’d start: owning embedding generation and search end to end.
* Build model introspection infrastructure (attention, attribution, ablations) that turns “why did the model do that?” from a research project into a query.
* Help define how frontier LLMs, VLMs and agents change ML analysis here: triaging, labeling, clustering and summarizing driving scenarios and eval results. We already have a prototype using LLMs for data curation, and you’d help decide where it goes next.
* Work side by side with the ML engineers training these models to decide what to measure, then make those measurements trustworthy, observable and cheap enough to run on every candidate model.
* Build the web app and CLI that engineers and AI agents use to find datasets, training runs, evals and their costs, designed with agents as first-class users.

**Required qualifications**

* Typically 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend, data or ML infrastructure.
* Strong Python, and proficiency with SQL.
* Designed and operated large-scale batch or data pipelines on cloud infrastructure, including backfills, retries and cost management.
* Built systems that measure or evaluate something: metrics, experimentation, evaluation or analytics platforms.
* Experience with distributed compute and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS Batch or similar).

**Desirable qualifications**

* ML evaluation infrastructure: eval harnesses, golden datasets, regression detection, A/B model comparison.
* Embeddings and vector search, or model introspection and interpretability tooling.
* Using LLMs, VLMs or agentic workflows to automate analysis, labeling or data curation.
* Autonomous vehicles, robotics or other large-scale sensor data.
* Observability for data systems (metrics, alerting, SLOs), and everyday use of AI coding agents.
* Coming from backend or data engineering and want to learn ML evaluation? Apply anyway: we’ll teach you the ML side.
