jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Hayward Holdings Inc. (NYSE "HAYW") is one of the leading manufacturers of residential swimming pool equipment in the world, with a significant presence in the commercial pool market that is continuously growing. Hayward designs, manufactures, and markets a full line of residential and commercial pool and spa equipment including pumps, filters, heating, cleaners, salt chlorinators, automation, lighting, safety, flow control and energy solutions at our company owned facilities. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Hayward also has facilities in Tennessee, Arizona, and Rhode Island, Georgia, as well as Canada, Spain, France, Australia, and China.

**Overview:**

We're looking for a self-directed engineer who thrives with ownership — someone who can take a project from concept through manufacturing release with minimal oversight, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver industry-leading pool controls, electronics, and assemblies.

Join us to lead, grow, and make an impact as part of a company that values care, respect, and innovation.

**This position is based in North Kingstown, RI and is onsite 5 days a week.**

**Major Tasks and Responsibilities**

**1. Design Ownership**

* Analyze system and subsystem level requirements and evaluate technical solutions for new platforms.
* Generate electrical architecture solutions, topologies, and configurations to optimize the electrical design for new project needs.
* Design, model, simulate, implement, and verify circuits.
* Lead design reviews, optimize PCB layouts, and specify components for robust designs.

**2. Analysis and Verification**

* Support electronic circuit verification activities per industry accepted practices.
* Support DFMEA and other analyses to develop a robust product that meets market and safety requirements.

**3. Test, Validate, and Launch**

* Build and analyze bench level prototypes for proof-of-concept designs.
* Create and execute test plans to validate designs and ensure industry compliance (HALT, EMC/EMI, UL, CE).
* Partner with manufacturing teams for smooth production launches.

**4. Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work with product, firmware, mechanical, and system architects to create cohesive product architectures.
* Maintain detailed technical documentation and communicate design strategies effectively.

**5. Continuous Learning**

* Stay up to date on industry trends and emerging technologies through conferences, research, and side projects.
* Champion and role model best practices within the electrical engineering team.

**Requirements**

Experience: 8–10+ years in electrical design and product development.

**Who You Are**

* Self-driven and independent — comfortable owning projects end-to-end with minimal oversight and a strong commitment to meeting deadlines.

**Required Experience**

* Proficiency with schematic capture tools (Altium, Xpedition, Zuken, OrCAD or Eagle) and knowledge of PCB layout and PCB construction.
* Experience with IoT-connected embedded systems, including wireless communication protocols (e.g., Wi-Fi, BLE, Zigbee) and cloud-connected device architectures.
* Knowledge of 3-phase BLDC motor drives, embedded systems, microcontrollers, and analog/digital circuitry.
* Familiarity with safety standards, EMC, and environmental compliance.
* Understanding of mechanical/thermal/packaging design for embedded systems in commercial and industrial markets.
* Experience with oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, power analyzers, and timing analyzers to support product verification.
* Technical knowledge of reliability testing including environmental, safety, and EMI/EMC verification procedures.
* Working knowledge of display controller and touch-controller interfaces (e.g., RGB, MIPI DSI, SPI, I2C), including backlight drive and power sequencing, touch tuning for wet, gloved, and high-glare conditions, ESD/EMC protection of the display and touch subsystem.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using simulation and analysis tools such as LTSpice, Saber, Mathcad, or Maple.
* Experience with electrical product design in a regulated environment such as automotive, aerospace, or medical.
* Design For Six Sigma, DMAIC, Lean Six Sigma, or Shainin Red X certification.
* Hands-on experience designing and integrating user-interface displays and touchscreens for harsh, outdoor-exposed products, including full-color TFT LCD touchscreens (resistive and projected-capacitive) as well as simpler segmented, character, and LED displays and keypads.
* Proven track record translating customer and market requirements into product requirements, system architectures, and technical specifications.
* Experience leading or contributing to architecture trade studies, make/buy decisions, and platform selection (MCU/SoC, connectivity modules, sensors).

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) required; Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (MSEE) preferred.

**Why Join Hayward**

* **Impact at Scale:** Build the connected, IoT-enabled hardware inside smart pool products used in millions of homes worldwide.
* **Our Mission:** Transforming water experiences with innovation and sustainability.
* **Growth Opportunities:** A supportive environment for career advancement and professional development.
* **Inclusive Culture:** We value diversity and foster a collaborative workplace.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Competitive pay, health coverage, retirement plan matching, and paid time off.

**Sensor Autonomy Engineer - Tactical Applications**  
  
**About Overwatch:**  
Overwatch Imaging is an imagery intelligence technology company working to bring sensor autonomy to time-critical airborne search, detection, tracking and monitoring missions. Our Automated Sensor Operator (ASO) software, native to our own line of purpose-built Smart Sensors and as an upgrade for airborne video gimbal platforms, brings Superhuman Vision and Workload Reduction to users of real-time imagery intelligence systems. We fundamentally believe that modern edge processing and AI-enabled autonomy can perform an important set of time-critical imagery intelligence missions better, faster and more safely than humans can alone.  
  
Founded in 2016 in Hood River, Oregon, we support private sector companies as well as federal, state and local agencies around the world with missions ranging from wildfire mapping and disaster response to law enforcement, border security, maritime domain awareness and tactical intelligence.  
  
**Position Description**  
The Sensor Autonomy Engineer will design and implement software and firmware to transform high-level user inputs and raw sensor data into real-time customer intelligence for Overwatch's Tactical Applications products. This engineer works hands-on with prototype and low-rate production automated imaging systems, developing, testing, and deploying real-time onboard sensor autonomy, image processing and artificial intelligence algorithms, embedded hardware drivers, image manipulation software, user interfaces, and data post-processing tools built to perform within the size, weight, power, and latency constraints of tactical operating environments.  
  
**Level Description**  
The Sensor Autonomy Engineer is responsible for leading the design, development, and maintenance of complex software applications. They may have a technical leadership role in mentoring and managing teams of junior and mid-level software engineers. They are expected to have a strong technical background, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to make high-level decisions that affect the entire software development process.

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Mathematical Modeling & Analysis:**  
  + 3D mathematics, including coordinate systems, vectors, and rotations.
  + Control systems, state estimation, and motion planning.

* **Geospatial Imagery Optimization:**
  + Develop software to geolocate, rectify, mosaic, register, and combine imagery with map data.
* **Software Development:**
  + Design, develop, and maintain complex software applications.
  + Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  + Participate in code reviews, troubleshoot issues, and optimize software performance and functionality.
* **Payload Embedded Software:**
  + Lead code development, version management, and testing for motion control, camera and IMU drivers, and data management.
  + Balance urgent code changes and unit-specific customization with long-term software sustainability and code reuse.
  + Interface with low-level hardware using SPI, I2C, UART, and analog interfaces.
  + Improve error detection, reporting, and mitigation.
* **Software Interfaces:**
  + Develop and maintain connections between Overwatch Imaging payloads and external systems for command and control, external exploitation algorithms, and data export.
* **Software Deployment:**
  + Develop automated build tools to build, test, and deploy software updates while managing dependencies.

**Character Attributes:**  

* Thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced small startup business environment
* Highly motivated self-starter able to work independently and with a team
* Collaborates well in a small team environment
* Enjoys hands-on work and learning new skills
* Eager to learn and solve real-world problems and accept new challenges
* Takes pride in seeing new products reach operational use quickly

  
**Experience and Education:**  
  

* Formal education in software engineering, computer science, aeronautical engineering, robotics, optics or related fields.
* Strong analytical background in physical systems that interact with the real world
* Experience in airborne or space-based remote sensing and image processing; hands-on experience with mid-sized unmanned aircraft and/or airborne camera systems.
* Experience with image processing software, machine learning techniques, and/or autonomous systems.
* Experience with device driver implementation and embedded system deployment.
* At least 8 years of experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or
* At least 5 years of experience with a Master’s degree, or a Ph.D degree.
* Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

Join Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions practice as a Microsoft Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant). You will help clients design, deploy, and support scalable Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365 F&O) and Power Platform environments that advance finance and supply chain transformation. You will collaborate with client business and technology leaders to establish secure application lifecycle management, DevOps, integration, and operational practices across complex engagements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.  
  
Work you'll do  
  
As a Microsoft D365/Power Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant) on the Emerging ERP Solutions team, you will be responsible for:  
  
Design and govern environment topology, routing, capacity, deployment standards, Data Loss Prevention policies, and managed-environment settings across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Dataverse, model-driven apps, and Power Automate; lead transitions from Lifecycle Services (LCS) to Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) deployment models.  
  
Architect and maintain Git-based application lifecycle management (ALM) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Power Platform Build Tools, solution packaging, automated solution checker gates, release controls, and rollback procedures.

Location:

Job Description:

The Staff Electrical Engineer will be responsible for the electronic design and development of ORTEC brand nuclear instrumentation and measurement systems used for radiation detection and radioisotope identification. This role involves board-level circuit design with an emphasis on mixed-signal electronics, including low-noise amplifiers, analog-to-digital converters, digital circuitry, and power supply design.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

Electronic Design & Development

* Conceptualize, design, simulate, implement, and validate low-noise electronic systems using mixed-signal, analog, digital, and software development techniques.
* Design and develop board-level electronic circuits for nuclear instrumentation and measurement systems.
* Develop and implement new technologies to address market opportunities.

Hardware Design & Verification

* Perform schematic capture, feasibility analysis, prototyping, PCB bring-up, debugging, verification testing, and performance characterization of new designs.
* Design and integrate electronic systems incorporating components such as displays, touch panels, and batteries.
* Support compliance testing activities and associated documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Provide technical assistance to Manufacturing and Customer Service teams.
* Partner with Marketing to ensure product designs and performance specifications align with overall product requirements.
* Support system-level hardware and software integration efforts.
  

**Requirements:**

Education & Experience

* BS in Electrical Engineering or equivalent required.
* 3–5 years of relevant electronics design experience.

Technical Requirements

* Experience with mixed-signal and/or analog circuit design, including:
  + Amplifier circuits
  + Active and passive filters
  + Transistor circuits
  + Linear and switching power supplies
  + Impedance matching and transformation
  + A/D converters
* Experience with digital circuit design, including:
  + Microprocessors
  + Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs)
* Experience implementing digital signal processing within electronic systems.
* Proficiency with electronic design and simulation tools, including schematic capture and SPICE-based simulation software.
* Experience with system-level software and hardware integration.
* Experience designing high-accuracy, low-noise measurement circuits, including component selection, schematic capture, modeling, and layout techniques.
* Experience selecting electronic components and designing circuits for cryogenic temperature environments.
* Experience designing instrumentation for nuclear measurement applications.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.

Communication & Professional Skills

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
* Ability to present technical information effectively to customers and employees.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced professional environment.
* Strong organizational, data collection, and presentation skills.
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to continuous improvement.
* Willingness to take on increasing technical leadership responsibilities.

Advanced Measurement Technology (AMT), part of AMETEK’s Materials Analysis Division, is a global leader in high-precision measurement and detection solutions. Headquartered in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, AMT designs and manufactures advanced instrumentation for nuclear spectrometry, radiological measurement, electrochemical analysis, and electronic signal recovery. Our technologies enable customers in research, defense, homeland security, and industrial markets to solve their most complex challenges with accuracy and reliability.

  

AMT combines renowned brands such as ORTEC, Amptek, and Sunpower, delivering differentiated solutions for applications ranging from radiation detection and semiconductor analysis to cryogenic cooling systems. As a cleared defense contractor, AMT also supports U.S. government programs with custom products and services. jobs.title: Staff Firmware/Middleware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

Renesas Electronics Americas (REA) brings together the strong financial foundation of a multi-billion-dollar global operation and the flexibility and velocity of a smaller organization. As a result of the combination of Renesas, IDT and Intersil, REA has a deep portfolio of technology, a strong customer base and big ambitions to grab more market share on a global stage. Our engineers, marketers, sales and support teams are all unified in our goal to create an environment where creativity thrives, where results are rewarded and where diversity is valued.

Renesas Electronics, a leading global semiconductor company, is rapidly scaling its AI-focused power delivery business. Products include high-performance digital power VRMs, multiphase controllers, Smart Power Stages (SPS), Vertical Power Stages (SPS with integrated capacitors and multiple silicon die), Power Towers (power modules integrating multiple SPS-equivalents with capacitors and inductors), and power MOSFETs.

Position Overview:

REA is seeking a Staff Firmware Engineer for our Performance Computing Power (PCP) team in Austin, TX, where we develop the most advanced digital power ICs in the industry. You will architect, design, and maintain firmware for integrated circuits that supply power to the largest and most powerful advanced computing platforms. Your contributions will span low level circuits to large system design, and you will see those systems all the way through to high volume manufacturing.

Job Duties:

* Design, develop, and verify embedded firmware for digital PWM voltage regulators
* Write firmware patches to implement new features or apply hardware workaround
* Work with hardware design team to define interface based on user requirements
* Write specification to document firmware architecture and implementation
* Collaborate with validation team to bring up new silicon and debug any issues found
* Develop automated tests to validate firmware on lab bench using test equipment

  
**Qualifications**  

* 8+ years of experience in firmware development on custom SOCs in pre and post silicon environment
* BS/MS in Electrical and Computer Engineering, or related field
* Expert at embedded firmware development in C and assembly programming language
* Good understanding of software development cycle and version control system
* Skillful at interrupt, memory, and performance optimization for real-time applications
* Deep understanding of state machine driven task management and RTOS concepts
* Experience working with hardware RTL design in Verilog
* Proficient at Linux command line and a scripting language such as Python/Perl
* Strong analytical skills and debug methodology with excellent attention to detail
* Good written and verbal communications skills

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of ARM cortex M-series processors and ARM compiler toolchain
* Working experience with Cadence or Synopsys design tools: SimVision or Verdi
* Solid understanding of serial bus protocols such as I2C, SPI
* Test Driven Development (TDD) and standalone FW unit test bench
* Familiarity with DC-DC buck converter concepts and applications

  
**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

Renesas Electronics deals with dual-use technology that is subject to U.S. export controls regulations. Under these regulations it may be necessary for Renesas to obtain U.S. government export license prior to release of technology to certain persons. jobs.title: Firmware Engineer - Server BMC
jobs.description:
We are seeking a curious and self-motivated BMC Firmware Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development of next-generation industry-standard server platforms. Our work focuses on improving the manageability and security of Apple data center systems. You will work alongside highly skilled engineers who are committed to engineering excellence, and your work will have a direct impact on the platforms we deliver.  
  
**Description**  
  
As a BMC Firmware Engineer, you will design, implement, test, and maintain BMC firmware features for server platforms. You will bring up BMC software on new hardware, work with ODM, OEM, and silicon vendor partners, and help ensure the firmware is robust against security threats. Your work will support strong infrastructure manageability, serviceability, and security.","responsibilities":"Develop and maintain BMC firmware features, including services, APIs, and management interfaces (Redfish, IPMI).  
  
Design scalable, maintainable BMC software that supports new hardware through configuration. Upstream changes to the OpenBMC community where appropriate and maintain downstream patches across releases.  
  
Bring up BMC firmware on new hardware: kernel, drivers, device trees, and board support. Strong embedded firmware knowledge and hands on experience in embedded firmware to support BMCs on devices other than DCSCM module.  
  
Implement and debug low-level drivers and hardware interfaces in collaboration with hardware engineers.  
  
Debug issues across hardware, firmware, and software boundaries using serial console, JTAG, and bus analyzers.  
  
Support EVT, DVT, and PVT builds, and work with global ODM, OEM, and contract manufacturing partners to resolve issues.  
  
Contribute to firmware security: secure boot, firmware signing, vulnerability triage, and patching.  
  
Write unit tests for new features, and support system-level validation by reproducing and fixing defects.  
  
Write clear technical documentation and contribute to design discussions.  
  
Stay current on new vulnerabilities, attack methods, and security standards (NIST, FIPS).  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Familiarity with PLDM and MCTP, and with PECI/APML.  
  
Experience with BMC security features such as secure or verified boot, firmware signing, root of trust, SPDM, and vulnerability management.  
  
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across hardware, firmware, and software, with effective collaboration with vendor and hardware teams.  
  
Experience supporting BMC software on new hardware, including low-level debugging (JTAG, serial, oscilloscope, I2C analyzer).  
  
Exposure to EDKII/BIOS and platform enablement.  
  
Familiarity with RAS concepts (fault management, telemetry, recovery).  
  
Familiarity with cloud-scale operations and fleet management of BMC firmware.  
  
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, and sometimes ambiguous environment, and to identify and raise technical and schedule risks early.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.  
  
7+ years of experience in embedded Linux development with strong C/C++ programming skills, plus scripting in Bash and Python.  
  
Hands-on experience with OpenBMC including IPMI, systemd and D-Bus services, Redfish, sensors and telemetry, and firmware update frameworks.  
  
Experience porting OpenBMC to new platforms, including build configuration, kernel and device tree changes, and platform-specific services.  
  
Experience integrating and scaling sensors in OpenBMC, with attention to service count, memory, and boot-time cost.  
  
Working knowledge of server platform interfaces such as I2C/I3C, SPI, PMBus, UART, GPIO, and Ethernet controllers.  
  
Experience taking firmware through product development stages, ideally EVT/DVT/PVT with ODM or OEM partners.  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,000 and $308,500, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**About us**
============

Graphcore is one of the world's leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world's most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore's teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.

  

**Job Summary**
===============

We are seeking a Senior Systems or Staff Hardware Engineer to provide advanced operational, diagnostic, and engineering support for Graphcore's Arm-based hardware platforms across lab and data center environments.

This role focuses on supporting hardware bring-up, validation, and troubleshooting of complex AI compute platforms, including server blades, racks, and rack-scale infrastructure. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with engineering, platform, and data center teams to ensure the reliability and performance of next-generation AI systems.

  

**The Team**
============

The Systems Engineering and Hardware Engineering teams are responsible for enabling the bring-up, validation, and operational reliability of Graphcore's AI infrastructure platforms.

The team works closely with server engineering, firmware teams, platform architects, and data center operations to support the development, testing, and deployment of next-generation AI compute systems.

This collaborative environment enables rapid problem-solving and continuous improvement of Graphcore's hardware platforms from early development through production deployment.

  

**Responsibilities and Duties**
===============================

* Lead advanced break-fix troubleshooting for server blades, motherboards, power systems, and rack-scale infrastructure.
* Support engineering bring-up activities, including component validation and firmware interaction testing.
* Diagnose system-level failures involving thermal behavior, power anomalies, network configuration, and BIOS/BMC issues.
* Collaborate with server engineering teams to perform root cause analysis and propose corrective actions or design improvements.
* Support deployment and rollout of next-generation hardware platforms through structured validation and qualification cycles.
* Interface with facilities and infrastructure teams to understand environmental factors impacting system reliability.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and validation documentation.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior technicians and engineers on troubleshooting methodologies and hardware diagnostics.
* Participate in on-call rotations or off-hours support during critical engineering milestones or hardware bring-up phases.

**Candidate Profile**
=====================

**Essential**
-------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline.
* 7+ years experience with server hardware architectures and board-level debugging.
* Experience analyzing system logs, hardware telemetry, and power/thermal metrics to isolate hardware failures.
* Hands-on experience with HPC systems, AI compute platforms, or rack-scale infrastructure.
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in fast-paced engineering environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Desirable**
-------------

* Experience supporting prototype or pre-production hardware bring-up.
* Familiarity with data center facilities, including liquid cooling and power distribution systems.
* Experience using Python, Bash, or automation tools for hardware validation or troubleshooting.
* Exposure to structured failure analysis and reliability engineering methodologies.

  

**USA Benefits**  
  
In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing and financial future. Our benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), disability and life insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, commuter benefits, wellness services and an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we're committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

You will report directly to our Engineering Manager, and you’ll work out of our Richardson, TX location on a Hybrid work schedule.

In this role, you will impact the aerospace industry by ensuring that Honeywell’s aerospace products are rigorously tested and validated, contributing to safer and more efficient air travel worldwide. Delivering mission-critical, electronic solutions that protect lives. Use your creativity and critical thinking to take our products from concept to customer. You will lead the development and execution of sophisticated test solutions for Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuits (MMICs). This role involves analyzing detailed test requirements and designing advanced Automated Test Equipment (ATE) systems tailored to customer specifications. The engineer will create and implement comprehensive test strategies, including test plans, acceptance procedures, and rigorous design verification processes.

The position requires leadership in enhancing team test capabilities through planning, coordination, and development of custom test equipment, including fixture design and fabrication. Responsibilities include performing RF test setup, calibration, validation, and troubleshooting of complex assemblies to ensure accurate, repeatable measurements.

The engineer will develop and maintain automated test software using National Instruments LabVIEW, integrating instrumentation and databases to enable scalable, efficient, and high-throughput testing environments. Additional duties include conducting advanced troubleshooting, failure analysis, and root cause investigations for MMIC devices and RF assemblies, as well as executing product qualification and environmental stress testing to meet industry standards.

This role also involves generating detailed technical reports, managing test data systems, and supporting laboratory operations such as asset tracking and equipment maintenance. Precision work under microscopes for inspection, assembly support, and failure analysis are also required. The ideal candidate is highly technical, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently in a fast-paced engineering environment.

the largest manufacturer of roller coasters and thrill rides, is seeking a full time **Electrical Engineering Manager**

**Electrical Engineering Manager**

**Position Summary**

The Electrical Engineering Manager is responsible for leading a small team of electrical engineers, controls engineers, designers, and drafters in the design, development, and implementation of electrical and control systems for amusement rides and devices. This role provides technical leadership, project oversight, resource planning, and process improvement while ensuring compliance with industry standards, functional safety requirements, and regulatory codes. The Electrical Engineering Manager works closely with his team, project engineers, and the Engineering director to deliver safe, innovative, and reliable ride systems that meet project schedules, budgets, and company objectives.

The Electrical Engineering Manager is expected to maintain technical proficiency and remain actively involved in engineering activities. This role is not solely administrative; the successful candidate will dedicate a meaningful portion of their time to hands-on engineering work while leading and developing the electrical engineering team.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Leadership and Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of electrical engineers, controls engineers, designers, and drafters engaged in the design and development of amusement rides and devices.
* Monitor team performance and productivity, implementing improvements through mentoring, training, standardization, software tools, and process enhancements.
* Schedule team workload and adjust priorities as necessary to support project demands and align with the master engineering schedule.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, technical excellence, and collaboration.
* Assist the Engineering Director with departmental budgeting, resource planning, staffing, and workload forecasting.
* Lead by example through active participation in engineering and design activities while balancing management, planning, and supervisory responsibilities.
* Provide technical support and contribute directly to project deliverables, design reviews, engineering calculations, and problem resolution efforts as needed.

**Technical Leadership**

* Define and oversee the design and engineering of electrical and control systems for new ride and attraction projects.
* Work with Project Engineers and the Engineering Director to establish technical requirements, milestones, and deliverables for projects.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Spacecraft Hardware
jobs.description:
**About Overview Energy**

Overview Energy is a mission-driven team committed to building a new layer of energy infrastructure: satellites in geosynchronous orbit that redirect solar energy to terrestrial solar projects via passively safe near-infrared light. We’re in the earliest phase, where every circuit board and harness that leaves our facility is designed, built, and tested end-to-end by a small, dedicated team. Headquartered in the Northern Virginia / Washington, DC area and backed by world-class investors, we are advancing the next generation of clean energy technology.

**About the Role**

We’re hiring an Electrical Engineer to design, build, and test the electronics behind our flight and ground hardware. You’ll report directly to our lead electrical engineer and work daily with our mechanical, embedded software, and systems engineers.

This is a generalist seat. One week you’re capturing a schematic and bringing up a new board on the bench. The next, you’re holding a supplier to its statement of work and checking that what ships matches what we specified.

This is built for someone a few years into their career who has already put real hardware on a bench and wants a far bigger slice of the system than a large prime can offer. The role is onsite daily at our Ashburn Virginia facility.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and capture schematics for analog, digital, and power boards: sensors, data acquisition, power delivery, and the interfaces between them.
* Select components, build BOMs, and see boards through fabrication and assembly.
* Bring up new PCBs with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and bench supplies, then debug and characterize them against requirements.
* Support systems engineering on requirements, architecture, and interfaces.
* Design and document wire harnesses and interconnects: wire gauge, connectors, pinouts, and interface control documents (ICDs).
* Manage electronics suppliers and contractors: review statements of work, track deliverables, and verify what arrives against spec.
* Run power budgets and first-pass thermal and EMI checks, applying derating and space-environment practices to every design.
* Write test procedures and scripts that automate measurements and data analysis.
* Drive hardware anomalies to root cause and close out corrective actions.
* Write complete design reports, ICDs, and test procedures, so the next engineer can pick up your work without a meeting.

**What We’re Looking For From You**

* B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 2–5+ years of hands-on electrical hardware experience. Internships and co-ops count, as does a substantial hardware program such as CubeSat, Formula SAE, solar car, hybrid/EV, rocketry, or UAV teams.
* At least one piece of hardware you designed, built, or tested end-to-end and can walk us through on a whiteboard.
* Solid fundamentals in analog and digital circuits, plus enough embedded experience to work with microcontrollers and common communication buses.
* Schematic capture experience in Altium, KiCad (preferred), or a similar tool.
* Comfort on the bench with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and power supplies.
* Some experience working with an external supplier or contractor, even a single one on a single program.
* Ability to work onsite at our Northern Virginia facility.

**We Have a Strong Preference For**

* Hardware that has flown, or a full program cycle in space, aerospace, UAV, or another high-reliability field.
* Exposure to environmental testing: vibration, shock, and thermal vacuum.
* Familiarity with circuit design in LTspice or related simulation platforms such as SIMetrix/SIMPLIS, PLECS, or Qspice
* Power electronics or battery system experience.
* Wire harness design and fabrication.
* Range across mechanical, electrical, and embedded work.

The salary band for this position is $110,000 - $150,000 commensurate with experience. Individuals with demonstrated exceptional ability may be considered beyond this band.

**Our Benefits**

We take care of our people. In addition to competitive salary and equity, Overview Energy offers comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, a health and wellness stipend, 4 weeks paid time off, 2 weeks sick leave, parental leave, and 401(k) matching. Benefits are subject to change at the Company's discretion.

Candidates must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer**  
  
Join Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions practice as a Microsoft Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant). You will help clients design, deploy, and support scalable Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365 F&O) and Power Platform environments that advance finance and supply chain transformation. You will collaborate with client business and technology leaders to establish secure application lifecycle management, DevOps, integration, and operational practices across complex engagements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.  
  
Work you'll do  
  
As a Microsoft D365/Power Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant) on the Emerging ERP Solutions team, you will be responsible for:  
  
Design and govern environment topology, routing, capacity, deployment standards, Data Loss Prevention policies, and managed-environment settings across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Dataverse, model-driven apps, and Power Automate; lead transitions from Lifecycle Services (LCS) to Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) deployment models.  
  
Architect and maintain Git-based application lifecycle management (ALM) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Power Platform Build Tools, solution packaging, automated solution checker gates, release controls, and rollback procedures.  
  
Lead client workshops, architecture reviews, and stakeholder discussions; document environment and architecture decisions in decision logs and runbooks; present trade-offs involving cost, governance, and delivery speed.  
  
Manage Azure integration services, including Service Bus, API Management (APIM), Storage Accounts, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and Application Insights; monitor batch jobs, workflows, integrations, and application performance; investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.  
  
Manage technical delivery across concurrent client engagements, mentor team members, maintain reusable assets, and evaluate governance implications of emerging Power Platform capabilities, including Code Apps, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and Copilot Studio agents.  
  
Participate in on-call and after-hours support as required.  
  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  
  
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  
  
Effective written and verbal communication skills  
  
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  
  
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  
  
Ability to lead projects or workstreams  
  
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  
  
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  
  
Ability to meet deadlines  
  
Ability to provide clear guidance to others  
  
Qualifications Required:  
  
6+ years of experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) or Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management (F&SCM), and Power Platform.  
  
Experience using Azure DevOps or GitHub-based continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for Dataverse solutions and Git workflows, including branching, pull requests, and conflict resolution.  
  
Experience using Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC), environment groups, managed environments, and Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS)-to-PPAC deployment transitions.  
  
Experience designing Dataverse solution architecture, including managed and unmanaged solution layering and use of the Power Platform Center of Excellence Starter Kit or Application Lifecycle Management Accelerator.  
  
Experience using Azure Portal and at least two of the following Azure services: API Management, Service Bus, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Key Vault, or Azure Functions.  
  
Experience leading client workshops, architecture reviews, or steering committee presentations.  
  
Experience managing technical delivery across two or more concurrent client engagements.  
  
You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.  
  
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.  
  
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.  
  
Preferred:  
  
Microsoft certifications: PL-600 (Solution Architect), MB-700 (F&SCM Solution Architect), MB-800, or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer).  
  
AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-204 (Azure Developer) certification.  
  
Experience with Dataverse Git integration and Power Platform Build Tools.  
  
Experience with Copilot Studio agent governance and AI Builder.  
  
Experience with dual-write or integration architectures connecting Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management or Customer Engagement to external systems through Service Bus or API Management.  
  
Experience creating environment and ALM decision records, operational support documentation, or runbooks.  
  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. jobs.description:
### **About Us**

AGE Solutions is a premier technology and professional services company, providing in-depth consulting, advanced technology solutions, and essential services throughout the U.S. government, defense, and intelligence sectors. Prioritizing innovation and client-focused solutions, we assist major agencies in addressing intricate issues and ensuring a more secure future.

We are seeking a **Systems Engineer** to support a DoD customer with storage and backup requirements across multiple on-premises and cloud environments. The selected candidate will provide engineering and administration support.

**Responsibilities Include:**

* Responsible for effective provisioning, operation, installation/configuration, and maintenance of systems hardware/software/related infrastructure.
* Provides technical support, guidance and hands-on delivery in the planning, implementation, and ongoing operations.
* Participates in technical research and development to enable continuing innovation within the infrastructure.
* Ensured that system hardware, operating systems, software systems, and related procedures adhere to organizational values and regulatory requirements.
* Documents specifications, project plans, configurations, test plans and results.
* Depicts complex ideas, issues, and designs to varied audiences; communicates project objectives, scope and status to project teams.
* Develops, integrates, and oversees storage arrays, fiber switches, backup solutions, and associated components.
* Monitors and reports on existing data restore and disaster recovery capabilities.
* Provides recommendations on process improvement/efficiencies.
* Maintains and oversees data backup solutions to ensure mission objective are met.
* Researches, builds, and implements file sharing technologies to meet customer requirements.
* Troubleshoots and advises on advanced storage issues/deficiencies.
* Performs routine equipment checks and preventative maintenance.
* Performs storage analysis, capacity planning, and performance planning of storage components.
* Authors and reviews operational procedures/documentation in relation to new and existing technologies.
* Authors/documents policies and procedures to support the operational storage environment and participates in the design and ongoing refinement of procedures and policies.
* Prepares reports on storage administration best practices, new technologies, etc., and recommends enhancements and configuration changes to improve and optimize existing storage technologies.

**Required Skills, Qualifications, and Experience:**

* **Experience:**
  + Three (3) years of overall professional experience in the engineering field. This includes evaluating, constructing, and integrating enterprise-level storage and backup software technologies.
  + Two (2) years hands-on experience with enterprise SAN (Storage Area Network) management to include capabilities and technologies such as: Fiber Channel zoning, iSCSI, FCoE (Fiber Channel over Ethernet) unified fabric, HBA/CNA (Host Bus Adapter/Converged Network Adapter), storage controllers, and LUN (Logical Unit Number), RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks), and file sharing / NAS (Network Addressable Storage).
  + Hands-on experience with enterprise hierarchical storage system management; operation of enterprise backup/restore services, using software such as Veritas NetBackup, Cohesity Cloud.
  + Two (2) years hands-on experience working with Department of War (DoW) IT systems.
* **Clearance:**
  + Top Secret Clearance or Secret Clearance with favorably adjudicated Tier 5/SSBI investigation.
* **Certifications:**
  + Must have a compliant DoD 8570 IAT II Certification such as: CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, Security+ CE, SSCP, CASP CE, CCNP Security, CISA, CISSP, GCED, or GCIH
  + Must also have one of the following current certifications:
    - AWS CSA Associate
    - AWS CSA Professional
    - GIAC GDSA
    - MC: Azure AA
    - MC: Azure SAE
    - NetApp Certified Data Administrator
    - NetApp Certified hybrid Cloud Implementation Engineer
    - NetApp Certified Hybrid Cloud Architect
    - NetApp Certified Hybrid Cloud Administrator
    - NetApp Certified Implementation Engineer - SAN Specialist, ONTAP
    - NetApp Certified Technology Associate
    - Pure Certified Data Storage Associate
    - Pure Certified FlashArrayTM Implementation Specialist
    - Veritas Certified Specialist – NetBackup
* **Location:**
  + Must reside within commutable distance of either Richmond, VA or Tracy, CA in order to work onsite full time.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certifications from multiple vendors including Pure, NetApp, Microsoft, AWS, and Google Cloud.

**Work Environment and Physical Demand:**

* Must be able to work from a computer for extended hours in an office environment and be able to work from comm closets when/as needed.

The projected salary range for this position is $110,000+ annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including years of relevant experience, active security clearance level, certifications, technical skillset, contract requirements, and overall qualifications.

**At AGE Solutions, we reward performance, invest in growth, and share success.** Our benefits support the whole person, professionally, financially, and personally.

* **26 Days Paid Leave:** Includes vacation, sick, personal time, and holidays. You choose how to use it.
* **Performance Bonuses:** Performance bonuses are awarded based on individual contributions and company-wide results, aligning recognition with impact.
* **401(k) with Match:** We match 3% of your contributions with immediate vesting.
* **Financial Protection:** Company-paid life insurance up to $300K and options for additional coverage for you and your dependents.
* **Health Benefits:** Multiple medical plans, dental, vision, FSA and HSA options to fit your needs.
* **Parental Leave:** 15 days of fully paid leave for new parents, because family matters.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.  
  
Amazon LEO is seeking a Senior Manufacturing And Automation Engineer to develop, automate, and scale manufacturing processes for complex aerospace hardware, including PCBAs, battery packs, LRUs, and associated components. This role is responsible for transforming prototype and manual manufacturing processes into scalable, reliable, and efficient production solutions. The successful candidate will lead manufacturing process development, automation equipment integration, process optimization, and production readiness, ensuring manufacturing systems meet quality, throughput, safety, and cost objectives.  
The ideal candidate combines strong manufacturing process engineering expertise with hands-on experience in industrial automation, equipment design, robotics, and production system integration.  
  
Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Manufacturing Process Development: Develop, optimize, and industrialize manufacturing processes for PCBA, battery pack, LRU, and component assembly, improving efficiency, repeatability, quality, and scalability.  
  
Manufacturing Automation: Design, develop, and implement automated and semi-automated production systems incorporating robotics, PLCs, motion control, machine vision, sensors, and industrial controls.  
  
Equipment and Tooling Development: Define requirements and lead the design, fabrication, integration, and commissioning of manufacturing equipment, fixtures, tooling, and automated assembly stations.  
Process Capability and Optimization: Establish manufacturing process parameters, implement process controls, and apply PFMEA, DOE, SPC, and capability analysis to improve yield, reduce variation, and eliminate defects.  
  
Production Scalability: Develop manufacturing strategies and automation solutions to increase production capacity, reduce cycle time, minimize manual operations, and support production ramp-up.  
Equipment Integration and Qualification: Lead equipment acceptance, commissioning, process validation, and production release, ensuring manufacturing systems meet performance, safety, and reliability requirements.  
  
Manufacturing Troubleshooting: Lead root cause investigations of manufacturing defects, equipment failures, and process inefficiencies, implementing sustainable corrective actions.  
  
Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Design Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, Quality, Test Engineering, and suppliers to improve manufacturability, implement process automation, and transition products into production.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
* Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related STEM field

* Experience developing and implementing manufacturing processes, automated equipment, or assembly systems.
* Hands-on experience with industrial automation technologies such as PLCs, robotics, sensors, motion control, or machine vision.
* Experience with manufacturing process troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or equivalent
* Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
* Experience with the project management of technical projects

* Risk Management & Trade Studies: Conduct trade studies to evaluate design alternatives, assess technical risks, and ensure the best engineering solutions for mission effectiveness.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, autonomy, software, propulsion, and flight operations teams to drive seamless system integration and rapid development cycles.

* 5+ years of experience in systems engineering for aerospace, defense, or autonomous aircraft systems.
* Demonstrated experience defining system behavior logic and operational modes
* Deep expertise in system architecture, avionics integration, and autonomy-driven flight systems.
* Proficiency in MBSE, DOORS, SysML, CAMEO, or similar system modeling tools for complex systems design and analysis.

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive complex projects to successful completion.

jobs.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft is the world’s center of expertise on topological quantum computing. We are building a scaled, fault‑tolerant quantum computer grounded in topological qubits and integrated end‑to‑end with the Azure Quantum software stack.

As a **Senior Quantum Systems Electrical Engineer**, you’ll collaborate closely with quantum physicists, systems software, RF/EE, and manufacturing/production to help define, design, and deliver FPGA‑based, ultra‑low‑latency digital subsystems that sit at the heart of our topological quantum engine—spanning readout classification, error‑decoder acceleration, room‑temperature front‑ends for cryogenic control, high‑speed interconnects, and precision clocking networks. Your work will directly impact logical‑qubit stability, throughput, and system scale.

At Microsoft Quantum, we aim to empower science and scientists to solve the world’s biggest problems by realizing advanced computing platforms at the intersection of high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and quantum information technology. Microsoft Quantum will change the world of computing and help solve some of humankind’s currently unsolvable problems. For more information about our team, visit https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/quantum.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

**The Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) has an outstanding opportunity for a Signal Processor/Software Engineer 3 to join the Environmental and Information Systems Department.**

**About this Opportunity**

Reporting to the Senior Engineer, the Signal Processor/Software Engineer 3 will be an integral member of the signal processing group within EIS. The incumbent will contribute by developing complex specialty software for engineering research programs, with a focus on imaging sonar array beamforming and detection, classification, localization, and tracking of targets in sonar applications, and sensor processing for autonomous systems. The candidate will be responsible for updating the existing codebase as well as designing, developing, and coding new applications. They will convert MATLAB algorithms to run on real-time systems. They will participate in design reviews, code reviews, and generate test plans to ensure the quality of code.

The top candidate must be able to work both independently and tightly coupled with the team in an agile environment. The candidate should be well-versed in software development and testing tools such as Git for version control, bug tracking tools, performance and system monitoring tools, and debugging tools. The candidate will also be expected to be disciplined in using the project-defined coding conventions and interface documentation techniques.

This position will work with the system architects when creating parts of the applications to make sure they meet the desired goals. jobs.description:
**About Helion**

We are a fusion power company based in Everett, WA, with the mission to build the world's first fusion power plant, enabling a future with unlimited clean electricity. Our vision is a world with clean, reliable, and affordable energy for everyone.  
  
Since Helion's founding in 2013, we have raised $1.5 billion from long-time investors such as Sam Altman, Mithril, and Capricorn Investment Group as well as new investors including Thrive Capital, LightSpeed Venture Capital, SoftBank, and others to propel us forward. Our current prototype, Polaris, has reached record-breaking plasma temperatures of 150 million degrees Celsius (13 keV). Helion is continuing to iterate and on the path to the world's first fusion power plant, Orion.  
  
This is a pivotal time to join Helion. You will tackle real-world challenges with a team that prizes urgency, rigor, ownership, and a commitment to delivering hard truths – values essential to achieving what no one has before. Together, we will change the future of energy, because the world can't wait.

**What You Will Be Doing:**

You will drive the design and development of cutting-edge semiconductors for high-performance pulsed power systems used in Helion’s fusion generators. You will work in a fast-paced environment to develop, test, and implement high-reliability, high-efficiency switching components, with a strong emphasis on rapid development cycles. You will report directly to our Senior Manager of Electrical Engineering, and this is an onsite role located at our Everett, WA office.

**You Will:**

* Spearhead efforts to gather and utilize requirements for switching components and apply them toward design of physical products
* Drive the design and development of novel pulsed power electronics components and systems, focusing on high-efficiency, high-reliability semiconductor solutions
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure integration of electrical, mechanical, and physics-based principles in semiconductor development
* Lead development cycles, including hands-on prototyping, small-scale testing, and large-scale performance validation
* Conduct simulations, testing, and analysis to validate designs and iterate quickly using data-backed decision making
* Stay informed on emerging semiconductor materials, device architectures, and industry trends
* Document design processes, specifications, test results, and findings for continuous improvement and knowledge sharing

**Required Skills:**

* Bachelor’s, Master’s, or higher degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in power electronics and high voltage semiconductor design
* Strong foundation in semiconductor physics, power electronics, and circuit design principles
* Proven experience with rapid prototyping and development cycles in a high-tech environment
* Background working with semiconductor fabricators to manufacture semiconductor devices
* Proficiency with simulation tools and test equipment for power electronics

jobs.title: Senior Security Software Engineer EDR
jobs.description:
The Detection team within Apple Services Engineering (ASE) is responsible for finding any threat actors attacking approximately three quarters of Apple's systems and services. We do this by partnering closely with engineering teams to build a deep technical understanding of how their systems work, and a comprehensive understanding of the threats against them.  
  
A growing part of that mission is the endpoint detection and response (EDR) technology we build ourselves. It is a Swift-based agent that runs on Linux (x86 and ARM64) and on Apple operating systems running on Apple silicon. It collects security telemetry, evaluates detections directly on the host, and takes response action on the host. It also supports Apple's Private Cloud Compute (PCC), the system that extends the privacy and security of Apple devices into the cloud and runs the larger models behind Apple Intelligence. Most of your work will be on Apple's own internal servers, and some of it supports public-facing products used by hundreds of millions of people.  
  
**Description**  
  
We are looking for an exceptional engineer to help us grow this agent to protect a very large fleet, and to do it without ever taking production down. You will bring two things at once: the engineering depth to ship new capabilities quickly, and a reliability mindset that treats every release as something that runs on production hosts. You will take vague, high-stakes problems and turn them into working software, working with other teams to find out what to build and how. This is not a role where you will be handed pre-defined tickets.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Experience building or operating endpoint, host or agent software deployed at large scale, with performance and availability objectives.  
  
Experience with eBPF, EndpointSecurity or similar OS-level instrumentation, and an understanding of how those mechanisms can be evaded or disabled.  
  
Experience with Swift on server, concurrency in Swift, and cross-platform builds.  
  
Understanding of EDR or host-based detection techniques and the current industry state of the art.  
  
Experience with policy-driven detection logic (for example OPA/Rego), and with statistical techniques such as probabilistic data structures for bounded-memory anomaly detection.  
  
Experience with virtualization and hypervisor environments.  
  
Experience building CI/CD and release tooling for software deployed to hosts, including staged rollout and rollback.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
  
7+ years of professional experience building, shipping and supporting production software or system software.  
  
Personal proficiency, in at least one high-level or scripting language (Python or Rust) and at least one low-level systems language (C or C++).  
  
Solid knowledge of operating system internals (processes, threads, memory, system calls, namespaces). Linux, macOS or both.  
  
Credible understanding of attacker behavior and security concepts, and of how malicious activity shows up in host telemetry such as process, network and file events.  
  
**Pay & Benefits**  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,000 and $308,500, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - MDASH
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate.

The **MDASH team** is reimagining how organizations identify and remediate vulnerabilities in source code. Using AI agents and models, MDASH analyzes code to determine whether potential vulnerabilities are real and reachable, provides developers with actionable fixes, and helps verify that vulnerabilities have been successfully addressed.

We’re looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to help build and evolve the MDASH scanning engine as we work to advance agentic code scanning. In this role, you’ll design and build systems that coordinate AI agents and models to analyze complex codebases, scale across programming languages and frameworks, validate security findings, generate high-quality fixes, and deliver reliable, efficient performance in production environments.

You’ll work closely with security researchers, applied scientists, model teams, and product managers to turn new techniques and evaluation insights into product capabilities. We’re looking for an engineer with experience building complex, large-scale systems, foundational knowledge of application security, and excitement about using AI to solve challenging problems in software security.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Design, build, and evolve the MDASH scanning engine, including agent orchestration, multi-model routing, code understanding, vulnerability detection, reachability validation, and fix generation and verification.
* Extend the engine's coverage across vulnerability classes, programming languages, frameworks, build systems, and codebase sizes, from single services to large monorepos.
* Integrate program analysis techniques into agent workflows to make detections more precise and grounded. These include static and dynamic analysis, taint tracking, call-graph and data-flow analysis, fuzzing, and sandboxed execution.
* Improve the engine's precision, recall, consistency, and fix quality, working from evaluation results, research findings, and production feedback.
* Optimize scan performance, scalability, cost, and latency so MDASH works well on enterprise-scale codebases and in CI/CD workflows.
* Build a secure, reliable, observable engine, with strong isolation for running untrusted code and clear telemetry for diagnosing agent behavior.
* Work with security research, applied science, model, and product teams to bring new techniques and models into the engine quickly and safely.
* Track the agentic security and code-scanning landscape, and bring forward ideas that make MDASH stand out against competitors.
* Write high-quality, well-tested code. Lead design reviews, take part in code reviews and on-call rotations, and help raise the engineering bar for the team.
* Mentor other engineers and model Microsoft values to help build an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
  + OR equivalent experience.

**Other Requirements**: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* **Microsoft Cloud Background Check:** This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
  + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python
  + OR equivalent experience.
* Experience building production systems with large language models, such as AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, planning, context management, or code-understanding systems.
* Experience building or working on security scanners, static analysis (SAST), dynamic analysis (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), compilers, or other program analysis tools.
* Working knowledge of vulnerability classes such as memory safety, injection, authentication and authorization, deserialization, path traversal, SSRF, and business-logic flaws.
* Experience with program analysis techniques such as taint analysis, data-flow and control-flow analysis, code property graphs, fuzzing, or symbolic execution.
* Experience building distributed, high-scale cloud services on Azure, including containerized or sandboxed execution.
* Familiarity with multiple software ecosystems and build systems across C/C

**Job Summary**

The Electrical Engineer will support gas, coal, renewable, and new-generation self-build projects by defining electrical design-basis requirements and supporting the technical specification, engineering, procurement, integration, and commissioning of power generation electrical systems. A required focus of this role is advanced knowledge of utility-scale power plant electrical systems and equipment, including generators, generator step-up transformers (GSUs), medium- and low-voltage distribution systems, switchgear, motor control centers (MCCs), protective relaying, grounding systems, black-start systems, auxiliary power systems, and grid interconnection requirements.  
This role collaborates with Architect & Engineering (A/E) and Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) firms and coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure electrical designs meet performance, reliability, maintainability, constructability, safety, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements. The engineer will participate in RFx/OEM engagements, support self-build proposals, and provide construction, commissioning, startup, and lifecycle support across the generation portfolio.

**What you’ll do:**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support development of electrical design-basis and equipment requirements (generators, transformers, switchgear, station service, UPS/DC, cabling).
* Assist with power system studies and data preparation (load flow, short‑circuit, protection coordination, arc‑flash, harmonics) under senior review.

* Familiarity with power system study tools and analysis methods.
* Experience reviewing vendor drawings and RFx responses.
