jobs.description:
Job Description
  
  
**Job Title:** AI/ML Software Engineer, Fairbanks Morse Technology
  
  
**Reports To:** Electrical and Controls Engineering Manager
  
  
**Location:** Beloit, WI (full-time, on-site)
  
  
Summary
  
Fairbanks Morse Technology’s goal is to create secure, mission-driven, advanced, and reliable technology solutions through artificial intelligence, digital technology, smart engineering solutions, automation, and Advanced IoT Solutions.
  
  
FMT is looking for an AI/ML Software Engineer to design and build complete software products from customer requirements. This is a developer role for someone who can gather and write down what the customer needs, then build the full application that meets it, and who designs it so it can be reused and expanded to other equipment, customers, and use cases.
  
  
This rolls will focus is applying AI/ML to predictive maintenance, root cause analysis, and driving action to fix the problem automatically, starting with U.S. Navy shipboard equipment. We are looking for someone who uses AI development tools safely and effectively to deliver working products quickly.
  
  
Principal Duties and Responsibilities
  

* Work with customers and stakeholders to gather requirements, document them clearly, and turn them into a technical plan.
* Design and build full applications (backend, APIs, data pipelines, and user interface) that meet those requirements.
* Architect products to be modular and reusable so they can expand to other assets, customers, and situations without a rewrite.
* Develop and deploy AI/ML solutions for predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and root cause analysis.
* Connect detection and diagnosis to action by building workflows that recommend or trigger the fix, such as guided maintenance, work orders, or automated responses.
* Use AI coding assistants and tools to build and iterate quickly, while reviewing, testing, and securing all AI-generated work.
* Integrate with sensors, controllers, historians, and customer or third-party systems, including in disconnected edge environments.
* Write tests and documentation, use CI/CD, and build with security and compliance requirements (STIG, NIST, RMF) from the start.
* Demonstrate work to customers and stakeholders and keep them informed of progress and risks.
* Any other duties as the job requires.

Qualifications and Educational Requirements
  
Required
  

* BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience, including full-stack or full-application delivery from requirements through deployment.
* Proven ability to take an unclear customer need, define the requirements, and deliver a working, tested product.
* Strong Python and at least one other language such as C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or C++.
* Experience building REST APIs, data pipelines, databases, and web user interfaces.
* Hands-on experience applying machine learning in production, such as anomaly detection, classification, or time-series analysis, using tools like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
* Experience using AI coding tools to speed up development, with sound judgment on testing, code review, and protecting sensitive data.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, Docker, and a major cloud platform (Azure preferred).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical trade-offs to customers and leadership.
* Ability to work independently and quickly in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
* This position requires access or potential access to Unclassified Naval Nuclear Propulsion Information, which is Not Releasable to Foreign Nationals (NOFORN) data. Therefore, to meet NOFORN requirement, you will have to provide proof of US Citizenship and attest that you do not have dual citizenship. Acceptable proof of US Citizenship is a US Passport, US Birth Certificate or Naturalization Certificate.

Preferred
  

* Experience with predictive maintenance, condition-based maintenance (CBM+), or prognostics and health management.
* Experience with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic workflows.
* Experience with industrial data sources and protocols such as PLCs, OPC UA, Modbus, or MQTT.
* Experience supporting U.S. Navy or Department of Defense programs, including Azure Government Cloud and RMF, STIG, and NIST requirements.
* Edge or embedded deployment experience on disconnected hardware.
* Cross-platform mobile development experience (for example .NET MAUI).

This specification is intended to indicate the kinds of tasks and levels of work difficulty that will be required of positions that will be given this title and shall not be construed as declaring what the specific duties and responsibilities of any particular position shall be. It is not intended to limit or in any way modify the right of any supervisor to assign, direct, and control the work of employees under his/her supervision. Ability to competently perform all the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, demonstrated commitment to effective customer service delivery, and the ability to work productively as a member of a team or work group are basic requirements of all positions at Fairbanks Morse Defense.

* Define and maintain verification and validation strategies, including mapping of system and software requirements to test plans and procedures.
* Develop and review test plans, procedures, and cases, ensuring they provide adequate coverage of requirements and key operational scenarios.
* Support integration and system test activities, including anomaly investigation, root cause analysis, and requirements-focused corrective actions.
* Work closely with test engineers to evaluate test results, confirm requirement satisfaction, and improve test effectiveness and traceability.

* Ensure systems engineering and requirements artifacts are properly baselined, controlled, and integrated with configuration management tools and processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve requirements management, architecture practices, and verification workflows, and help implement process and tool enhancements.
* Support customer interactions and technical presentations, clearly communicating requirements rationale, system capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs.

TriVector Services, Inc. provides quality aerospace engineering solutions to complex problems through a renowned team of engineering professionals. TriVector Services, Inc., is seeking qualified candidates to fill our **Electrical Engineering Technician IV** position.

The Electrical Engineering Technician level IV (Service Contract Act (SCA) Occupation Code 30080) support NASA - Marshall Space Flight Center must be able to provide semi-professional technical support for engineers working in such areas as research, design, development, testing, or manufacturing process improvement. Work pertains to electrical, electronic, or mechanical components or equipment. These technicians are required to have some practical knowledge of science or engineering. * Operate and maintain electrical, electronic, and instrumentation equipment used in laboratory, fabrication, integration, and test environments.
* Perform verification, calibration, maintenance, and functional checkout of instrumentation, sensors, measurement systems, and associated support equipment.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* U.S. Citizenship is required.
* Must have at least 5 years of relevant experience.
* Requires ability to obtain and maintain NASA Public Trust background screening requirements.

* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and workmanship.
* Must be able to pass a MSFC physical examination for any required safety-related certifications.

Design and govern environment topology, routing, capacity, deployment standards, Data Loss Prevention policies, and managed-environment settings across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Dataverse, model-driven apps, and Power Automate; lead transitions from Lifecycle Services (LCS) to Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) deployment models.

new_jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be availableCLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: NoCLEARANCE TYPE: SecretTRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Sr. Principal Electrical Engineer 4 – Automated Test Equipment (ATE)

Northrop Grumman Space Systems is currently seeking an experienced Principal Electrical Engineer to join our electrical ground support equipment group in our Chandler, AZ facility. The Automated Test Equipment (ATE) team supports our programs with the design, test, and sustainment of all ATE and test support equipment hardware used in the integration and launch of our vehicles. Our EGSE team members work in a diverse set of roles across the lifecycle of a program.

Job Duties: Based on specific objectives, work with a system electrical engineering team to perform analysis, design, and test of complex “system level” designs with a focus on the electrical ground support equipment and test support equipment for the launch vehicle.

Job responsibilities:

  

* Broad understanding and application of company electrical engineering technical standards.
* Broad technical expertise and working knowledge of other related disciplines.
* Prepares and presents electrical engineering materials for Requirements and Design Reviews.
* With minimal guidance, studies basic design concepts and criteria for more complex problems.
* Applies electrical engineering principles to adapt or improve upon heritage features from previous successful designs of a similar nature.
* Actively and effectively participates and contributes in a positive manner while supporting team decisions and goals.
* Makes an extra effort to provide quality internal and external customer service.
* Constantly seeks new sources of information and provides information necessary to meet customer needs.
* Disciplined with escalation when required.
* Derives requirements through multiple sources of documentation and design meetings.
* Evaluate, with supervision, uncertainty and risks associated with requirements and designs.
* Patriciate in trade studies for both internal projects and procured equipment.
* Act with safety as your number one priority through every aspect of the role.
* Provides formal peer review of simple engineering designs or analyses for less experienced engineers.
* Completing day-to-day activities with no oversight of senior engineers.

Desired Experience:

  

* Design, test, and/or integration and deployment of electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) or test support equipment (TSE).
* Design, test, programming, and/or integration and deployment of automated test equipment (ATE).
* Testing of avionics, electronic components, or electrical systems using purpose designed test equipment.
* Burndown of nonconformances and/or root cause failure analysis of electronic systems.
* Release of engineering documentation including technical drawings, specifications, and test procedures.
* Leading teams or personnel in the execution of test procedures.
* Leading teams or personnel in the design of electronic equipment.
* Management or tracking of projects through a product life cycle.
* Support of manufacturing engineering during the production of test equipment products.
* Experience with telemetry systems including decoms and chapter 10 recorders.
* Development or support of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) or other integrations labs.
* Problem solving not only for technical issues, but also for schedule, cost, resource and other project challenges.
* Mentoring and cross-training team members across a diverse set of technologies and equipment architectures used to meet customer requirements.
* Knowledgeable with the use of basic test equipment such as power supplies, oscilloscopes, DMMs, and electronic loads.
* Broad or high-level circuit design and analysis.

Also seeking experience in any of the following:

  

* LabVIEW/TestStand programming and NI hardware and software products.
* Contributions to process improvement initiatives.
* CompTIA Security+ or similar certifications.
* Usage and troubleshooting of networks, Windows systems, and RHEL or other Linux distributions.
* Experience with classified test systems or systems subject to cyber security policies.

Basic Qualifications for Sr. Principal Electrical Engineer - 4

  

* Requires 8 years with a Bachelor’s in Engineering or 5 years with a Master’s in Engineering.
* Ability to obtain U.S. Government Secret Clearance at time of application.
* U.S. Citizenship is required
* Proficient knowledge of electrical engineering principles.
* Design, Test, or Integration experience with EGSE or similar equipment.
* Experience with processes applicable to operating EGSE in secure environments.

**Position Purpose & Focus**

The **Senior Systems Engineer** leads the definition of system architecture, interface standards, and product requirements for Phillips Connect's connected trailer and fleet telematics products. Operating at the PM4 Senior Professional level, this role's core focus is the launch of new product lines from concept to mass production. The Senior Systems Engineer owns embedded system and IoT device-to-cloud architecture across multiple product platforms, harmonizes interfaces across current and future designs, serves as a technical knowledge resource across functions, and mentors Systems Engineers.

This position partners closely with Hardware Engineering, Firmware Engineering, Test Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, and the Commercial team to ensure Phillips Connect systems are scalable, reliable, testable, and aligned with customer and business needs.

**Expected Results**

* System architectures and interface standards that scale across multiple product platforms
* Complete, prioritized product requirements that enable on-schedule launch of new product lines from concept to mass production
* Harmonized interfaces across current and future designs that reduce development and validation time
* Vendor-ready protocol library specifications with clear release testing requirements
* System-level verification and validation strategies that reduce field issues and release risk
* Effective cross-functional alignment and development of Systems Engineers through mentoring

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
=======================================

* **System Architecture Leadership**

* Lead the definition of system and software architectures for embedded platforms across multiple product lines.
* Define the partitioning of functions across MCUs, hardware, firmware, and cloud systems, including the roles and responsibilities of each MCU.
* Lead system architecture and interface reviews, and make trade-off decisions balancing performance, power, cost, reliability, and schedule.
* Verify that architectures and interfaces meet timing, throughput, and frame/packet size requirements for all use cases.

* **Interface Standards & Harmonization**

* Establish standardized microprocessor interfaces and interconnects between printed circuit board assemblies.
* Update existing interfaces to harmonize current and future designs, leveraging reusable design components to speed development.
* Own protocol library requirements and the release testing requirements for libraries distributed to vendors.

* **Requirements Leadership**

* Lead the translation of commercial requirements into firmware and system product requirements for new product lines from concept to mass production.
* Define and propose algorithms based on commercial requirements, and resolve requirement conflicts across functions.
* Establish requirements traceability from commercial needs through design, verification, and release.

* **IoT & Connectivity Architecture**

* Lead the definition of IoT device-to-cloud protocols, data payloads, and client/server interfaces in partnership with Cloud Engineering.
* Ensure device-to-cloud interfaces are secure, efficient, scalable, and supportable across product generations.

* **Verification & Validation Strategy**

* Define system-level verification and validation strategies, monitoring and test interfaces, and release criteria for firmware features.
* Lead system-level root cause analysis of complex integration and field issues with Firmware, Hardware, Test Engineering, and Technical Support.

* **Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement**

* Mentor and develop Systems Engineers, and serve as a technical knowledge resource for Firmware and Hardware Engineering.
* Facilitate communication to align design teams on standard interfaces, and present concise technical recommendations to engineering leadership.
* Recommend and implement improvements to systems engineering processes, documentation standards, and tools, and publish and archive technical requirements and analysis.

*The above is intended to describe the general content of and the requirements for the performance of this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements.*

**Experience, Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities**
================================================

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field required.
* Master's degree is preferred.

**Experience**

* 5–8+ years of systems engineering experience, including hardware and software design and development.
* Demonstrated experience defining system architecture and requirements for commercial embedded products from concept through production.
* Experience leading interface standardization or architecture efforts across multiple products or platforms.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Experience with telematics, IoT, connected vehicle, or industrial embedded systems preferred.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Advanced system architecture and design for embedded platforms
* Requirements engineering, traceability, and requirements management practices
* Embedded communication interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, CAN/J1939, EIA-485)
* IoT device-to-cloud protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, MQTT), data payload design, and secure networking fundamentals
* Architecture trade studies and timing, throughput, and power budget analysis
* System verification and validation strategy

new_jobs.title: Sr Embedded Engineer, Vehicle Diagnostics and Monitoring
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match.  
  
Our AV Labs Hardware team is building the next-generation E/E architecture for our L4 data-collection vehicle fleet. A fleet only collects useful data when its compute, MCU and sensors work reliably in the car, and when a fault can be found and fixed without a technician on site. You will build the diagnostics, monitoring and dashboards that make fleet health visible, from MCU and SoC firmware to fleet dashboards, and you will bring our hardware to life in vehicles and support the path to production-line testing.  
  
**What the Candidate Will Do**  

* **Diagnostics and fault management:** Design and implement fault detection, event and DTC handling, UDS and DoIP services, and watchdog supervision across the MCU and the Linux compute platform.
* **Monitoring framework:** Design and own the vehicle health monitoring pipeline: collect metrics, logs and fault events from the MCU (CAN, serial or UDP) and the Linux SoC, and send them to a central time-series and log store using standard tooling (for example Prometheus exporters or OpenTelemetry collectors).
* **Deep system observability:** Use eBPF and kernel tracing to observe Linux SoC behavior with low overhead: scheduling, network, driver and camera pipeline latency, and frame or packet drops.
* **Dashboards and alerting:** Build dashboards (for example in Grafana) for fleet, vehicle and board health: temperatures, voltages, power state, bus load, time sync offset, camera link status and update status. Define alert rules and thresholds, and route alerts to on-call.
* **Vehicle bring-up and integration:** Commission the compute, MCU and sensor stack in vehicles (CAN-FD, Ethernet, power sequencing, GNSS, IMU, cameras) and validate gPTP and PPS timing.
* **Field triage and test automation:** Use monitoring data to reproduce and root-cause vehicle issues with the reliability and software teams, and turn each one into an automated regression test and, where useful, a new dashboard panel or alert.
* **Safety and security of diagnostics:** Contribute to safety analysis (FMEA, FMEDA) and implement safety mechanisms. Protect diagnostic access with authenticated sessions and security access.
* **Production line support:** Define the diagnostic interfaces and readouts (unit identity, firmware versions, pass or fail data) that end-of-line test stations use, with the manufacturing test team.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* **Embedded experience:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, with 7+ years developing embedded software in C/C++ on an RTOS, embedded Linux or bare metal.
* **Automotive diagnostics:** Hands-on experience with UDS (ISO 14229), DTC handling and ISO-TP over CAN; DoIP (ISO 13400) is a plus.
* **Vehicle networks and integration:** Strong experience with CAN/CAN-FD and Automotive Ethernet, tools such as Vector CANoe or similar, oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, and integrating compute platforms and sensors in vehicles.
* **Linux observability:** Hands-on experience debugging system-level issues on embedded Linux with eBPF-based tools and profilers (for example bpftrace, bcc or perf).
* **Monitoring and visualization:** Experience building monitoring for devices or fleets (for example with Prometheus and Grafana): instrumentation or exporters, dashboards and alert rules, in Python, Go or C/C++.
* **Production lifecycle:** Experience taking embedded systems from prototype and third-party integration to production, ideally in autonomous vehicle, robotics or mission-critical automotive domains.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* **Observability stack:** Experience with log and time-series stacks (for example Loki, ELK, OpenTelemetry, InfluxDB), eBPF-based observability tools, and fleet-scale telemetry pipelines (retention, cardinality, cost).
* **Security:** Hardware security module (HSM) and secure boot experience, plus secure diagnostics (UDS security access, authenticated sessions, key management).
* **AUTOSAR diagnostics:** Configuring Dcm, Dem, FiM, WdgM and E2E modules in an AUTOSAR Classic stack.
* **Functional safety:** ISO 26262 (ASIL B through D), ASPICE and MISRA C/C++.
* **Production and service tooling:** End-of-line test, factory programming or remote service diagnostics tooling.
* **Linux and AV compute:** Linux kernel, device tree and Yocto board support, and experience with platforms such as NVIDIA DRIVE or Jetson.

new_jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Xona is the navigational intelligence company bringing real-time, centimeter-level certainty to any device, anywhere on Earth.

With Pulsar – the world’s most advanced PNT satellite infrastructure in Low Earth Orbit – Xona will offer a future-proof, backwards-compatible global positioning system optimized for absolute precision, superior power, and robust protection.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an **Electrical Engineer** to join our satellite development team. In this role, you will design, develop, and integrate electrical systems that power and control spacecraft propulsion systems, working closely with engineers from other subsystems to integrate your designs from concept through flight.

This is a hands-on, collaborative role where you’ll lead electrical hardware design, lab testing, and debugging across low-to-high voltage subsystems. This includes embedded microcontroller hardware, power tree design, precision sensor acquisition, valve drivers, and dedicated DC/DC converters. You will work alongside firmware and power electronics engineers and collaborate closely with propulsion and avionics teams to ensure hardware reliability in harsh space environments.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Hardware Design:** Design and develop electrical subsystems for propulsion electronics, including embedded microcontroller hardware, sensor interfaces, valve drivers, and power conversion.
* **PCB Development:** Lead schematic capture and multi-layer PCB layout design from breadboard prototypes to flight hardware.
* **Power & Driver Stages:** Design, tune, and validate DC/DC converters and driver stages for inductive and resistive loads.
* **Analog Acquisition:** Implement precision analog front-ends for critical telemetry, including current sensing (high-side/low-side), pressure transducers, and temperature monitoring.
* **Firmware Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with embedded firmware engineers to define hardware/firmware interfaces, peripheral pin mappings, register maps, and communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, RS-422).
* **Reviews & Quality:** Conduct hardware design and layout reviews. Support component sourcing while ensuring compliance with standards and derating guidelines.
* **Testing & Automation:** Develop and execute electrical test plans from breadboard to flight hardware, writing Python scripts for test automation and data logging.
* **Lab Debugging:** Troubleshoot and debug electrical systems in a lab environment using test equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, electronic dynamic loads, power meters).
* **Documentation:** Develop electrical interface documentation (ICDs) and test procedures for spacecraft subsystems.
* **Integration Support:** Support assembly, integration, and test (AIT) activities, including environmental testing (e.g., TVAC, vibration, EMI/EMC).

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 2+ years taking mixed-signal designs from schematics to manufacturing and lab bring-up.
* **EDA & Modeling:** Familiarity with electrical design and simulation tools (e.g., Altium, KiCad, SPICE).
* **Core Technical:** Fundamental understanding of mixed-signal electronics, power tree design, power conversion, signal integrity, and hardware reliability in harsh space environments.
* **Embedded HW:** Hands-on experience designing embedded microcontroller hardware and peripheral interfaces (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, RS-422).
* **Power Electronics:** Experience designing driver circuits for inductive loads (valves, valve drivers, solenoids) and closed-loop DC/DC converters. High-voltage power electronics experience is a plus.
* **Analog Design:** Strong background in precision sensor acquisition and analog signal conditioning (op-amps, filtering, ADC/DAC interfacing).
* **Lab Validation:** Hands-on experience with electrical testing, debugging (oscilloscopes, dynamic loads, power meters), and Python test scripting.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to satellite systems, avionics, or electrical power systems.
* Experience with space environmental testing (e.g., TVAC, vibration, EMI/EMC per MIL-STD-461) and component derating standards (e.g., NASA EEE-INST-002).
* Experience developing hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulators
* Familiarity with reading embedded C/C++ to collaborate seamlessly with firmware engineers during low-level driver bring-up and boundary-scan debugging.

**For U.S. Roles:** To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States (i.e. Green Card holder), or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

**For U.K. Roles:** To comply with U.K. regulations, this role requires Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) checks, and successful candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC).

**For Canada Roles:** Successful candidates must obtain and hold a security clearance at the reliability status level, and pass security assessment for the Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and ITAR.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Compensation Range: $140K - $185K

new_jobs.title: Senior Mission Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**About Varda**
---------------

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

**About This Role**
-------------------

The **Senior Mission Software Engineer** is responsible for Varda's critical ground segment software, and the platform it runs on which enables spacecraft operations. We operate at the intersection of telemetry and commanding, data acquisition and distribution, mission control interfaces, simulation and test automation, with reliable deployment across lab, test range, and mission operations environments. You'll work hands-on with flight software, avionics, RF/ground systems, and mission ops.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Own Ground Segment Services:** Develop and maintain high-reliability services for telemetry ingestion, scaling, distribution, and commanding. Ensure deterministic behavior for real-time operations and post-flight analysis.
* **Mission Control Interfaces:** Deliver operator-grade UIs and dashboards that optimize "ops time" and reduce cognitive load across integration, test, and on-orbit operations phases.
* **Simulation and Test Automation:** Build tools to run flight-software simulations, device emulators, and scenario-based automated tests - enabling fast, safe iteration for avionics, GNC, and operations teams.
* **Build the Mission Platform***:* Design, implement, and productionize software for mission and ground software teams. Standardize CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, service templates, infrastructure-as-code, simulation and hardware-in-the-loop frameworks, test harnesses, and observability - all delivered as self-service tooling.
* **Deployments Across Environments:** Create robust deployment patterns for lab benches, test stands, and mission networks. Implement safe rollout/rollback strategies and air-gapped or limited-connectivity deployment approaches.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.
* 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.
* Expertise with development in Python, along with a strong understanding of the language concepts.
* Have strong systems fundamentals: concurrency, networking, performance, reliability.
* Experience building real-time data acquisition, scaling, and distribution services - low-latency messaging, time-series and relational stores.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD, dependency/build systems, and infrastructure-as-code.
* End-to-end observability experience: logging, metrics, tracing.
* Docker/Kubernetes; release management, phased rollouts, and operational readiness for controlled networks.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------

* Proficiency in C++, Ansible, and/or NiceGUI.
* Experience with DAQ and closed-loop control (lab/test control environments).
* Prior work on CI/testing/simulation/data tools integrated with flight software teams.
* Experience with requirements, test, and certification artifacts from safety-critical or certified workflows.
* Knowledge of ground systems standards; security in mission networks.
* Experience building mission-grade UIs with structured command workflows, alarming, and situational awareness.

**Pay Range**
-------------

* Salary range: Senior Software: $169,067 - $216,031/ per year.

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Mission System’s Engineering and Sciences (E&S) Baltimore and Partnered Sites (BaPs) Division is seeking a Principal Systems Engineer to join our team of qualified and diverse individuals at our Melbourne, FL campus. The Melbourne FL team primarily supports UAV systems such as the Global Hawk and NATO AGS. Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is a trusted provider of mission-enabling solutions for global security. Our organization is chartered by providing the skills and innovative technologies to develop, design, produce, and sustain optimized product lines across the sector while providing a decisive advantage to the warfighter. This position will be in Melbourne, FL, and is a full-time on-site role.

**What You’ll Get To Do****:**

We are an established signal processing and data analysis organization providing solutions to challenging Moving Target Indication (MTI), Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), and other embedded software challenges. Our Systems Engineers are responsible for the development of sensor system modes and advanced signal- and data-processing algorithms, from mathematical/analytical derivation through testing and verification using simulated and real sensor data. Included are topics such as mode design and statistical analysis of system performance.

* Conduct performance analysis of flight data from multiple radar platforms.
* Develop and maintain analysis tools using languages such as MATLAB, LabVIEW, Python, and C++.
* Utilize collaboration and configuration tools including SharePoint, Jira, Confluence, and IBM ClearCase/ClearQuest.
* Perform SAR imagery analysis to assess and improve system performance.
* Prepare design documentation; report progress; and deliver presentations to management, colleagues, and customers.
* Support the Responsible Engineer in reporting of status and tasking to IPT Leads, Program Managers, Chief Engineers, and other management.
* Develop analysis approaches for a variety of scenarios, working both independently and in collaboration with team members.

This position is contingent on contract award and the successful transfer of an active U.S Government Secret clearance.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 5 years of experience, a master’s degree with 3 years of experience, or a PhD with 1 years of experience in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or related technical fields; an additional 4 years may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* U.S Citizenship is required.
* A current/active U.S Government Secret Clearance.
* Proficiency in engineering programming languages (e.g., C/C++) with familiarity in MATLAB, LabVIEW, and/or Python.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with version control tools (e.g., Git, Bitbucket, ClearCase).
* Demonstrated ability to develop algorithms and process data using computer-based tools.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced degrees in Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.
* Experience with modeling, experimentation, simulation, validation, verification, and performance analysis
* Familiarity with RF principles, imagery scoring, performance analysis, and mode software, (GMTI, MMTI, SAR).
* Familiarity with scripting languages
* Experience working in a Linux or Solaris environment.
* Ability to travel on occasion to Northrop Grumman facilities and customer locations.

Northrop Grumman provides a comprehensive benefits package and a work environment which encourages your growth and supports the mutual success of our people and our company. Northrop Grumman benefits give you the flexibility and control to choose the benefits that make the most sense for you and your family.

  

Your benefits will include the following: Health Plan, Savings Plan, Paid Time Off and Additional Benefits including Education Assistance, Training and Development, 9/80 Work Schedule (where available), and much more!

  

Northrop Grumman has approximately 90,000 employees in all 50 states and in more than 27 countries. We strive to attract and retain the best employees by providing an inclusive work environment wherein employees are receptive to diverse ideas, perspectives, and talents to help solve our toughest customer challenges: to develop and maintain some of the most technically sophisticated products, programs, and services in the world.

  

Our Values. The women and men of Northrop Grumman Corporation are guided by Our Values. They describe our company as we want it to be. We want our decisions and actions to demonstrate these Values. We believe that putting Our Values into practice creates long-term benefits for shareholders, customers, employees, suppliers, and the communities we serve.

new_jobs.title: Database Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Description:

We’re hiring a skilled and detail-oriented **Database Systems Engineer** to join our Information Technology (IT) team. In this role, you’ll support and optimize Alturas Analytics’ laboratory and business systems by managing database infrastructure, developing custom applications and queries, and ensuring data performance, security, and reliability. You’ll play an important role in maintaining efficient, high-performing systems that enable our team to focus on delivering high-quality scientific work.

**Starting salary: $95,000+, DOE**

**This position is on-site only in Moscow, Idaho.**

**Why Join Alturas Analytics?**

Alturas Analytics, Inc. is a privately owned contract research organization specializing in bioanalytical services for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide. Our work supports scientific research that advances the treatment and cure of disease. At Alturas, you'll join a collaborative, supportive team that values quality, encourages professional growth, and takes pride in making a meaningful impact. We're committed to creating an environment where employees feel valued, continue to learn, and have opportunities to grow their careers.

**Benefits**

* We pay 100% of your premiums for health, dental, and vision insurance and a portion of the premium for dependent coverage
* PTO, paid sick time and paid holidays
* Bonus program based on company-wide goals
* Safe Harbor 401k with an automatic 3% employer contribution with additional 1% match option
* Health Savings Account (HSA) (with company match) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options - including Dependent Care
* Life insurance and short- and long-term disability at no cost to you
* Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) focused on mental health
* Voluntary Life, AD&D, Critical Illness and Accident insurance

**Perks**

* Work-life balance
* Opportunities for continuous learning, professional development and promotion; tuition reimbursement
* Relaxed yet professional environment
* Wellness program including bike/walk to work incentive
* Charitable donation matching and paid time off for volunteering
* Monthly catered lunches, holiday celebrations, unlimited (good) coffee, beverages, snacks and more!

### **A Day in the Life**

You’ll manage and optimize the database systems that support Alturas Analytics’ laboratory and business operations, overseeing database configuration, upgrades, migrations, performance tuning, backups, and security. You’ll also design and develop database applications, write custom queries, and collaborate with internal teams to meet business needs and resolve technical challenges. Additionally, you’ll help ensure system reliability, data integrity, and regulatory compliance while providing technical guidance and support to team members as needed.

**Essential Duties and Tasks:**

* Plans and maintains database server infrastructure, including hardware, operating systems and database software.
* Installs, configures and upgrades databases systems including but not limited to Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle Database.
* Performs data migrations and ensures compatibility with existing systems and applications.
* Performs database performance monitoring and tuning to optimize application performance.
* Patches database backend periodically.
* Creates, tests and implements database backup, restoration, and disaster recovery plans.
* Works with internal end users to understand user requirements and to develop custom applications, reports and queries for data export/import.
* Designs, tests and deploys databases to ensure database normalization, performance optimization and regulatory compliance.
* Codes and tests the application and custom queries with excellent understanding of good programming practices.
* Releases applications and queries for production per Alturas software lifecycle management processes.
* Maintains database security, access controls, and data integrity.
* Provides technical leadership and may supervise, train and mentor database or IT staff as assigned.

**Additional Duties and Tasks**:

* Collaborates with validation personnel for application testing and validation activities.
* Works with application, database and software vendors to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
* Performs other duties as needed or assigned.

Requirements:

**Education and Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s or Associate degree in Computer Science, Management Information System, Software Engineering or related fields.
* Experience supporting enterprise relational database systems such as Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle Database is preferred.
* Minimum of 4 years of work experience in database administration, database development or related role.
* Equivalent combination of education, training and relevant experience may be considered.

**Skills and Abilities Requirements:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to analyze and translate end user requirements into database designs and technical solutions.
* Advanced knowledge in relational database architecture and database design principles.
* Experience with database backup, disaster recovery strategies including transaction logs and point-in-time recovery.
* Proficient in Microsoft SQL Server T-SQL and Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
* Proficient in Microsoft Access Jet SQL and VBA/VB.
* Experience with database administration tools such as Toad, SSMS, SSIS or similar platforms.
* Advanced knowledge with database connectivity technologies including ODBC, OLEDB and related platforms.
* Understanding of regulated data environments and FDA regulatory requirements such as 21 CFR Part 11, GLP, and GCP is preferred (training may be provided).
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Position requires sitting over 2/3 of the time
* Position requires working in front of a computer monitor over 2/3 of the time
* Position requires walking less than 1/3 of the

* Generate and update system- and subsystem-level specifications, including requirements traceability, verification traceability (tracing requirements to test plans/procedures/results), and the update and maintenance of system drawings and documents.

-

* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to create and support a cooperative team environment.
* Experience working on Department of Defense (DoD) contracts.
* Prior experience designing hardware, firmware, and software, with the ability to allocate functions optimally across product elements.
* Experience leading hardware, software, and systems design teams, including demonstrated ability to:
* Provide critical insight to identify when teams require intervention,
* Define and remove stumbling blocks hindering success, and
* Take appropriate action to return the team to a successful path to completion.
* At least five (5) years of experience with the maintenance and sustainment of Electronic Warfare (EW) systems.
* Experience in the design, development, test, or sustainment of airborne tactical electronic systems.
* Ability to obtain or active Department of Defense (DoD) Secret or higher security clearance.

-

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PhD in electrical engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical field and 8+ years of related experience.
* Familiarity with the theory, operation, and practice of both airborne and ground-based tactical radars.
* Digital circuit design experience, including simulation and schematic capture through test and integration.
* Prototyping and hands-on debug experience testing digital subsystems, such as circuit card development involving FPGAs, embedded processors, graphics processors, and/or high-speed data interfaces (e.g., PCIe).
* System modeling and simulation experience, including development of MATLAB-based models of system functionality, to include FPGA functionality.

new_jobs.title: Advisor, Automation Engineering
new_jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
We are seeking an Indianapolis-based senior automation engineer to join the Automation Engineering team within Lilly's RNA Therapeutics group.
  
  
In this role, the successful candidate will do the core technical work of building, deploying, and supporting laboratory automation that advances pipeline-facing science, with a particular focus on in vitro pharmacology and chemistry workflows. Equally important is the partnership side of the role: working closely with scientific users to understand their needs, supporting the systems they depend on, and enabling teams to get the most out of automation. This is a builder's role for someone who wants to be close to the bench and the instruments, and who takes satisfaction in seeing their systems genuinely adopted.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a skilled automation engineer who independently identifies the key technical problems in a workflow and develops practical solutions to solve them. They take pride in delivering systems that are intuitive and dependable for users with varying levels of automation experience, so that automation measurably improves the efficiency of their work. They bring sound engineering judgment, a methodical approach to qualification and reproducibility, a teamwork-minded approach to user support, and an interest in how emerging tools, including LLM-based coding assistants, can speed up method development and deployment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Build, program, deploy, and maintain laboratory automation systems supporting in vitro pharmacology, chemistry, and related pipeline workflows
* Develop and validate automated methods, translating scientific protocols into robust, reproducible automated processes
* Partner directly with scientific users to gather requirements, understand their workflows, weigh practical tradeoffs, and deliver automation solutions that meet their needs
* Deploy and support automation systems tailored to specific pipeline processes and throughput needs
* Provide ongoing support for deployed systems, responding to user needs and keeping automation running reliably day to day
* Develop clear documentation, quick-reference guides, and ongoing support resources that help teams operate automated workflows independently
* Plan and deliver hands-on training to local end users on new instrumentation, automated methods, and protocols, tailoring instruction to varying levels of automation experience and ensuring users can operate systems confidently and independently
* Resolve hardware, software, and integration issues to keep systems running reliably
* Strengthen data reproducibility across automated processes through sound standards, controls, and qualification practices
* Integrate automation with scheduling and lab orchestration software and with ELN/LIMS platforms such as Benchling
* Apply LLM-based coding tools and agentic assistants to accelerate method development, scripting, and systems integration
* Contribute to the generation of large-scale, structured datasets suitable for AI/ML applications
* Build effective working relationships across scientific and engineering teams to ensure automation solutions fit real-world use

**Basic Qualifications:**  
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, biological sciences, or related field with 5+ years of hands-on laboratory automation experience.
  
  
**Additional Skills/Preferences:**  

* Hands-on expertise with the Hamilton automation ecosystem and a track record of building and deploying integrated automation across other platforms (e.g. acoustic dispensers (e.g., Echo), oligonucleotide synthesizers, robotic arms, Tecan instruments)
* Experience automating in vitro pharmacology and chemistry workflows.
* Strong method development and qualification skills, with a focus on reproducibility.
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with scientific users to gather requirements and support adoption.
* Experience with schedulers and end-to-end lab orchestration.
* Experience integrating automation with ELN/LIMS, such as Benchling.
* Experience with automated sample management systems.
* Proficiency in scripting or programming for automation.
* Experience using LLM-based coding tools or agentic assistants to accelerate method development, scripting, or systems integration.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to build durable working relationships with scientific users.

Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

**About the Role**
------------------

Aerodyn Engineering is looking for an Electrical Engineer to own the electrical programming and controls for our turbo test cells. You'll program Siemens PLCs, design and troubleshoot PC-based data acquisition systems, and select the sensors and controls that let us deliver accurate, successful test results to aerospace and industrial customers.

* Must demonstrate ability to act professionally.

new_jobs.title: Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer**  
  
Join Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions practice as a Microsoft Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant). You will help clients design, deploy, and support scalable Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365 F&O) and Power Platform environments that advance finance and supply chain transformation. You will collaborate with client business and technology leaders to establish secure application lifecycle management, DevOps, integration, and operational practices across complex engagements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.  
  
Work you'll do  
  
As a Microsoft D365/Power Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant) on the Emerging ERP Solutions team, you will be responsible for:  
  
Design and govern environment topology, routing, capacity, deployment standards, Data Loss Prevention policies, and managed-environment settings across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Dataverse, model-driven apps, and Power Automate; lead transitions from Lifecycle Services (LCS) to Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) deployment models.  
  
Architect and maintain Git-based application lifecycle management (ALM) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Power Platform Build Tools, solution packaging, automated solution checker gates, release controls, and rollback procedures.  
  
Lead client workshops, architecture reviews, and stakeholder discussions; document environment and architecture decisions in decision logs and runbooks; present trade-offs involving cost, governance, and delivery speed.  
  
Manage Azure integration services, including Service Bus, API Management (APIM), Storage Accounts, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and Application Insights; monitor batch jobs, workflows, integrations, and application performance; investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.  
  
Manage technical delivery across concurrent client engagements, mentor team members, maintain reusable assets, and evaluate governance implications of emerging Power Platform capabilities, including Code Apps, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and Copilot Studio agents.  
  
Participate in on-call and after-hours support as required.  
  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  
  
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  
  
Effective written and verbal communication skills  
  
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  
  
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  
  
Ability to lead projects or workstreams  
  
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  
  
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  
  
Ability to meet deadlines  
  
Ability to provide clear guidance to others  
  
Qualifications Required:  
  
6+ years of experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) or Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management (F&SCM), and Power Platform.  
  
Experience using Azure DevOps or GitHub-based continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for Dataverse solutions and Git workflows, including branching, pull requests, and conflict resolution.  
  
Experience using Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC), environment groups, managed environments, and Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS)-to-PPAC deployment transitions.  
  
Experience designing Dataverse solution architecture, including managed and unmanaged solution layering and use of the Power Platform Center of Excellence Starter Kit or Application Lifecycle Management Accelerator.  
  
Experience using Azure Portal and at least two of the following Azure services: API Management, Service Bus, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Key Vault, or Azure Functions.  
  
Experience leading client workshops, architecture reviews, or steering committee presentations.  
  
Experience managing technical delivery across two or more concurrent client engagements.  
  
You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.  
  
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.  
  
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.  
  
Preferred:  
  
Microsoft certifications: PL-600 (Solution Architect), MB-700 (F&SCM Solution Architect), MB-800, or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer).  
  
AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-204 (Azure Developer) certification.  
  
Experience with Dataverse Git integration and Power Platform Build Tools.  
  
Experience with Copilot Studio agent governance and AI Builder.  
  
Experience with dual-write or integration architectures connecting Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management or Customer Engagement to external systems through Service Bus or API Management.  
  
Experience creating environment and ALM decision records, operational support documentation, or runbooks.  
  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $116,000 to $229,100.

new_jobs.title: Automation Engineer (LAP)
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move.

* Job Type: Full time
* Work Type: On-site

  

**Louisville Assembly Plant | Future Home of the Ford Fathom™**

Louisville Assembly Plant is undergoing a historic transformation — and there's never been a better time to join this energized team. As the future home of the Ford Fathom™, we are launching the first truck built on Ford's Universal Electric Vehicle platform, and we're looking for talented people to help lead the way.

**In this position...**

As an Automation Engineer - You will apply designs, implement, and optimize automated control systems, robotics, and industrial machinery to maximize manufacturing efficiency, product quality, and operational safety. Dayshift; Must be able to work alternate shifts as business needs dictate.

**What you'll do...**

**Automation & New Technology Expertise**

* Hands-on experience with advanced material-handling technologies, including:
* Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) - Automated Guided Vehicles(AGVs)
* Automated dock systems (autoloading/unloading, dock scheduling, smart docks
* Ability to evaluate, pilot, implement, and optimize new logistics technologies
* Experience defining functional requirements, layouts, and traffic logic for AMR/AGV systems
* Understanding of fleet management systems, task orchestration, and exception handling
* Ability to coordinate with automation vendors and system integrators
* Experience with ASRS material storage/retrieval systems
* PLC experience

**Systems & Digital Integration**

* Experience integrating AMR/AGV systems with ERP, WMS, and MES
* Working knowledge of PLC interfaces, sensors, scanners, and safety systems, preference with Allen Bradley and Siemens
* Strong data analysis skills (Excel, Power BI, SQL, or similar) to monitor system performance and KPIs

**Process Improvement & Project Leadership**

* Lead or support automation, digitalization, and smart factory initiatives
* Apply Lean/CI principles to automated material flows
* Support plant launches, new line installs, and technology ramp-ups
* Conduct capacity analysis, ROI justification, and performance validation for automation projects
* Support plant launches, new line installs, and technology ramp-ups

**You'll have...**

* Bachelor’s degree in Industrial/Electrical Engineering, Automation, or related experience
* 3+ years of experience in automation, or manufacturing operations (related internships or co-op experience included)
* Experience in high-volume manufacturing or automotive environments
* Validated experience managing a unionized workforce

**Even better, you may have...**

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

* Immediate medical, dental, and prescription drug coverage
* Flexible family care, parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up childcare and more
* Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
* Vehicle discount program for employees and family members, and management leases
* Tuition assistance
* Established and active employee resource groups
* Paid time off for individual and team community service
* A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
* Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is a salary grade 7 and ranges from $84,480-141,360.

For more information on salary and benefits, click here: https://fordcareers.co/GSR

Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status.

The **Shipboard Effectors Department** is currently searching for an **Electrical Design Engineer II** to work on a multi-discipline team to support the production of Shipboard Effectors products and subsystems **located in Louisville, KY**.

This **Electrical Engineering** position is responsible for Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs) and other electrical subsystem hardware. We are seeking candidates with the skills and passion to engineer complex systems, subsystems, circuit card assemblies, and components.

A successful candidate is one who can participate in a multi-disciplined team and properly apply engineering tools and processes. A candidate is willing to collaborate and coordinate with Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and other Engineering disciplines to resolve issues that may arise during production, testing, and integration.

**What You Will Do:**

  

* Troubleshoot hardware and process issues down to CCA and component levels
* Resolution of issues on production lines and in testing (including suppliers)
* Failure analysis / root cause determination and corrective action implementation
* Performing analog and digital circuit analysis, and characterizing and modeling electrical signals of electronic subsystems in simulation
* Identifying and instantiating circuit card and subassembly design updates
* Some travel to suppliers may be required

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

  

* Typically requires a Bachelor's Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 5 years of prior relevant experience. An Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 3 years experience
* Electronics coursework, laboratory, or projects of electronics design
* The ability to obtain and maintain a US security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Qualifications We Value:**

  

* Master of Science in Electrical, Electronics, or Computer Science or related STEM degree
* Knowledge of analog, digital, or mixed signal analysis/design
* Radio Frequency (RF) and Electromagnetic coursework and/or laboratory
* Knowledge of high-level programming languages, such as: BASIC, C/C++
* Interest in or experience with RF/microwave devices
* Experience with electrical software, such as: Mentor Graphics, DxDesigner, PSPICE, Advanced Design System (ADS)
* Experience with common test equipment, such as: Oscilloscopes, DMMs, Logic Analyzers, Network Analyzers, etc.
* Willingness to lead small teams
* Willingness to work in a fast paced environment
* Effective written and spoken communication
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with coworkers
* Demonstrated ability to work with colleagues who represent a diversity of work and conflict resolution styles

**What We Offer**

  

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
* Relocation Eligible

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

  

* Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.***

new_jobs.description:
About Us:

NorthStar Energy Services, a **Quanta Services, Inc.** (NYSE:PWR) company, is based in Channelview, TX and provides engineering, design, procurement, construction and support services to the chemical, petrochemical, pipeline, oil & gas, bulk storage and terminal industries throughout the country. We offer individual project services as well as turnkey EPC project implementation.

NorthStar possesses the skills and expertise to self-perform the design and installation of civil, structural, mechanical, piping, electrical, and instrumentation systems throughout a broad array of industrial applications.

Joining our team means being part of an organization that values drive and inclusion. We focus on career development and reward excellence, recognizing each team member's unique contributions. We're at the forefront of powering modern life. Discover how your skills and dedication can make a real difference to us.

About this Role:

**Sr. Power Systems Engineer, P.E. - Baton Rouge, LA & Houston, TX**

10-15 Years Experience

NorthStar Energy Services is seeking an experienced **Senior Power Systems Engineer, P.E.** to join our Professional Engineering Consulting team. This role supports the design and execution of electrical systems for energy, petrochemical, industrial and data center industries. The Senior Power Systems Engineer will be responsible for developing electrical design concepts, performing advanced engineering analyses, and ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and client requirements across the full project lifecycle.

This position works closely with multidisciplinary engineering and design teams and plays a key role in delivering safe, reliable, and constructible power electrical designs for complex energy facilities.

(ID: 2026-3890)

**Axle** is a bioscience and information technology company that offers advancements in translational research, biomedical informatics, and data science applications to research centers and healthcare organizations nationally and abroad. With experts in biomedical science, software engineering, and program management, we focus on developing and applying research tools and techniques to empower decision-making and accelerate research discoveries. We work with some of the top research organizations and facilities in the country including multiple institutes at the National Institutes of Health (NIH).

  

**Benefits We Offer:**

* 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage for Employees
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* 401K match up to 5%
* Educational Benefits for Career Growth
* Employee Referral Bonus
* Flexible Spending Accounts:
  + Healthcare (FSA)
  + Parking Reimbursement Account (PRK)
  + Dependent Care Assistant Program (DCAP)
  + Transportation Reimbursement Account (TRN)

**Position Overview**

  

The Laboratory Automation Engineer will program, integrate, and keep running the robots of the autonomous laboratory in Bethesda, starting with the BAB400, so that biological experiments run reliably without a person at the bench. The role builds the software layer that turns robot hardware into orchestrated, repeatable workflows, using the MADSci framework from Argonne National Laboratory. It also builds digital twins of the robots and workcells, used to plan, test, and validate protocols before they run on real hardware. The position combines hands-on robotics work in a biological lab with production-quality software development, and it works closely with IDSS data engineers, bioinformaticians, and the biologists who define the protocols.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Robot programming and control.** Program, calibrate, and maintain the BAB400 and other laboratory robots, including arms, liquid handlers, plate movers, and incubator and imaging interfaces.
* **MADSci integration.** Deploy MADSci modules, nodes, and workcell definitions so each robot and instrument can be commanded, monitored, and scheduled through a common interface. Contribute fixes and new modules back to the framework where appropriate.
* **Workflow development and scheduling.** Translate biological protocols (cell culture, iPSC maintenance, passaging, media exchange, imaging, sampling) into automated workflows with sequencing, timing, resource tracking, and recovery from failures.
* **Instrument and data integration.** Connect robot and instrument outputs to the data pipelines, LIMS, and metadata systems maintained by IDSS, so every run is logged, traceable, and reusable.
* **Validation and reliability.** Develop acceptance tests, error handling, logging, and monitoring. Troubleshoot hardware and software faults, and document root causes and fixes.
* **Safety and compliance.** Implement interlocks and safe-state behavior, and follow laboratory, biosafety, and NIH/HHS security requirements.
* **Tool evaluation.** Evaluate robots, drivers, simulators, and frameworks, and prepare short technical assessments for IDSS leadership.
* **Training and documentation.** Train laboratory staff to operate and recover the system, and write standard operating procedures and technical documentation.

  

**Required Qualifications**

The selection standard is demonstrated ability to get automated systems working. A degree in engineering, computer science, robotics, or a related science is common, but equivalent practical experience is fully acceptable.

* **Automation experience.** Several years of hands-on experience with laboratory robotics or comparable automation, such as robotic arms, liquid handlers, plate handlers, or workcells, including installing, programming, calibrating, and troubleshooting them.
* **Robot software.** Experience with the software that drives laboratory robots: vendor APIs and SDKs, device drivers, and orchestration or scheduling software.
* **Laboratory context.** Some experience with robotics in a biological laboratory (cell culture, molecular biology, or assay automation), and comfort working around biological materials under biosafety practices.
* **Programming.** Strong Python, including asynchronous or service-style code, REST APIs, and working with hardware or network protocols (serial, TCP/IP, OPC UA, or similar).
* **Software engineering practices.** Experience with Git, testing, and code review, and with Docker for deploying software next to hardware.
* **Protocol translation.** Ability to read a protocol, understand what the biology requires, and turn it into a reliable automated workflow.
* **Communication.** Strong communication skills and the ability to train laboratory staff.
* **Clearance.** Ability to obtain and maintain NIH/HHS security clearance and meet federal contractor suitability requirements.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience with MADSci, or with similar laboratory orchestration frameworks (for example PyLabRobot, Opentrons tooling, or ROS-based systems).
* Experience with simulation platforms such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MoveIt, or similar robot simulators.
* Experience with stem cell, iPSC, organoid, or tissue engineering laboratories.
* Experience with self-driving or autonomous laboratories, including closed-loop experiments driven by ML or optimization.
* Familiarity with ROS 2, robot kinematics, and computer vision for labware or sample detection.
* Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and message-based architectures (MQTT, Redis, or similar).
* Familiarity with LIMS, ELN, and metadata standards, and with FAIR data principles.
* Experience with imaging instruments and plate-based assays.
* Experience building or using simulation or digital-twin models of robotic systems, or a clear record of learning a new simulator quickly.

**Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer**  
  
Join Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions practice as a Microsoft Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant). You will help clients design, deploy, and support scalable Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365 F&O) and Power Platform environments that advance finance and supply chain transformation. You will collaborate with client business and technology leaders to establish secure application lifecycle management, DevOps, integration, and operational practices across complex engagements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.  
  
Work you'll do  
  
As a Microsoft D365/Power Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant) on the Emerging ERP Solutions team, you will be responsible for:  
  
Design and govern environment topology, routing, capacity, deployment standards, Data Loss Prevention policies, and managed-environment settings across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Dataverse, model-driven apps, and Power Automate; lead transitions from Lifecycle Services (LCS) to Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) deployment models.  
  
Architect and maintain Git-based application lifecycle management (ALM) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Power Platform Build Tools, solution packaging, automated solution checker gates, release controls, and rollback procedures.  
  
Lead client workshops, architecture reviews, and stakeholder discussions; document environment and architecture decisions in decision logs and runbooks; present trade-offs involving cost, governance, and delivery speed.  
  
Manage Azure integration services, including Service Bus, API Management (APIM), Storage Accounts, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and Application Insights; monitor batch jobs, workflows, integrations, and application performance; investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.  
  
Manage technical delivery across concurrent client engagements, mentor team members, maintain reusable assets, and evaluate governance implications of emerging Power Platform capabilities, including Code Apps, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and Copilot Studio agents.  
  
Participate in on-call and after-hours support as required.  
  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  
  
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  
  
Effective written and verbal communication skills  
  
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  
  
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  
  
Ability to lead projects or workstreams  
  
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  
  
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  
  
Ability to meet deadlines  
  
Ability to provide clear guidance to others
