6+ years of experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) or Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management (F&SCM), and Power Platform.  
  
Experience using Azure DevOps or GitHub-based continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for Dataverse solutions and Git workflows, including branching, pull requests, and conflict resolution.  
  
Experience using Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC), environment groups, managed environments, and Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS)-to-PPAC deployment transitions.  
  
Experience designing Dataverse solution architecture, including managed and unmanaged solution layering and use of the Power Platform Center of Excellence Starter Kit or Application Lifecycle Management Accelerator.  
  
Experience using Azure Portal and at least two of the following Azure services: API Management, Service Bus, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Key Vault, or Azure Functions.  
  
Experience leading client workshops, architecture reviews, or steering committee presentations.  
  
Experience managing technical delivery across two or more concurrent client engagements.  
  
You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.  
  
Preferred:  
  
Microsoft certifications: PL-600 (Solution Architect), MB-700 (F&SCM Solution Architect), MB-800, or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer).  
  
AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-204 (Azure Developer) certification.  
  
Experience with Dataverse Git integration and Power Platform Build Tools.  
  
Experience with Copilot Studio agent governance and AI Builder.  
  
Experience with dual-write or integration architectures connecting Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management or Customer Engagement to external systems through Service Bus or API Management.  
  
Experience creating environment and ALM decision records, operational support documentation, or runbooks.

**Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer**  
  
Join Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions practice as a Microsoft Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant). You will help clients design, deploy, and support scalable Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365 F&O) and Power Platform environments that advance finance and supply chain transformation. You will collaborate with client business and technology leaders to establish secure application lifecycle management, DevOps, integration, and operational practices across complex engagements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.  
  
Work you'll do  
  
As a Microsoft D365/Power Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant) on the Emerging ERP Solutions team, you will be responsible for:  
  
Design and govern environment topology, routing, capacity, deployment standards, Data Loss Prevention policies, and managed-environment settings across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Dataverse, model-driven apps, and Power Automate; lead transitions from Lifecycle Services (LCS) to Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) deployment models.  
  
Architect and maintain Git-based application lifecycle management (ALM) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Power Platform Build Tools, solution packaging, automated solution checker gates, release controls, and rollback procedures.  
  
Lead client workshops, architecture reviews, and stakeholder discussions; document environment and architecture decisions in decision logs and runbooks; present trade-offs involving cost, governance, and delivery speed.  
  
Manage Azure integration services, including Service Bus, API Management (APIM), Storage Accounts, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and Application Insights; monitor batch jobs, workflows, integrations, and application performance; investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.  
  
Manage technical delivery across concurrent client engagements, mentor team members, maintain reusable assets, and evaluate governance implications of emerging Power Platform capabilities, including Code Apps, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and Copilot Studio agents.  
  
Participate in on-call and after-hours support as required.  
  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  
  
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  
  
Effective written and verbal communication skills  
  
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  
  
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  
  
Ability to lead projects or workstreams  
  
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  
  
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  
  
Ability to meet deadlines  
  
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

6+ years of experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) or Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management (F&SCM), and Power Platform.  
  
Experience using Azure DevOps or GitHub-based continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for Dataverse solutions and Git workflows, including branching, pull requests, and conflict resolution.  
  
Experience using Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC), environment groups, managed environments, and Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS)-to-PPAC deployment transitions.  
  
Experience designing Dataverse solution architecture, including managed and unmanaged solution layering and use of the Power Platform Center of Excellence Starter Kit or Application Lifecycle Management Accelerator.  
  
Experience using Azure Portal and at least two of the following Azure services: API Management, Service Bus, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Key Vault, or Azure Functions.  
  
Experience leading client workshops, architecture reviews, or steering committee presentations.  
  
Experience managing technical delivery across two or more concurrent client engagements.  
  
You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.  
  
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.  
  
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.  
  
Preferred:  
  
Microsoft certifications: PL-600 (Solution Architect), MB-700 (F&SCM Solution Architect), MB-800, or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer).  
  
AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-204 (Azure Developer) certification.  
  
Experience with Dataverse Git integration and Power Platform Build Tools.  
  
Experience with Copilot Studio agent governance and AI Builder.  
  
Experience with dual-write or integration architectures connecting Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management or Customer Engagement to external systems through Service Bus or API Management.  
  
Experience creating environment and ALM decision records, operational support documentation, or runbooks.

new_jobs.description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits.

**It's Time to Join Stryker!**
------------------------------

**Why Join Stryker?**
---------------------

Join Stryker's Mako Robotics team and help shape the future of robotic-assisted surgery!

As an Electrical Engineer, you will take ownership of electrical designs supporting Mako's robotic end effectors, contributing to the development, integration, testing, and improvement of sophisticated medical technology.

  

This is a hands-on opportunity to work across the electrical engineering lifecycle, from circuit design and hardware development to troubleshooting and system integration.

Working alongside a talented multidisciplinary engineering team, you will help develop reliable, innovative solutions that support surgical precision and improve patient outcomes.

If you enjoy building things, solving challenging technical problems, and seeing your designs come to life in real-world applications, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Design, develop, and support electrical components and subsystems for Mako robotic end effectors, taking ownership of assigned electrical designs throughout the development lifecycle.
* Translate product requirements into electrical engineering specifications, circuit designs, and technical solutions.
* Perform schematic design, PCB development, component selection, and electrical hardware integration activities.
* Build and evaluate prototypes, conduct bench testing, and validate electrical functionality and performance.
* Troubleshoot electrical hardware and system-level issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective solutions.
* Integrate electrical hardware with mechanical, software, and other system components to support reliable robotic system performance.
* Evaluate existing designs, identify opportunities for improvement, and support ongoing product development and engineering changes.
* Conduct electrical testing, verification activities, and technical investigations to ensure designs meet performance, safety, and quality requirements.
* Develop and maintain engineering documentation, including schematics, design specifications, test procedures, technical reports, and design history records.
* Collaborate with Systems, Mechanical, Software, Manufacturing, Quality, and other cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges and support successful product development.
* Apply engineering best practices, design controls, and risk management principles in accordance with applicable medical device regulations and quality system requirements.

**What You Need**
-----------------

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline is required.
* 2 or more years of professional engineering experience is required.

### **Preferred Qualifications (You do not need to have all of these)**

  

* Experience designing, developing, building, testing, and troubleshooting electrical hardware or subsystems.
* Experience with electrical schematic design, PCB development, and component selection.
* Proficiency with electrical design tools, with experience using Altium Designer preferred.
* Hands-on experience with electrical prototyping, bench testing, and laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and power supplies.
* Experience troubleshooting electrical circuits and resolving hardware integration or system-level issues.
* Understanding of electrical system integration and interactions between hardware, software, and mechanical components.
* Experience translating engineering requirements into electrical designs, test plans, and verification activities.
* Familiarity with electrical manufacturing processes, design for manufacturability, and hardware reliability considerations.
* Experience supporting electromechanical systems, robotics, or other complex integrated products.
* Experience working in a regulated industry, particularly medical devices, including familiarity with design controls, risk management, and technical documentation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on, collaborative approach to engineering challenges.
* Ability to independently manage technical assignments, communicate findings, and collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

  

* $89,300 - $148,800 USD Annual

Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD&D insurance, and short-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.

new_jobs.title: Sr Controls Engineer - Heat Rejection
new_jobs.description:
Gradian is an engineering-led, full-line thermal solutions partner serving data center and other mission-critical, commercial, and industrial markets. Headquartered in Maple Grove, MN, with additional facilities across North America, we design and manufacture liquid cooling systems, air handling equipment, heat rejection units, and modular, factory-assembled thermal management solutions.

Gradian was founded through the unification of four complementary, established brands: MAS HVAC, Daedex, DeepCoolAI, and EcoChillers. Together, we act as a single-source provider, deploying cooling technologies as scalable systems optimized for efficiency, spatial constraints, and overall performance. With a vertically integrated engineering and manufacturing model, we pair rapid design turnaround with precision fabrication, so customers can move faster on complex projects where reliability, timeline, and quality all matter.

**Why work here**

At Gradian, you'll work alongside others who get genuinely fired up by complex problems, see your work go from first sketch to job site in weeks, not years, and know that while we're developing the technologies critical for AI infrastructure to scale, our culture remains people-first by design.

It is core to our identity that we operate as one team — driving to win together, energizing others, and building lasting relationships that make the work fun and rewarding.

**Position Summary:**

The Senior Controls Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for designing, integrating, and programming advanced control systems for chillers, heat rejection equipment, and related products. This role requires deep expertise in control system architecture, hardware selection, and software programming, along with experience leading cross-functional teams. The Senior Controls Engineer will drive technical strategy, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and business functions to ensure successful execution of complex projects. The position bridges high-level strategy and hands-on implementation, ensuring innovative, reliable, and efficient control solutions for mission-critical environments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and integrate control systems for chillers and heat rejection equipment, including dry coolers, adiabatic coolers, cooling towers, and condensers.
* Develop control system architectures for new machines, including hardware selection (HMIs, sensors, VFDs, actuators, etc.) and software programming logic.
* Program control logic and sequences of operation (e.g., compressor staging, fan and pump speed control, free-cooling changeover, adiabatic/spray control, and lead-lag staging) to meet customer requirements, specifications, and standards.
* Conduct thorough testing of control systems on test benches, prototype chillers, or heat rejection units to identify and resolve issues including troubleshooting and debugging.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including R&D, product development, sales, and customer support, to deliver effective control solutions.
* Develop and maintain detailed engineering documentation, including control system drawings, wiring diagrams, and system specifications.
* Ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and in accordance with customer specifications.
* Maintain and improve internal processes to enhance product quality and efficiency.
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies, incorporating them into product designs.

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

Required:

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in control systems engineering, preferably with OEM products.
* Demonstrated expertise in designing and developing detailed electrical schematics using industry-standard software such as AutoCAD and Visio.
* Proven ability to develop and implement control algorithms for PC, PLC, and HMI platforms using vendor-specific software and in compliance with industry standards.
* Experience with control communication protocols, including Modbus TCP/RTU, BACnet, and Ethernet/IP.
* Demonstrated capability to perform three phase power and arc flash calculations, determining SCCR and componentry for 480VAC enclosures, power transformers, panelboards and switchgear.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to resolve complex system issues.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams and customers.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and prioritize tasks effectively.

Preferred:

* Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Familiarity with chiller and heat rejection controls, data center applications, electrical codes, and safety standards.
* Background knowledge with Distech control systems.

**Key Competencies:**

* Strong analytical and technical skills.
* Ability to manage complex projects and meet deadlines.
* Collaborative mindset with cross-functional teams.
* Innovative approach to solving chiller and heat rejection challenges.
* Strategic leadership and mentorship abilities.

* Education assistance program

Experience managing technical delivery across two or more concurrent client engagements.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Microsoft certifications: PL-600 (Solution Architect), MB-700 (F&SCM Solution Architect), MB-800, or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer).

Join our team as a Senior Electrical Engineer-Control Panel Design!

This is a hybrid role based out of our upcoming office in Raleigh, North Carolina. The position is salaried and includes eligibility for overtime pay.

* Varied industrial background is a plus. Key industries include food and beverage, chemical, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to interact with customers, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Must possess a valid driver's license.
* Must be able to travel, both locally and overnight, approximately 20-25%.

new_jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer - Linux/Firmware (Job ID 3022539)
new_jobs.description:
**Locations and Workstyle:**

**Blue Bell, PA**: Primarily remote; candidates should be within commuting distance of the Blue Bell office and able to work onsite as needed. Option to come onsite more frequently if desired.
  
**Irving, TX** and **Boca Raton, FL**: Hybrid schedule – onsite a minimum of four days per week, with one remote day. Five days onsite may be required based on business needs.

**What you should know about our team:**
  
You’ll join a Product Engineering environment focused on developing reliable embedded software for security systems. In this role, you’ll work hands-on across embedded Linux development, system integration, build and release automation, and production support. You’ll collaborate closely with Systems, Hardware, Quality, DevOps, Security, and Product teams to turn requirements into production-ready software.

**What you will do:**

* You’ll own meaningful pieces of the embedded software lifecycle, from design and development through testing, integration, and release. Your work will help improve the reliability, repeatability, and quality of the software and firmware that powers our security products.
* Design, develop, debug, test, and maintain C/C++ software and firmware in embedded Linux environments.
* Build and enhance Linux platform components, including system services, device interfaces, networking functions, board configurations, and hardware and cloud integrations.
* Deliver maintainable, production-quality code and unit tests while reviewing pull requests and ensuring changes meet architecture, security, quality, and coding standards.
* Own and improve embedded build and release environments using Buildroot, cross-compilation toolchains, package integration, versioning, system image generation, and artifact management.
* Automate and maintain build, test, and release pipelines incorporating continuous integration, static analysis, test execution, release validation, and deployment readiness.
* Investigate and resolve build, integration, and release failures through root-cause analysis and corrective actions that improve reliability and release quality.
* Integrate and govern AI-assisted engineering tools for development, code review, test generation, defect analysis, and documentation while applying appropriate validation, security, IP, and traceability controls.
* Collaborate across Systems, Hardware, Quality, DevOps, Security, and Product teams while developing reusable automation, frameworks, and engineering practices.

**What you need to be successful:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
* Strong hands-on experience developing and debugging C/C++ software in embedded Linux environments.
* Knowledge of Linux kernel concepts, device interfaces, system services, networking, and software security.
* Hands-on experience with Buildroot, including configuration, package integration, board configuration, cross-compilation, system image generation, and build troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting firmware release processes, including firmware over-the-air releases.
* Experience managing automated build, test, and release pipelines for embedded products.
* Strong technical judgment, ownership, teamwork, and the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work across functions and quickly learn new technical concepts.

**What will set you apart:**

* Experience with Yocto.
* Experience with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, LTE, Z-Wave, Matter, or Thread.
* Experience designing systems to meet non-functional requirements.
* Experience leading cross-functional engineering efforts.
* Experience applying AI-assisted tools responsibly within software engineering workflows.

**How ADT invests in you:**

* Culture of professional development & training
* Commitment to equity and inclusion through ongoing initiatives, employee resource groups, and employee recognition programs.
* Volunteer Opportunities
* Pay per performance culture
* Click here to view our full benefit offerings.

**Why you’ll love working here:**

* We boldly shape the future, embracing change, taking smart risks, and continuously improving to create the best experiences.
* We lead by taking ownership, empowering you to make decisions, solve problems proactively, and support each other with empathy.
* We elevate to serve a greater purpose, going above and beyond to earn trust, celebrate wins, and value every perspective.
* We unite and win together, fostering teamwork, breaking down silos, and achieving shared goals through inclusivity and collaboration.

  

*In the event a position is commission-based, compensation is solely based on the individual’s sales volume. This applies only to commission roles.*

  

Los Angeles Applicants: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Philadelphia Applicants: Background checks will be conducted during the employment process. Any information will be reviewed through an individualized assessment in accordance with the Philadelphia Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance.

  

***ADT is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. ADT strives to ensure every employee and applicant feels valued. Visit us at jobs.adt.com/diversity to learn more.***

new_jobs.title: Systems Engineer Associate - Early Career
new_jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

Performs technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, cost and risk, and supportability and effectiveness analyses for total systems. Analyses are performed at all levels of total system product to include: concept, design, fabrication, test, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal. Ensures the logical and systematic conversion of customer or product requirements into total systems solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule, and cost constraints. Performs functional analysis, timeline analysis, detail trade studies, requirements allocation and interface definition studies to translate customer requirements into hardware and software specifications. For positions that perform IT responsibilities, use E646, Systems Engr-IT.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline
* Understanding of Systems Engineering fundamentals, lifecycle, and work products
* Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)
* Active DoD Secret clearance or above

**Desired Skills**
------------------

Experience with a related Program, Project or Customer

Experience working in the development phase of a Space or Missile development program preferably for the US Government

Systems engineering experience or relevant systems engineering training through a university or certificate program

Experience with one or more Systems Engineering functions in a program setting, such as:

a.) Subsystem design or analysis

b.) CONOPS development

c.) System modeling or analysis

d.) Requirements and Interface Control Document (ICD) development

e.) System trade studies

f.) System Integration, Test and/or Verification

g.) Design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, etc.)

Missile or space segment design and test experience with one or more subsystems or disciplines outside of Systems Engineering

Familiarity or proficiency with the following engineering tools: Model Center, Cameo (NoMagic) aligned with UAF® using Unified Profile for DoDAF/MODAF (UPDM™) 3.0 modeling standard and UML/SysML, DOORS

Ability to work in a fast-paced, synergetic team environment

Demonstrated basic understanding of systems thinking skills and behaviors

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong social skills, and ability to build consensus among peers while building solid relationships with team members

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $65500.00 - $121700.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
* For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

**Description**
---------------

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking a **Staff Electrical Engineer** **T**his position will be located in **Roy, UT**.  
  
**What You’ll Get To Do:**

The Flight Systems Futures operating unit within Strategic Deterrent Systems is seeking highly motivated talent to join a team at the forefront of next-generation hypersonic capabilities. Our team focuses on the design, development, and demonstration of hypersonic re-entry vehicles and advanced payloads, with an emphasis on rapid development and prototyping aligned to specific customer missions. We operate in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment where innovative concepts are matured quickly into credible, testable solutions that address our nation’s most demanding strategic deterrence needs.

This role will be joining a team of electrical engineers as part of one of our new programs, the following are the roles responsibilities:

  

* Author clear, testable requirements and verification plans for electrical subsystems.
* Review and assess vendor provided technical data (schematics, datasheets, test reports) for compliance with program requirements.
* Support and update the program Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) model, maintaining traceability among requirements, interfaces, and verification items.
* Collaborate with mechanical, software, and test engineers to capture cross Domain impacts and resolve conflicts.
* Participate in design, trade, and verification reviews; provide status updates to program leadership.
* Follow Northrop Grumman configuration control and documentation standards.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) discipline from an accredited university and12 years of experience, or 10 years of experience with a Master’s degree, or 8 years of experience with a PhD.
* Must be a US Citizen with an active DoD Top Secret Clearance. Must have the ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) approval within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs.
* 3+ years experience in reading and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and component datasheets with familiarity with creating verification matrices, test procedures, and traceability documentation for electrical hardware.
* 1+ years experience in model based engineering concepts; ability to work with and maintain system models.
* 1+ years experience of industry/military codes and standards, including mil-specs, IEEE, NEC, NESC, NFPA, IEC, and UFC.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience generating and maintaining requirements in an MBSE model using CAMEO Systems Modeler (or equivalent SysML tool).
* Prior involvement with electrical subsystems for nuclear surety or nuclear safety programs.
* Experience with configuration management tools (Perforce, Git) and PLM systems.
* INCOSE Certified Systems Engineering Professional (CSEP) or similar certification.
* Basic knowledge or ability to pick up Northrop Grumman engineering processes (CMMI, MILSTD498, DO178C/DO254).
* Strong written and verbal communication; capable of producing concise status reports and presenting technical information to cross functional teams.
* Experience with high-power and/or high-frequency systems, including power electronics.
* Knowledge of EMI/EMC design, shielding techniques, and thermal management for electronic systems.
* Authorship and release of engineering documentation including technical drawings, specifications, and test procedures.

* Paid Time Off
* Health & Wellness Resources
* Employee Discounts

This positions standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off. This role may offer a competitive relocation assistance package.

George Mason University, a Carnegie Research I institution, is Virginia’s largest and most diverse university with more than 38,000 students. Located in Fairfax, Virginia, Mason is part of the Washington DC metropolitan area offering easy access to the scientific and political resources of the nation’s capital.
  
  
George Mason University is committed to advancing inclusion, access, and equal opportunity throughout our community. We believe that a broad range of voices, cultures, and perspectives brings vibrancy, innovation, and growth to an academic community.
  
  
The Landolt Mission team is responsible for developing and executing a NASA space-based mission through coordinated work across science, payload, spacecraft bus, software, systems engineering, integration and test, mission assurance, and project management functions. The unit provides an interdisciplinary research and training environment for faculty, postdoctoral researchers, engineers, staff, and students working collaboratively with federal, academic, commercial, and other external partners.
  
  
The Landolt Mission team supports mission formulation, systems engineering, subsystem coordination, technical trade studies, requirements development, verification and validation planning, assembly, integration and testing, technical documentation, mission reviews, and mission operations planning. The unit works collaboratively across payload, spacecraft bus, software, ground systems, mission operations, science, and programmatic interfaces to advance mission objectives and meet NASA requirements.

We believe that varied opinions, cultures, and perspectives are what provides vibrancy, innovation, and growth to an academic community. By prioritizing cultural responsiveness in academics, teaching, research, and global engagement, we strive to attract faculty and staff who exemplify the Mason Science mission and vision.

* Fosters a culture of engagement, diversity, inclusiveness, excellence, and innovation. Champions George Mason University's commitment to Access, Justice, Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion to create an inclusive and welcoming environment that promotes a commitment to safety, integrity, and teamwork.

* PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical or Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field;
* Knowledge of NASA procedures and practices; and
* Knowledge of space system development, integration, and testing.

new_jobs.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

As a Senior Systems Engineer on Shield AI’s next gen UAS program, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and integrating cutting-edge autonomous aircraft systems for national defense. You will lead the technical execution of system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, autonomy, propulsion, sensor payloads, and mission-critical systems.

This position requires a deep understanding of aerospace systems engineering, autonomy, and complex system integration. You will work cross-functionally with teams in hardware, software, autonomy, flight operations, and manufacturing to develop a scalable, mission-ready platform capable of operating in contested environments.

Your expertise will be critical in defining system requirements and architectures through model-based systems engineering, conducting trade studies, ensuring compliance with military and aviation standards, and supporting the aircraft through flight testing and operational deployment.

### **What You'll Do**

* Perform System Architecture & Design: Develop and refine the system architecture for the next gen UAS, ensuring seamless integration of avionics, autonomy, propulsion, sensor payloads, and mission systems.
* Define and document system-level behavior, including modes, states, transitions, and fault responses
* Support safety analyses (FHA, FMEA, FTA) by defining behavior under fault conditions
* Define and Manage System Requirements: Establish top-level requirements, decompose them into subsystems, and maintain traceability across the development lifecycle.
* Autonomy & AI Integration: Work closely with autonomy and software teams to integrate AI-driven flight control, decision-making, and mission execution capabilities.
* Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE): Utilize SysML, DOORS, or other MBSE tools to create digital system models, conduct trade studies, and optimize system performance.
* Risk Management & Trade Studies: Conduct trade studies to evaluate design alternatives, assess technical risks, and ensure the best engineering solutions for mission effectiveness.
* Stakeholder & Customer Engagement: Work closely with DoD stakeholders, industry partners, and government agencies to align system capabilities with operational requirements.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, autonomy, software, propulsion, and flight operations teams to drive seamless system integration and rapid development cycles.

### **What You'll Bring**

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in systems engineering for aerospace, defense, or autonomous aircraft systems.
* Demonstrated experience defining system behavior logic and operational modes
* Deep expertise in system architecture, avionics integration, and autonomy-driven flight systems.
* Proficiency in MBSE, DOORS, SysML, CAMEO, or similar system modeling tools for complex systems design and analysis.
* Experience with Group 4 or Group 5 UAS, military aircraft, or autonomous airborne platforms.
* Strong background in flight testing, system integration, and performance validation.
* Knowledge of DoD acquisition processes, MIL-STDs, FAA airworthiness certification, and airborne system safety standards.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive complex projects to successful completion.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile development environment with shifting priorities.
* Worked on developmental program from clean sheet to first flight

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing AI-driven autonomy for unmanned aircraft.
* Expertise in ISR, EW, and advanced sensor integration for airborne platforms.
* Familiarity with modular open system architectures (MOSA) and Government Reference Architectures (GRA) for defense applications.
* Prior experience working with defense primes, DoD stakeholders, or government R&D programs.
* Active Secret clearance (or ability to obtain one).

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack, Frontend-Focused)
new_jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a talented and passionate **Software Engineer** for our **Snowpark Container Service**, part of our **Snowflake Compute Platform** - to build our elastic, high-scale, high-performance, cloud native compute platform to enable bringing Compute to Data effortless and simple.

**Snowpark Container Services** is a fully managed container offering that helps our customers easily deploy, manage, and scale containerized applications without having to move data out of Snowflake. As a fully managed service, it comes with Snowflake security, configuration, and operational best practices built in. You will be part of this highly productive, fast moving, and growing team that is critical to realizing Snowflake’s Data Cloud Mission.

### **AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL:**

* Design and develop features, understand customer requirements and meet business goals.
* Lead a team of engineers, including mentoring and guiding them, and build technical direction and strategy for large and critical parts of the product surface area.
* Manage all aspects of the Project, including Design, Coding, Reviews, Testing, Observability, Tooling and On-Call support.
* Build highly reliable and fault-tolerant software to meet the needs of the largest customers.
* Ensure operational readiness and maintainability of the service with heavy focus on reliability, availability, debuggability and performance.
* Design and build Kubernetes based OCI compliant container compute platform features and capabilities that scale and evolve with changing business and customer needs.
* Snowpark Container Services is still in an early stage of development - it is an amazing opportunity for outsized impact on Snowflake’s growth story.

### **OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE MOST OF THE FOLLOWING QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Excitement to learn new things - passion to learn and grow are keys to success on this team.
* Be a team player - Our team culture is a priority. Transparency, knowledge sharing, fun events, and helping each other are all part of our work environment
* Work across functions and across teams - we don’t only work on code that we own, we work with other parts of Snowflake every day.
* 4+ years of industry experience building features and capabilities of large scale systems or infrastructure level platforms.
* Extremely strong fundamental computer science skills and experience building distributed systems.
* Hands-on coding experience in Java, C++ or Go is highly desirable
* Ability to work on-site in our downtown Bellevue office.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

* The estimated base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $230,000.
* Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

new_jobs.title: Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Microsoft D365 Sr Systems Engineer**  
  
Join Deloitte's Emerging ERP Solutions practice as a Microsoft Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant). You will help clients design, deploy, and support scalable Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365 F&O) and Power Platform environments that advance finance and supply chain transformation. You will collaborate with client business and technology leaders to establish secure application lifecycle management, DevOps, integration, and operational practices across complex engagements.  
  
Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.  
  
Work you'll do  
  
As a Microsoft D365/Power Platform Sr Systems Engineer (Sr Consultant) on the Emerging ERP Solutions team, you will be responsible for:  
  
Design and govern environment topology, routing, capacity, deployment standards, Data Loss Prevention policies, and managed-environment settings across Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, Dataverse, model-driven apps, and Power Automate; lead transitions from Lifecycle Services (LCS) to Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC) deployment models.  
  
Architect and maintain Git-based application lifecycle management (ALM) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, Power Platform Build Tools, solution packaging, automated solution checker gates, release controls, and rollback procedures.  
  
Lead client workshops, architecture reviews, and stakeholder discussions; document environment and architecture decisions in decision logs and runbooks; present trade-offs involving cost, governance, and delivery speed.  
  
Manage Azure integration services, including Service Bus, API Management (APIM), Storage Accounts, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Key Vault, and Application Insights; monitor batch jobs, workflows, integrations, and application performance; investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.  
  
Manage technical delivery across concurrent client engagements, mentor team members, maintain reusable assets, and evaluate governance implications of emerging Power Platform capabilities, including Code Apps, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and Copilot Studio agents.  
  
Participate in on-call and after-hours support as required.  
  
A successful candidate would possess these skills:  
  
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  
  
Effective written and verbal communication skills  
  
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  
  
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  
  
Ability to lead projects or workstreams  
  
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  
  
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  
  
Ability to meet deadlines  
  
Ability to provide clear guidance to others  
  
Qualifications Required:  
  
6+ years of experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) or Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management (F&SCM), and Power Platform.  
  
Experience using Azure DevOps or GitHub-based continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for Dataverse solutions and Git workflows, including branching, pull requests, and conflict resolution.  
  
Experience using Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC), environment groups, managed environments, and Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS)-to-PPAC deployment transitions.  
  
Experience designing Dataverse solution architecture, including managed and unmanaged solution layering and use of the Power Platform Center of Excellence Starter Kit or Application Lifecycle Management Accelerator.  
  
Experience using Azure Portal and at least two of the following Azure services: API Management, Service Bus, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT) Hub, Key Vault, or Azure Functions.  
  
Experience leading client workshops, architecture reviews, or steering committee presentations.  
  
Experience managing technical delivery across two or more concurrent client engagements.  
  
You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.  
  
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.  
  
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.  
  
Preferred:  
  
Microsoft certifications: PL-600 (Solution Architect), MB-700 (F&SCM Solution Architect), MB-800, or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer).  
  
AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-204 (Azure Developer) certification.  
  
Experience with Dataverse Git integration and Power Platform Build Tools.  
  
Experience with Copilot Studio agent governance and AI Builder.  
  
Experience with dual-write or integration architectures connecting Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management or Customer Engagement to external systems through Service Bus or API Management.  
  
Experience creating environment and ALM decision records, operational support documentation, or runbooks.  
  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. new_jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------

The Office of the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) provides operations support services and business solutions to the community of 10,000 House Members, Officers and staff.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Clarification from the agency**

Open to the public

  

**Duties**
----------

**Job Summary:**

The Office of the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) provides operations support services and business solutions to the community of 10,000 House Members, Officers and staff. The CAO organization comprises more than 800 technical and administrative staff working in a variety of areas, including information technology, finance, budget management, human resources, payroll, child care, food and vending, procurement, logistics and administrative counsel.

This position is located in the Immediate Office, House Recording Studio (HRS), Office of the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO), U.S. House of Representatives (House). The purpose of the House Recording Studio is to provide live broadcast coverage of House proceedings, livestream coverage of Committee hearings, and full-service television and radio studios to Members of Congress. This position serves as Network Systems Engineer.

Key responsibilities include supporting, maintaining, and improving the internal audio and video networks required to facilitate House Recording Studio operations, including transport of uncompressed, real-time video, audio, and metadata. Incumbent will provide systems administration and configuration of network hardware and software components within HRS’ hybrid IP-SDI infrastructure and serve as a technical consultant on network systems analysis, integration, implementation, and maintenance.

Limited travel and a flexible work schedule including occasional weekends and late nights are required for this position. Schedule may fluctuate on a biweekly basis to accommodate the service needs of the House. Grade level at time of appointment is determined by experience and designated level of responsibility.
  
  
The position does not have day-to-day supervisory/managerial responsibilities.

**Primary Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with the Principal Engineer and Program Manager to assist in designing high-performance, scalable, and secure IP networks in full mesh design for live video production across a multi-site campus.
* Optimize routing of network traffic to ensure dynamic pathfinding and maximum redundancy of critical applications and fault tolerance to prevent single link failures from disrupting the network.
* Modernize existing workflows to transition television operations from SDI to IP and improve existing IP workflows on a continual basis.
* Implement appropriate encryption and security protocols to protect data integrity.
* Implement pertinent technologies such as Layer 2 Leaf-Spine and Layer 3 Leaf-Spine.
* Create and update technical drawings and schematics using industry standard software tools.
* Manage the deployment of ST-2110 systems utilizing System Timing (-10), Uncompressed Video (-20),
* Compressed Video (-22), PCM Audio (-30), and Ancillary Data (-40) standards.
* Configure Precision Time Protocol (IEEE 1588 PTP) to ensure precise timing and synchronization across operations.
* Utilize network analyzers and specialized monitoring tools to diagnose packet loss, jitter, and bandwidth issues.
* Perform daily verification of network health; develop and maintain tracking, measurement, and quality control processes for assigned areas, and provide reports as directed.
* Perform diagnostic testing as needed to identify technical characteristics of complex systems, encompassing broadcast, audiovisual, and network environments.
* Proactively monitor software and firmware versions and install updates and patches as needed to ensure optimal system performance.
* Ensure that audio and video broadcast standards are consistently maintained.
* Apply project management principles to achieve successful outcomes, including definition of scope, identification of deliverables, risk management, timeline discipline, and collaborative communication.
* Research, review, and recommend innovative solutions to meet service needs, improve performance, and modernize operations.
* Maintain and seek to enhance customer experience; and maintain positive, respectful communication with customers and coworkers at all times.
* Oversee installation, commissioning, maintenance, repair, decommissioning, and replacement of all IP and network equipment used for broadcast production operations and adhere to lifecycle maintenance standards as directed by management.
* Fiber optic cable infrastructure design, testing and installation oversight.
* Day-to-day administration of Arista CloudVision.
* Continually maintain knowledge of industry trends and seek professional development to keep pace with evolving technologies.
* Train and mentor junior staff and new employees.
* Perform miscellaneous clerical and administrative tasks as needed.
* Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* USAJobs Conditions of Employment

### **Qualifications**

**Qualifications:**

Minimum

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent level of professional work experience.
* Five years of professional network engineering experience with progressive professional development to maintain competence in evolving technology.
* Arista Campus Wired Engineering Specialist certification or an Arista Data Center Engineering Specialist certification.
* Working knowledge of IP, Realtime Protocol (RTP), Precision Time Protocol (PTP) and Border Gateway Protocol (MP-BGP).
* Working knowledge of Protocol Independent Multicast (PIM) - Sparse Mode, Rendezvous Point r
